vulg: quoniam quidem multi conati sunt ordinare narrationem quae in nobis conpletae sunt rerum
clem: Quoniam quidem multi conati sunt ordinare narrationem, qu in nobis complet sunt, rerum:
tr: επειδηπερ πολλοι επεχειρησαν αναταξασθαι διηγησιν περι των πεπληροφορημενων εν ημιν πραγματων
kjv: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

vulg: sicut tradiderunt nobis qui ab initio ipsi viderunt et ministri fuerunt sermonis
clem: sicut tradiderunt nobis, qui ab initio ipsi viderunt, et ministri fuerunt sermonis:
tr: καθως παρεδοσαν ημιν οι απ αρχης αυτοπται και υπηρεται γενομενοι του λογου
kjv: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;

vulg: visum est et mihi adsecuto a principio omnibus diligenter ex ordine tibi scribere optime Theophile
clem: visum est et mihi, assecuto omnia a principio diligenter, ex ordine tibi scribere, optime Theophile,
tr: εδοξεν καμοι παρηκολουθηκοτι ανωθεν πασιν ακριβως καθεξης σοι γραψαι κρατιστε θεοφιλε
kjv: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,

vulg: ut cognoscas eorum verborum de quibus eruditus es veritatem
clem: ut cognoscas eorum verborum, de quibus eruditus es, veritatem.
tr: ινα επιγνως περι ων κατηχηθης λογων την ασφαλειαν
kjv: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.

vulg: fuit in diebus Herodis regis Iudaeae sacerdos quidam nomine Zaccharias de vice Abia et uxor illi de filiabus Aaron et nomen eius Elisabeth
clem: Fuit in diebus Herodis, regis Jud, sacerdos quidam nomine Zacharias de vice Abia, et uxor illius de filiabus Aaron, et nomen ejus Elisabeth.
tr: εγενετο εν ταις ημεραις ηρωδου του βασιλεως της ιουδαιας ιερευς τις ονοματι ζαχαριας εξ εφημεριας αβια και η γυνη αυτου εκ των θυγατερων ααρων και το ονομα αυτης ελισαβετ
kjv: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

vulg: erant autem iusti ambo ante Deum incedentes in omnibus mandatis et iustificationibus Domini sine querella
clem: Erant autem justi ambo ante Deum, incedentes in omnibus mandatis et justificationibus Domini sine querela.
tr: ησαν δε δικαιοι αμφοτεροι ενωπιον του θεου πορευομενοι εν πασαις ταις εντολαις και δικαιωμασιν του κυριου αμεμπτοι
kjv: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

vulg: et non erat illis filius eo quod esset Elisabeth sterilis et ambo processissent in diebus suis
clem: Et non erat illis filius, eo quod esset Elisabeth sterilis, et ambo processissent in diebus suis.
tr: και ουκ ην αυτοις τεκνον καθοτι η ελισαβετ ην στειρα και αμφοτεροι προβεβηκοτες εν ταις ημεραις αυτων ησαν
kjv: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.

vulg: factum est autem cum sacerdotio fungeretur in ordine vicis suae ante Deum
clem: Factum est autem, cum sacerdotio fungeretur in ordine vicis su ante Deum,
tr: εγενετο δε εν τω ιερατευειν αυτον εν τη ταξει της εφημεριας αυτου εναντι του θεου
kjv: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,

vulg: secundum consuetudinem sacerdotii sorte exiit ut incensum poneret ingressus in templum Domini
clem: secundum consuetudinem sacerdotii, sorte exiit ut incensum poneret, ingressus in templum Domini:
tr: κατα το εθος της ιερατειας ελαχεν του θυμιασαι εισελθων εις τον ναον του κυριου
kjv: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

vulg: et omnis multitudo erat populi orans foris hora incensi
clem: et omnis multitudo populi erat orans foris hora incensi.
tr: και παν το πληθος του λαου ην προσευχομενον εξω τη ωρα του θυμιαματος
kjv: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.

vulg: apparuit autem illi angelus Domini stans a dextris altaris incensi
clem: Apparuit autem illi angelus Domini, stans a dextris altaris incensi.
tr: ωφθη δε αυτω αγγελος κυριου εστως εκ δεξιων του θυσιαστηριου του θυμιαματος
kjv: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

vulg: et Zaccharias turbatus est videns et timor inruit super eum
clem: Et Zacharias turbatus est videns, et timor irruit super eum.
tr: και εταραχθη ζαχαριας ιδων και φοβος επεπεσεν επ αυτον
kjv: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

vulg: ait autem ad illum angelus ne timeas Zaccharia quoniam exaudita est deprecatio tua et uxor tua Elisabeth pariet tibi filium et vocabis nomen eius Iohannem
clem: Ait autem ad illum angelus: Ne timeas, Zacharia, quoniam exaudita est deprecatio tua: et uxor tua Elisabeth pariet tibi filium, et vocabis nomen ejus Joannem:
tr: ειπεν δε προς αυτον ο αγγελος μη φοβου ζαχαρια διοτι εισηκουσθη η δεησις σου και η γυνη σου ελισαβετ γεννησει υιον σοι και καλεσεις το ονομα αυτου ιωαννην
kjv: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

vulg: et erit gaudium tibi et exultatio et multi in nativitate eius gaudebunt
clem: et erit gaudium tibi, et exsultatio, et multi in nativitate ejus gaudebunt:
tr: και εσται χαρα σοι και αγαλλιασις και πολλοι επι τη γεννησει αυτου χαρησονται
kjv: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.

vulg: erit enim magnus coram Domino et vinum et sicera non bibet et Spiritu Sancto replebitur adhuc ex utero matris suae
clem: erit enim magnus coram Domino: et vinum et siceram non bibet, et Spiritu Sancto replebitur adhuc ex utero matris su:
tr: εσται γαρ μεγας ενωπιον του κυριου και οινον και σικερα ου μη πιη και πνευματος αγιου πλησθησεται ετι εκ κοιλιας μητρος αυτου
kjv: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.

vulg: et multos filiorum Israhel convertet ad Dominum Deum ipsorum
clem: et multos filiorum Isral convertet ad Dominum Deum ipsorum:
tr: και πολλους των υιων ισραηλ επιστρεψει επι κυριον τον θεον αυτων
kjv: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.

vulg: et ipse praecedet ante illum in spiritu et virtute Heliae ut convertat corda patrum in filios et incredibiles ad prudentiam iustorum parare Domino plebem perfectam
clem: et ipse prcedet ante illum in spiritu et virtute Eli: ut convertat corda patrum in filios, et incredulos ad prudentiam justorum, parare Domino plebem perfectam.
tr: και αυτος προελευσεται ενωπιον αυτου εν πνευματι και δυναμει ηλιου επιστρεψαι καρδιας πατερων επι τεκνα και απειθεις εν φρονησει δικαιων ετοιμασαι κυριω λαον κατεσκευασμενον
kjv: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.

vulg: et dixit Zaccharias ad angelum unde hoc sciam ego enim sum senex et uxor mea processit in diebus suis
clem: Et dixit Zacharias ad angelum: Unde hoc sciam? ego enim sum senex, et uxor mea processit in diebus suis.
tr: και ειπεν ζαχαριας προς τον αγγελον κατα τι γνωσομαι τουτο εγω γαρ ειμι πρεσβυτης και η γυνη μου προβεβηκυια εν ταις ημεραις αυτης
kjv: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.

vulg: et respondens angelus dixit ei ego sum Gabrihel qui adsto ante Deum et missus sum loqui ad te et haec tibi evangelizare
clem: Et respondens angelus dixit ei: Ego sum Gabriel, qui asto ante Deum: et missus sum loqui ad te, et hc tibi evangelizare.
tr: και αποκριθεις ο αγγελος ειπεν αυτω εγω ειμι γαβριηλ ο παρεστηκως ενωπιον του θεου και απεσταλην λαλησαι προς σε και ευαγγελισασθαι σοι ταυτα
kjv: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.

vulg: et ecce eris tacens et non poteris loqui usque in diem quo haec fiant pro eo quod non credidisti verbis meis quae implebuntur in tempore suo
clem: Et ecce eris tacens, et non poteris loqui usque in diem quo hc fiant, pro eo quod non credidisti verbis meis, qu implebuntur in tempore suo.
tr: και ιδου εση σιωπων και μη δυναμενος λαλησαι αχρι ης ημερας γενηται ταυτα ανθ ων ουκ επιστευσας τοις λογοις μου οιτινες πληρωθησονται εις τον καιρον αυτων
kjv: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

vulg: et erat plebs expectans Zacchariam et mirabantur quod tardaret ipse in templo
clem: Et erat plebs exspectans Zachariam: et mirabantur quod tardaret ipse in templo.
tr: και ην ο λαος προσδοκων τον ζαχαριαν και εθαυμαζον εν τω χρονιζειν αυτον εν τω ναω
kjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.

vulg: egressus autem non poterat loqui ad illos et cognoverunt quod visionem vidisset in templo et ipse erat innuens illis et permansit mutus
clem: Egressus autem non poterat loqui ad illos, et cognoverunt quod visionem vidisset in templo. Et ipse erat innuens illis, et permansit mutus.
tr: εξελθων δε ουκ ηδυνατο λαλησαι αυτοις και επεγνωσαν οτι οπτασιαν εωρακεν εν τω ναω και αυτος ην διανευων αυτοις και διεμενεν κωφος
kjv: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.

vulg: et factum est ut impleti sunt dies officii eius abiit in domum suam
clem: Et factum est, ut impleti sunt dies officii ejus, abiit in domum suam:
tr: και εγενετο ως επλησθησαν αι ημεραι της λειτουργιας αυτου απηλθεν εις τον οικον αυτου
kjv: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

vulg: post hos autem dies concepit Elisabeth uxor eius et occultabat se mensibus quinque dicens
clem: post hos autem dies concepit Elisabeth uxor ejus, et occultabat se mensibus quinque, dicens:
tr: μετα δε ταυτας τας ημερας συνελαβεν ελισαβετ η γυνη αυτου και περιεκρυβεν εαυτην μηνας πεντε λεγουσα
kjv: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,

vulg: quia sic mihi fecit Dominus in diebus quibus respexit auferre obprobrium meum inter homines
clem: Quia sic fecit mihi Dominus in diebus, quibus respexit auferre opprobrium meum inter homines.
tr: οτι ουτως μοι πεποιηκεν ο κυριος εν ημεραις αις επειδεν αφελειν το ονειδος μου εν ανθρωποις
kjv: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.

vulg: in mense autem sexto missus est angelus Gabrihel a Deo in civitatem Galilaeae cui nomen Nazareth
clem: In mense autem sexto, missus est angelus Gabriel a Deo in civitatem Galil, cui nomen Nazareth,
tr: εν δε τω μηνι τω εκτω απεσταλη ο αγγελος γαβριηλ υπο του θεου εις πολιν της γαλιλαιας η ονομα ναζαρετ  ναζαρεθ
kjv: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

vulg: ad virginem desponsatam viro cui nomen erat Ioseph de domo David et nomen virginis Maria
clem: ad virginem desponsatam viro, cui nomen erat Joseph, de domo David: et nomen virginis Maria.
tr: προς παρθενον μεμνηστευμενην ανδρι ω ονομα ιωσηφ εξ οικου δαβιδ και το ονομα της παρθενου μαριαμ
kjv: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.

vulg: et ingressus angelus ad eam dixit have gratia plena Dominus tecum benedicta tu in mulieribus
clem: Et ingressus angelus ad eam dixit: Ave gratia plena: Dominus tecum: benedicta tu in mulieribus.
tr: και εισελθων ο αγγελος προς αυτην ειπεν χαιρε κεχαριτωμενη ο κυριος μετα σου ευλογημενη συ εν γυναιξιν
kjv: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.

vulg: quae cum vidisset turbata est in sermone eius et cogitabat qualis esset ista salutatio
clem: Qu cum audisset, turbata est in sermone ejus, et cogitabat qualis esset ista salutatio.
tr: η δε ιδουσα διεταραχθη επι τω λογω αυτου και διελογιζετο ποταπος ειη ο ασπασμος ουτος
kjv: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.

vulg: et ait angelus ei ne timeas Maria invenisti enim gratiam apud Deum
clem: Et ait angelus ei: Ne timeas, Maria: invenisti enim gratiam apud Deum.
tr: και ειπεν ο αγγελος αυτη μη φοβου μαριαμ ευρες γαρ χαριν παρα τω θεω
kjv: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.

vulg: ecce concipies in utero et paries filium et vocabis nomen eius Iesum
clem: Ecce concipies in utero, et paries filium, et vocabis nomen ejus Jesum:
tr: και ιδου συλληψη εν γαστρι και τεξη υιον και καλεσεις το ονομα αυτου ιησουν
kjv: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name Jesus.

vulg: hic erit magnus et Filius Altissimi vocabitur et dabit illi Dominus Deus sedem David patris eius
clem: hic erit magnus, et Filius Altissimi vocabitur, et dabit illi Dominus Deus sedem David patris ejus: et regnabit in domo Jacob in ternum,
tr: ουτος εσται μεγας και υιος υψιστου κληθησεται και δωσει αυτω κυριος ο θεος τον θρονον δαβιδ του πατρος αυτου
kjv: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:

vulg: et regnabit in domo Iacob in aeternum et regni eius non erit finis
clem: et regni ejus non erit finis.
tr: και βασιλευσει επι τον οικον ιακωβ εις τους αιωνας και της βασιλειας αυτου ουκ εσται τελος
kjv: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

vulg: dixit autem Maria ad angelum quomodo fiet istud quoniam virum non cognosco
clem: Dixit autem Maria ad angelum: Quomodo fiet istud, quoniam virum non cognosco?
tr: ειπεν δε μαριαμ προς τον αγγελον πως εσται τουτο επει ανδρα ου γινωσκω
kjv: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?

vulg: et respondens angelus dixit ei Spiritus Sanctus superveniet in te et virtus Altissimi obumbrabit tibi ideoque et quod nascetur sanctum vocabitur Filius Dei
clem: Et respondens angelus dixit ei: Spiritus Sanctus superveniet in te, et virtus Altissimi obumbrabit tibi. Ideoque et quod nascetur ex te sanctum, vocabitur Filius Dei.
tr: και αποκριθεις ο αγγελος ειπεν αυτη πνευμα αγιον επελευσεται επι σε και δυναμις υψιστου επισκιασει σοι διο και το γεννωμενον  εκ σου  αγιον κληθησεται υιος θεου
kjv: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

vulg: et ecce Elisabeth cognata tua et ipsa concepit filium in senecta sua et hic mensis est sextus illi quae vocatur sterilis
clem: Et ecce Elisabeth cognata tua, et ipsa concepit filium in senectute sua: et hic mensis sextus est illi, qu vocatur sterilis:
tr: και ιδου ελισαβετ η συγγενης σου και αυτη συνειληφυια υιον εν γηρα αυτης και ουτος μην εκτος εστιν αυτη τη καλουμενη στειρα
kjv: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.

vulg: quia non erit inpossibile apud Deum omne verbum
clem: quia non erit impossibile apud Deum omne verbum.
tr: οτι ουκ αδυνατησει παρα τω θεω παν ρημα
kjv: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

vulg: dixit autem Maria ecce ancilla Domini fiat mihi secundum verbum tuum et discessit ab illa angelus
clem: Dixit autem Maria: Ecce ancilla Domini: fiat mihi secundum verbum tuum. Et discessit ab illa angelus.
tr: ειπεν δε μαριαμ ιδου η δουλη κυριου γενοιτο μοι κατα το ρημα σου και απηλθεν απ αυτης ο αγγελος
kjv: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

vulg: exsurgens autem Maria in diebus illis abiit in montana cum festinatione in civitatem Iuda
clem: Exsurgens autem Maria in diebus illis, abiit in montana cum festinatione, in civitatem Juda:
tr: αναστασα δε μαριαμ εν ταις ημεραις ταυταις επορευθη εις την ορεινην μετα σπουδης εις πολιν ιουδα
kjv: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;

vulg: et intravit in domum Zacchariae et salutavit Elisabeth
clem: et intravit in domum Zachari, et salutavit Elisabeth.
tr: και εισηλθεν εις τον οικον ζαχαριου και ησπασατο την ελισαβετ
kjv: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.

vulg: et factum est ut audivit salutationem Mariae Elisabeth exultavit infans in utero eius et repleta est Spiritu Sancto Elisabeth
clem: Et factum est, ut audivit salutationem Mari Elisabeth, exsultavit infans in utero ejus: et repleta est Spiritu Sancto Elisabeth:
tr: και εγενετο ως ηκουσεν η ελισαβετ τον ασπασμον της μαριας εσκιρτησεν το βρεφος εν τη κοιλια αυτης και επλησθη πνευματος αγιου η ελισαβετ
kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:

vulg: et exclamavit voce magna et dixit benedicta tu inter mulieres et benedictus fructus ventris tui
clem: et exclamavit voce magna, et dixit: Benedicta tu inter mulieres, et benedictus fructus ventris tui.
tr: και ανεφωνησεν φωνη μεγαλη και ειπεν ευλογημενη συ εν γυναιξιν και ευλογημενος ο καρπος της κοιλιας σου
kjv: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

vulg: et unde hoc mihi ut veniat mater Domini mei ad me
clem: Et unde hoc mihi, ut veniat mater Domini mei ad me?
tr: και ποθεν μοι τουτο ινα ελθη η μητηρ του κυριου μου προς με
kjv: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

vulg: ecce enim ut facta est vox salutationis tuae in auribus meis exultavit in gaudio infans in utero meo
clem: Ecce enim ut facta est vox salutationis tu in auribus meis, exsultavit in gaudio infans in utero meo.
tr: ιδου γαρ ως εγενετο η φωνη του ασπασμου σου εις τα ωτα μου εσκιρτησεν εν αγαλλιασει το βρεφος εν τη κοιλια μου
kjv: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

vulg: et beata quae credidit quoniam perficientur ea quae dicta sunt ei a Domino
clem: Et beata, qu credidisti, quoniam perficientur ea, qu dicta sunt tibi a Domino.
tr: και μακαρια η πιστευσασα οτι εσται τελειωσις τοις λελαλημενοις αυτη παρα κυριου
kjv: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

vulg: et ait Maria magnificat anima mea Dominum
clem: Et ait Maria: [Magnificat anima mea Dominum:
tr: και ειπεν μαριαμ μεγαλυνει η ψυχη μου τον κυριον
kjv: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

vulg: et exultavit spiritus meus in Deo salutari meo
clem: et exsultavit spiritus meus in Deo salutari meo.
tr: και ηγαλλιασεν το πνευμα μου επι τω θεω τω σωτηρι μου
kjv: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

vulg: quia respexit humilitatem ancillae suae ecce enim ex hoc beatam me dicent omnes generationes
clem: Quia respexit humilitatem ancill su: ecce enim ex hoc beatam me dicent omnes generationes,
tr: οτι επεβλεψεν επι την ταπεινωσιν της δουλης αυτου ιδου γαρ απο του νυν μακαριουσιν με πασαι αι γενεαι
kjv: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

vulg: quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est et sanctum nomen eius
clem: quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: et sanctum nomen ejus,
tr: οτι εποιησεν μοι μεγαλεια ο δυνατος και αγιον το ονομα αυτου
kjv: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.

vulg: et misericordia eius in progenies et progenies timentibus eum
clem: et misericordia ejus a progenie in progenies timentibus eum.
tr: και το ελεος αυτου εις γενεας γενεων τοις φοβουμενοις αυτον
kjv: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.

vulg: fecit potentiam in brachio suo dispersit superbos mente cordis sui
clem: Fecit potentiam in brachio suo: dispersit superbos mente cordis sui.
tr: εποιησεν κρατος εν βραχιονι αυτου διεσκορπισεν υπερηφανους διανοια καρδιας αυτων
kjv: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

vulg: deposuit potentes de sede et exaltavit humiles
clem: Deposuit potentes de sede, et exaltavit humiles.
tr: καθειλεν δυναστας απο θρονων και υψωσεν ταπεινους
kjv: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.

vulg: esurientes implevit bonis et divites dimisit inanes
clem: Esurientes implevit bonis: et divites dimisit inanes.
tr: πεινωντας ενεπλησεν αγαθων και πλουτουντας εξαπεστειλεν κενους
kjv: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.

vulg: suscepit Israhel puerum suum memorari misericordiae
clem: Suscepit Isral puerum suum, recordatus misericordi su:
tr: αντελαβετο ισραηλ παιδος αυτου μνησθηναι ελεους
kjv: He hath helped his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;

vulg: sicut locutus est ad patres nostros Abraham et semini eius in saecula
clem: sicut locutus est ad patres nostros, Abraham et semini ejus in scula.]
tr: καθως ελαλησεν προς τους πατερας ημων τω αβρααμ και τω σπερματι αυτου εις τον αιωνα
kjv: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.

vulg: mansit autem Maria cum illa quasi mensibus tribus et reversa est in domum suam
clem: Mansit autem Maria cum illa quasi mensibus tribus: et reversa est in domum suam.
tr: εμεινεν δε μαριαμ συν αυτη ωσει μηνας τρεις και υπεστρεψεν εις τον οικον αυτης
kjv: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

vulg: Elisabeth autem impletum est tempus pariendi et peperit filium
clem: Elisabeth autem impletum est tempus pariendi, et peperit filium.
tr: τη δε ελισαβετ επλησθη ο χρονος του τεκειν αυτην και εγεννησεν υιον
kjv: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.

vulg: et audierunt vicini et cognati eius quia magnificavit Dominus misericordiam suam cum illa et congratulabantur ei
clem: Et audierunt vicini et cognati ejus quia magnificavit Dominus misericordiam suam cum illa, et congratulabantur ei.
tr: και ηκουσαν οι περιοικοι και οι συγγενεις αυτης οτι εμεγαλυνεν κυριος το ελεος αυτου μετ αυτης και συνεχαιρον αυτη
kjv: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

vulg: et factum est in die octavo venerunt circumcidere puerum et vocabant eum nomine patris eius Zacchariam
clem: Et factum est in die octavo, venerunt circumcidere puerum, et vocabant eum nomine patris sui Zachariam.
tr: και εγενετο εν τη ογδοη ημερα ηλθον περιτεμειν το παιδιον και εκαλουν αυτο επι τω ονοματι του πατρος αυτου ζαχαριαν
kjv: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

vulg: et respondens mater eius dixit nequaquam sed vocabitur Iohannes
clem: Et respondens mater ejus, dixit: Nequaquam, sed vocabitur Joannes.
tr: και αποκριθεισα η μητηρ αυτου ειπεν ουχι αλλα κληθησεται ιωαννης
kjv: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.

vulg: et dixerunt ad illam quia nemo est in cognatione tua qui vocetur hoc nomine
clem: Et dixerunt ad illam: Quia nemo est in cognatione tua, qui vocetur hoc nomine.
tr: και ειπον προς αυτην οτι ουδεις εστιν εν τη συγγενεια σου ος καλειται τω ονοματι τουτω
kjv: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.

vulg: innuebant autem patri eius quem vellet vocari eum
clem: Innuebant autem patri ejus, quem vellet vocari eum.
tr: ενενευον δε τω πατρι αυτου το τι αν θελοι καλεισθαι αυτον
kjv: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.

vulg: et postulans pugillarem scripsit dicens Iohannes est nomen eius et mirati sunt universi
clem: Et postulans pugillarem scripsit, dicens: Joannes est nomen ejus. Et mirati sunt universi.
tr: και αιτησας πινακιδιον εγραψεν λεγων ιωαννης εστιν το ονομα αυτου και εθαυμασαν παντες
kjv: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.

vulg: apertum est autem ilico os eius et lingua eius et loquebatur benedicens Deum
clem: Apertum est autem illico os ejus, et lingua ejus, et loquebatur benedicens Deum.
tr: ανεωχθη δε το στομα αυτου παραχρημα και η γλωσσα αυτου και ελαλει ευλογων τον θεον
kjv: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.

vulg: et factus est timor super omnes vicinos eorum et super omnia montana Iudaeae divulgabantur omnia verba haec
clem: Et factus est timor super omnes vicinos eorum: et super omnia montana Jud divulgabantur omnia verba hc:
tr: και εγενετο επι παντας φοβος τους περιοικουντας αυτους και εν ολη τη ορεινη της ιουδαιας διελαλειτο παντα τα ρηματα ταυτα
kjv: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.

vulg: et posuerunt omnes qui audierant in corde suo dicentes quid putas puer iste erit etenim manus Domini erat cum illo
clem: et posuerunt omnes qui audierant in corde suo, dicentes: Quis, putas, puer iste erit? etenim manus Domini erat cum illo.
tr: και εθεντο παντες οι ακουσαντες εν τη καρδια αυτων λεγοντες τι αρα το παιδιον τουτο εσται και χειρ κυριου ην μετ αυτου
kjv: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

vulg: et Zaccharias pater eius impletus est Spiritu Sancto et prophetavit dicens
clem: Et Zacharias pater ejus repletus est Spiritu Sancto: et prophetavit, dicens:
tr: και ζαχαριας ο πατηρ αυτου επλησθη πνευματος αγιου και προεφητευσεν λεγων
kjv: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,

vulg: benedictus Deus Israhel quia visitavit et fecit redemptionem plebi suae
clem: [Benedictus Dominus Deus Isral, quia visitavit, et fecit redemptionem plebis su:
tr: ευλογητος κυριος ο θεος του ισραηλ οτι επεσκεψατο και εποιησεν λυτρωσιν τω λαω αυτου
kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

vulg: et erexit cornu salutis nobis in domo David pueri sui
clem: et erexit cornu salutis nobis in domo David pueri sui,
tr: και ηγειρεν κερας σωτηριας ημιν εν τω οικω δαβιδ του παιδος αυτου
kjv: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;

vulg: sicut locutus est per os sanctorum qui a saeculo sunt prophetarum eius
clem: sicut locutum est per os sanctorum, qui a sculo sunt, prophetarum ejus:
tr: καθως ελαλησεν δια στοματος των αγιων των απ αιωνος προφητων αυτου
kjv: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:

vulg: salutem ex inimicis nostris et de manu omnium qui oderunt nos
clem: salutem ex inimicis nostris, et de manu omnium qui oderunt nos:
tr: σωτηριαν εξ εχθρων ημων και εκ χειρος παντων των μισουντων ημας
kjv: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;

vulg: ad faciendam misericordiam cum patribus nostris et memorari testamenti sui sancti
clem: ad faciendam misericordiam cum patribus nostris: et memorari testamenti sui sancti:
tr: ποιησαι ελεος μετα των πατερων ημων και μνησθηναι διαθηκης αγιας αυτου
kjv: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;

vulg: iusiurandum quod iuravit ad Abraham patrem nostrum
clem: jusjurandum, quod juravit ad Abraham patrem nostrum, daturum se nobis
tr: ορκον ον ωμοσεν προς αβρααμ τον πατερα ημων
kjv: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,

vulg: daturum se nobis ut sine timore de manu inimicorum nostrorum liberati serviamus illi
clem: ut sine timore, de manu inimicorum nostrorum liberati, serviamus illi
tr: του δουναι ημιν (1:74) αφοβως εκ χειρος των εχθρων ημων ρυσθεντας λατρευειν αυτω
kjv: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,

vulg: in sanctitate et iustitia coram ipso omnibus diebus nostris
clem: in sanctitate et justitia coram ipso, omnibus diebus nostris.
tr: εν οσιοτητι και δικαιοσυνη ενωπιον αυτου πασας τας ημερας της ζωης ημων
kjv: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.

vulg: et tu puer propheta Altissimi vocaberis praeibis enim ante faciem Domini parare vias eius
clem: Et tu puer, propheta Altissimi vocaberis: pribis enim ante faciem Domini parare vias ejus,
tr: και συ παιδιον προφητης υψιστου κληθηση προπορευση γαρ προ προσωπου κυριου ετοιμασαι οδους αυτου
kjv: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;

vulg: ad dandam scientiam salutis plebi eius in remissionem peccatorum eorum
clem: ad dandam scientiam salutis plebi ejus in remissionem peccatorum eorum
tr: του δουναι γνωσιν σωτηριας τω λαω αυτου εν αφεσει αμαρτιων αυτων
kjv: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,

vulg: per viscera misericordiae Dei nostri in quibus visitavit nos oriens ex alto
clem: per viscera misericordi Dei nostri, in quibus visitavit nos, oriens ex alto:
tr: δια σπλαγχνα ελεους θεου ημων εν οις επεσκεψατο ημας ανατολη εξ υψους
kjv: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,

vulg: inluminare his qui in tenebris et in umbra mortis sedent ad dirigendos pedes nostros in viam pacis
clem: illuminare his qui in tenebris et in umbra mortis sedent: ad dirigendos pedes nostros in viam pacis.]
tr: επιφαναι τοις εν σκοτει και σκια θανατου καθημενοις του κατευθυναι τους ποδας ημων εις οδον ειρηνης
kjv: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

vulg: puer autem crescebat et confortabatur spiritu et erat in deserto usque in diem ostensionis suae ad Israhel
clem: Puer autem crescebat, et confortabatur spiritu: et erat in desertis usque in diem ostensionis su ad Isral.
tr: το δε παιδιον ηυξανεν και εκραταιουτο πνευματι και ην εν ταις ερημοις εως ημερας αναδειξεως αυτου προς τον ισραηλ
kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.

vulg: factum est autem in diebus illis exiit edictum a Caesare Augusto ut describeretur universus orbis
clem: Factum est autem in diebus illis, exiit edictum a Csare Augusto ut describeretur universus orbis.
tr: εγενετο δε εν ταις ημεραις εκειναις εξηλθεν δογμα παρα καισαρος αυγουστου απογραφεσθαι πασαν την οικουμενην
kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be taxed.

vulg: haec descriptio prima facta est praeside Syriae Cyrino
clem: Hc descriptio prima facta est a prside Syri Cyrino:
tr: αυτη η απογραφη πρωτη εγενετο ηγεμονευοντος της συριας κυρηνιου
kjv: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

vulg: et ibant omnes ut profiterentur singuli in suam civitatem
clem: et ibant omnes ut profiterentur singuli in suam civitatem.
tr: και επορευοντο παντες απογραφεσθαι εκαστος εις την ιδιαν πολιν
kjv: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

vulg: ascendit autem et Ioseph a Galilaea de civitate Nazareth in Iudaeam civitatem David quae vocatur Bethleem eo quod esset de domo et familia David
clem: Ascendit autem et Joseph a Galila de civitate Nazareth in Judam, in civitatem David, qu vocatur Bethlehem: eo quod esset de domo et familia David,
tr: ανεβη δε και ιωσηφ απο της γαλιλαιας εκ πολεως ναζαρετ  ναζαρεθ  εις την ιουδαιαν εις πολιν δαβιδ ητις καλειται 2564 βηθλεεμ δια το ειναι αυτον εξ οικου και πατριας δαβιδ
kjv: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

vulg: ut profiteretur cum Maria desponsata sibi uxore praegnate
clem: ut profiteretur cum Maria desponsata sibi uxore prgnante.
tr: απογραψασθαι συν μαριαμ τη μεμνηστευμενη αυτω γυναικι ουση εγκυω
kjv: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

vulg: factum est autem cum essent ibi impleti sunt dies ut pareret
clem: Factum est autem, cum essent ibi, impleti sunt dies ut pareret.
tr: εγενετο δε εν τω ειναι αυτους εκει επλησθησαν αι ημεραι του τεκειν αυτην
kjv: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.

vulg: et peperit filium suum primogenitum et pannis eum involvit et reclinavit eum in praesepio quia non erat eis locus in diversorio
clem: Et peperit filium suum primogenitum, et pannis eum involvit, et reclinavit eum in prsepio: quia non erat eis locus in diversorio.
tr: και ετεκεν τον υιον αυτης τον πρωτοτοκον και εσπαργανωσεν αυτον και ανεκλινεν αυτον εν τη φατνη διοτι ουκ ην αυτοις τοπος εν τω καταλυματι
kjv: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

vulg: et pastores erant in regione eadem vigilantes et custodientes vigilias noctis supra gregem suum
clem: Et pastores erant in regione eadem vigilantes, et custodientes vigilias noctis super gregem suum.
tr: και ποιμενες ησαν εν τη χωρα τη αυτη αγραυλουντες και φυλασσοντες φυλακας της νυκτος επι την ποιμνην αυτων
kjv: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

vulg: et ecce angelus Domini stetit iuxta illos et claritas Dei circumfulsit illos et timuerunt timore magno
clem: Et ecce angelus Domini stetit juxta illos, et claritas Dei circumfulsit illos, et timuerunt timore magno.
tr: και ιδου αγγελος κυριου επεστη αυτοις και δοξα κυριου περιελαμψεν αυτους και εφοβηθησαν φοβον μεγαν
kjv: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

vulg: et dixit illis angelus nolite timere ecce enim evangelizo vobis gaudium magnum quod erit omni populo
clem: Et dixit illis angelus: Nolite timere: ecce enim evangelizo vobis gaudium magnum, quod erit omni populo:
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις ο αγγελος μη φοβεισθε ιδου γαρ ευαγγελιζομαι υμιν χαραν μεγαλην ητις εσται παντι τω λαω
kjv: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

vulg: quia natus est vobis hodie salvator qui est Christus Dominus in civitate David
clem: quia natus est vobis hodie Salvator, qui est Christus Dominus, in civitate David.
tr: οτι ετεχθη υμιν σημερον σωτηρ ος εστιν χριστος κυριος εν πολει δαβιδ
kjv: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

vulg: et hoc vobis signum invenietis infantem pannis involutum et positum in praesepio
clem: Et hoc vobis signum: invenietis infantem pannis involutum, et positum in prsepio.
tr: και τουτο υμιν το σημειον ευρησετε βρεφος εσπαργανωμενον κειμενον εν τη φατνη
kjv: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

vulg: et subito facta est cum angelo multitudo militiae caelestis laudantium Deum et dicentium
clem: Et subito facta est cum angelo multitudo militi clestis laudantium Deum, et dicentium:
tr: και εξαιφνης εγενετο συν τω αγγελω πληθος στρατιας ουρανιου αινουντων τον θεον και λεγοντων
kjv: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,

vulg: gloria in altissimis Deo et in terra pax in hominibus bonae voluntatis
clem: [Gloria in altissimis Deo, et in terra pax hominibus bon voluntatis.]
tr: δοξα εν υψιστοις θεω και επι γης ειρηνη εν ανθρωποις ευδοκια
kjv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

vulg: et factum est ut discesserunt ab eis angeli in caelum pastores loquebantur ad invicem transeamus usque Bethleem et videamus hoc verbum quod factum est quod fecit Dominus et ostendit nobis
clem: Et factum est, ut discesserunt ab eis angeli in clum: pastores loquebantur ad invicem: Transeamus usque Bethlehem, et videamus hoc verbum, quod factum est, quod Dominus ostendit nobis.
tr: και εγενετο ως απηλθον απ αυτων εις τον ουρανον οι αγγελοι και οι ανθρωποι οι ποιμενες ειπον προς αλληλους διελθωμεν δη εως βηθλεεμ και ιδωμεν το ρημα τουτο το γεγονος ο ο κυριος εγνωρισεν ημιν
kjv: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

vulg: et venerunt festinantes et invenerunt Mariam et Ioseph et infantem positum in praesepio
clem: Et venerunt festinantes: et invenerunt Mariam, et Joseph, et infantem positum in prsepio.
tr: και ηλθον σπευσαντες και ανευρον την τε μαριαμ και τον ιωσηφ και το βρεφος κειμενον εν τη φατνη
kjv: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

vulg: videntes autem cognoverunt de verbo quod dictum erat illis de puero hoc
clem: Videntes autem cognoverunt de verbo, quod dictum erat illis de puero hoc.
tr: ιδοντες δε διεγνωρισαν περι του ρηματος του λαληθεντος αυτοις περι του παιδιου τουτου
kjv: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

vulg: et omnes qui audierunt mirati sunt et de his quae dicta erant a pastoribus ad ipsos
clem: Et omnes qui audierunt, mirati sunt: et de his qu dicta erant a pastoribus ad ipsos.
tr: και παντες οι ακουσαντες εθαυμασαν περι των λαληθεντων υπο των ποιμενων προς αυτους
kjv: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

vulg: Maria autem conservabat omnia verba haec conferens in corde suo
clem: Maria autem conservabat omnia verba hc, conferens in corde suo.
tr: η δε μαριαμ παντα συνετηρει τα ρηματα ταυτα συμβαλλουσα εν τη καρδια αυτης
kjv: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

vulg: et reversi sunt pastores glorificantes et laudantes Deum in omnibus quae audierant et viderant sicut dictum est ad illos
clem: Et reversi sunt pastores glorificantes et laudantes Deum in omnibus qu audierant et viderant, sicut dictum est ad illos.
tr: και επεστρεψαν οι ποιμενες δοξαζοντες και αινουντες τον θεον επι πασιν οις ηκουσαν και ειδον καθως ελαληθη προς αυτους
kjv: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

vulg: et postquam consummati sunt dies octo ut circumcideretur vocatum est nomen eius Iesus quod vocatum est ab angelo priusquam in utero conciperetur
clem: Et postquam consummati sunt dies octo, ut circumcideretur puer, vocatum est nomen ejus Jesus, quod vocatum est ab angelo priusquam in utero conciperetur.
tr: και οτε επλησθησαν ημεραι οκτω του περιτεμειν το παιδιον και εκληθη το ονομα αυτου ιησους το κληθεν υπο του αγγελου προ του συλληφθηναι αυτον εν τη κοιλια
kjv: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

vulg: et postquam impleti sunt dies purgationis eius secundum legem Mosi tulerunt illum in Hierusalem ut sisterent eum Domino
clem: Et postquam impleti sunt dies purgationis ejus secundum legem Moysi, tulerunt illum in Jerusalem, ut sisterent eum Domino,
tr: και οτε επλησθησαν αι ημεραι του καθαρισμου αυτων  αυτης  κατα τον νομον μωσεως ανηγαγον αυτον εις ιεροσολυμα παραστησαι τω κυριω
kjv: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

vulg: sicut scriptum est in lege Domini quia omne masculinum adaperiens vulvam sanctum Domino vocabitur
clem: sicut scriptum est in lege Domini: Quia omne masculinum adaperiens vulvam, sanctum Domino vocabitur:
tr: καθως γεγραπται εν νομω κυριου οτι παν αρσεν διανοιγον μητραν αγιον τω κυριω κληθησεται
kjv: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

vulg: et ut darent hostiam secundum quod dictum est in lege Domini par turturum aut duos pullos columbarum
clem: et ut darent hostiam secundum quod dictum est in lege Domini, par turturum, aut duos pullos columbarum.
tr: και του δουναι θυσιαν κατα το ειρημενον εν νομω κυριου ζευγος τρυγονων η δυο νεοσσους περιστερων
kjv: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

vulg: et ecce homo erat in Hierusalem cui nomen Symeon et homo iste iustus et timoratus expectans consolationem Israhel et Spiritus Sanctus erat in eo
clem: Et ecce homo erat in Jerusalem, cui nomen Simeon, et homo iste justus, et timoratus, exspectans consolationem Isral: et Spiritus Sanctus erat in eo.
tr: και ιδου ην ανθρωπος εν ιερουσαλημ ω ονομα συμεων  σιμεων  και ο ανθρωπος ουτος δικαιος και ευλαβης προσδεχομενος παρακλησιν του ισραηλ και πνευμα αγιον ην επ αυτον
kjv: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

vulg: et responsum acceperat ab Spiritu Sancto non visurum se mortem nisi prius videret Christum Domini
clem: Et responsum acceperat a Spiritu Sancto, non visurum se mortem, nisi prius videret Christum Domini.
tr: και ην αυτω κεχρηματισμενον υπο του πνευματος του αγιου μη ιδειν θανατον πριν η ιδη τον χριστον κυριου
kjv: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

vulg: et venit in Spiritu in templum et cum inducerent puerum Iesum parentes eius ut facerent secundum consuetudinem legis pro eo
clem: Et venit in spiritu in templum. Et cum inducerent puerum Jesum parentes ejus, ut facerent secundum consuetudinem legis pro eo,
tr: και ηλθεν εν τω πνευματι εις το ιερον και εν τω εισαγαγειν τους γονεις το παιδιον ιησουν του ποιησαι αυτους κατα το ειθισμενον του νομου περι αυτου
kjv: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

vulg: et ipse accepit eum in ulnas suas et benedixit Deum et dixit
clem: et ipse accepit eum in ulnas suas: et benedixit Deum, et dixit:
tr: και αυτος εδεξατο αυτο εις τας αγκαλας αυτου και ευλογησεν τον θεον και ειπεν
kjv: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

vulg: nunc dimittis servum tuum Domine secundum verbum tuum in pace
clem: [Nunc dimittis servum tuum Domine, secundum verbum tuum in pace:
tr: νυν απολυεις τον δουλον σου δεσποτα κατα το ρημα σου εν ειρηνη
kjv: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:

vulg: quia viderunt oculi mei salutare tuum
clem: quia viderunt oculi mei salutare tuum,
tr: οτι ειδον οι οφθαλμοι μου το σωτηριον σου
kjv: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

vulg: quod parasti ante faciem omnium populorum
clem: quod parasti ante faciem omnium populorum:
tr: ο ητοιμασας κατα προσωπον παντων των λαων
kjv: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;

vulg: lumen ad revelationem gentium et gloriam plebis tuae Israhel
clem: lumen ad revelationem gentium, et gloriam plebis tu Isral.]
tr: φως εις αποκαλυψιν εθνων και δοξαν λαου σου ισραηλ
kjv: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

vulg: et erat pater eius et mater mirantes super his quae dicebantur de illo
clem: Et erat pater ejus et mater mirantes super his qu dicebantur de illo.
tr: και ην ιωσηφ και η μητηρ αυτου θαυμαζοντες επι τοις λαλουμενοις περι αυτου
kjv: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

vulg: et benedixit illis Symeon et dixit ad Mariam matrem eius ecce positus est hic in ruinam et resurrectionem multorum in Israhel et in signum cui contradicetur
clem: Et benedixit illis Simeon, et dixit ad Mariam matrem ejus: Ecce positus est hic in ruinam et in resurrectionem multorum in Isral, et in signum cui contradicetur:
tr: και ευλογησεν αυτους συμεων  σιμεων  και ειπεν προς μαριαμ την μητερα αυτου ιδου ουτος κειται εις πτωσιν και αναστασιν πολλων εν τω ισραηλ και εις σημειον αντιλεγομενον
kjv: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

vulg: et tuam ipsius animam pertransiet gladius ut revelentur ex multis cordibus cogitationes
clem: et tuam ipsius animam pertransibit gladius ut revelentur ex multis cordibus cogitationes.
tr: και σου δε αυτης την ψυχην διελευσεται ρομφαια οπως αν αποκαλυφθωσιν εκ πολλων καρδιων διαλογισμοι
kjv: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

vulg: et erat Anna prophetissa filia Phanuhel de tribu Aser haec processerat in diebus multis et vixerat cum viro suo annis septem a virginitate sua
clem: Et erat Anna prophetissa, filia Phanuel, de tribu Aser: hc processerat in diebus multis, et vixerat cum viro suo annis septem a virginitate sua.
tr: και ην αννα προφητις θυγατηρ φανουηλ εκ φυλης ασηρ αυτη προβεβηκυια εν ημεραις πολλαις ζησασα ετη μετα ανδρος επτα απο της παρθενιας αυτης
kjv: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

vulg: et haec vidua usque ad annos octoginta quattuor quae non discedebat de templo ieiuniis et obsecrationibus serviens nocte ac die
clem: Et hc vidua usque ad annos octoginta quatuor: qu non discedebat de templo, jejuniis et obsecrationibus serviens nocte ac die.
tr: και αυτη χηρα ως ετων ογδοηκοντατεσσαρων η ουκ αφιστατο απο του ιερου νηστειαις και δεησεσιν λατρευουσα νυκτα και ημεραν
kjv: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.

vulg: et haec ipsa hora superveniens confitebatur Domino et loquebatur de illo omnibus qui expectabant redemptionem Hierusalem
clem: Et hc, ipsa hora superveniens, confitebatur Domino: et loquebatur de illo omnibus, qui exspectabant redemptionem Isral.
tr: και αυτη αυτη τη ωρα επιστασα ανθωμολογειτο τω κυριω και ελαλει περι αυτου πασιν τοις προσδεχομενοις λυτρωσιν εν ιερουσαλημ
kjv: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

vulg: et ut perfecerunt omnia secundum legem Domini reversi sunt in Galilaeam in civitatem suam Nazareth
clem: Et ut perfecerunt omnia secundum legem Domini, reversi sunt in Galilam in civitatem suam Nazareth.
tr: και ως ετελεσαν απαντα τα κατα τον νομον κυριου υπεστρεψαν εις την γαλιλαιαν εις την πολιν αυτων ναζαρετ  ναζαρεθ
kjv: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

vulg: puer autem crescebat et confortabatur plenus sapientia et gratia Dei erat in illo
clem: Puer autem crescebat, et confortabatur plenus sapientia: et gratia Dei erat in illo.
tr: το δε παιδιον ηυξανεν και εκραταιουτο πνευματι πληρουμενον σοφιας και χαρις θεου ην επ αυτο
kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

vulg: et ibant parentes eius per omnes annos in Hierusalem in die sollemni paschae
clem: Et ibant parentes ejus per omnes annos in Jerusalem, in die solemni Pasch.
tr: και επορευοντο οι γονεις αυτου κατ ετος εις ιερουσαλημ τη εορτη του πασχα
kjv: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

vulg: et cum factus esset annorum duodecim ascendentibus illis in Hierosolymam secundum consuetudinem diei festi
clem: Et cum factus esset annorum duodecim, ascendentibus illis Jerosolymam secundum consuetudinem diei festi,
tr: και οτε εγενετο ετων δωδεκα αναβαντων αυτων εις ιεροσολυμα κατα το εθος της εορτης
kjv: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

vulg: consummatisque diebus cum redirent remansit puer Iesus in Hierusalem et non cognoverunt parentes eius
clem: consummatisque diebus, cum redirent, remansit puer Jesus in Jerusalem, et non cognoverunt parentes ejus.
tr: και τελειωσαντων τας ημερας εν τω υποστρεφειν αυτους υπεμεινεν ιησους ο παις εν ιερουσαλημ και ουκ εγνω ιωσηφ και η μητηρ αυτου
kjv: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.

vulg: existimantes autem illum esse in comitatu venerunt iter diei et requirebant eum inter cognatos et notos
clem: Existimantes autem illum esse in comitatu, venerunt iter diei, et requirebant eum inter cognatos et notos.
tr: νομισαντες δε αυτον εν τη συνοδια ειναι ηλθον ημερας οδον και ανεζητουν αυτον εν τοις συγγενεσιν και εν τοις γνωστοις
kjv: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

vulg: et non invenientes regressi sunt in Hierusalem requirentes eum
clem: Et non invenientes, regressi sunt in Jerusalem, requirentes eum.
tr: και μη ευροντες αυτον υπεστρεψαν εις ιερουσαλημ ζητουντες αυτον
kjv: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

vulg: et factum est post triduum invenerunt illum in templo sedentem in medio doctorum audientem illos et interrogantem
clem: Et factum est, post triduum invenerunt illum in templo sedentem in medio doctorum, audientem illos, et interrogantem eos.
tr: και εγενετο μεθ ημερας τρεις ευρον αυτον εν τω ιερω καθεζομενον εν μεσω των διδασκαλων και ακουοντα αυτων και επερωτωντα αυτους
kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

vulg: stupebant autem omnes qui eum audiebant super prudentia et responsis eius
clem: Stupebant autem omnes qui eum audiebant, super prudentia et responsis ejus.
tr: εξισταντο δε παντες οι ακουοντες αυτου επι τη συνεσει και ταις αποκρισεσιν αυτου
kjv: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

vulg: et videntes admirati sunt et dixit mater eius ad illum fili quid fecisti nobis sic ecce pater tuus et ego dolentes quaerebamus te
clem: Et videntes admirati sunt. Et dixit mater ejus ad illum: Fili, quid fecisti nobis sic? ecce pater tuus et ego dolentes qurebamus te.
tr: και ιδοντες αυτον εξεπλαγησαν και προς αυτον η μητηρ αυτου ειπεν τεκνον τι εποιησας ημιν ουτως ιδου ο πατηρ σου καγω οδυνωμενοι εζητουμεν σε
kjv: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

vulg: et ait ad illos quid est quod me quaerebatis nesciebatis quia in his quae Patris mei sunt oportet me esse
clem: Et ait ad illos: Quid est quod me qurebatis? nesciebatis quia in his qu Patris mei sunt, oportet me esse?
tr: και ειπεν προς αυτους τι οτι εζητειτε με ουκ ηδειτε οτι εν τοις του πατρος μου δει ειναι με
kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?

vulg: et ipsi non intellexerunt verbum quod locutus est ad illos
clem: Et ipsi non intellexerunt verbum quod locutus est ad eos.
tr: και αυτοι ου συνηκαν το ρημα ο ελαλησεν αυτοις
kjv: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

vulg: et descendit cum eis et venit Nazareth et erat subditus illis et mater eius conservabat omnia verba haec in corde suo
clem: Et descendit cum eis, et venit Nazareth: et erat subditus illis. Et mater ejus conservabat omnia verba hc in corde suo.
tr: και κατεβη μετ αυτων και ηλθεν εις ναζαρετ  ναζαρεθ  και ην υποτασσομενος αυτοις και η μητηρ αυτου διετηρει παντα τα ρηματα ταυτα εν τη καρδια αυτης
kjv: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

vulg: et Iesus proficiebat sapientia aetate et gratia apud Deum et homines
clem: Et Jesus proficiebat sapientia, et tate, et gratia apud Deum et homines.
tr: και ιησους προεκοπτεν σοφια και ηλικια και χαριτι παρα θεω και ανθρωποις
kjv: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

vulg: anno autem quintodecimo imperii Tiberii Caesaris procurante Pontio Pilato Iudaeam tetrarcha autem Galilaeae Herode Philippo autem fratre eius tetrarcha Itureae et Trachonitidis regionis et Lysania Abilinae tetrarcha
clem: Anno autem quintodecimo imperii Tiberii Csaris, procurante Pontio Pilato Judam, tetrarcha autem Gali Herode, Philippo autem fratre ejus tetrarcha Itur, et Trachonitidis regionis, et Lysania Abilin tetrarcha,
tr: εν ετει δε πεντεκαιδεκατω της ηγεμονιας τιβεριου καισαρος ηγεμονευοντος ποντιου πιλατου της ιουδαιας και τετραρχουντος της γαλιλαιας ηρωδου φιλιππου δε του αδελφου αυτου τετραρχουντος της ιτουραιας και τραχωνιτιδος χωρας και λυσανιου της αβιληνης τετραρχουντος
kjv: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

vulg: sub principibus sacerdotum Anna et Caiapha factum est verbum Dei super Iohannem Zacchariae filium in deserto
clem: sub principibus sacerdotum Anna et Caipha: factum est verbum Domini super Joannem, Zachari filium, in deserto.
tr: επ αρχιερεων αννα και καιαφα εγενετο ρημα θεου επι ιωαννην τον του ζαχαριου υιον εν τη ερημω
kjv: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

vulg: et venit in omnem regionem Iordanis praedicans baptismum paenitentiae in remissionem peccatorum
clem: Et venit in omnem regionem Jordanis, prdicans baptismum pnitenti in remissionem peccatorum,
tr: και ηλθεν εις πασαν την περιχωρον του ιορδανου κηρυσσων βαπτισμα μετανοιας εις αφεσιν αμαρτιων
kjv: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

vulg: sicut scriptum est in libro sermonum Esaiae prophetae vox clamantis in deserto parate viam Domini rectas facite semitas eius
clem: sicut scriptum est in libro sermonum Isai prophet: [Vox clamantis in deserto: Parate viam Domini; rectas facite semitas ejus:
tr: ως γεγραπται εν βιβλω λογων ησαιου του προφητου λεγοντος φωνη βοωντος εν τη ερημω ετοιμασατε την οδον κυριου ευθειας ποιειτε τας τριβους αυτου
kjv: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

vulg: omnis vallis implebitur et omnis mons et collis humiliabitur et erunt prava in directa et aspera in vias planas
clem: omnis vallis implebitur, et omnis mons, et collis humiliabitur: et erunt prava in directa, et aspera in vias planas:
tr: πασα φαραγξ πληρωθησεται και παν ορος και βουνος ταπεινωθησεται και εσται τα σκολια εις ευθειαν και αι τραχειαι εις οδους λειας
kjv: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;

vulg: et videbit omnis caro salutare Dei
clem: et videbit omnis caro salutare Dei.]
tr: και οψεται πασα σαρξ το σωτηριον του θεου
kjv: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

vulg: dicebat ergo ad turbas quae exiebant ut baptizarentur ab ipso genimina viperarum quis ostendit vobis fugere a ventura ira
clem: Dicebat ergo ad turbas qu exibant ut baptizarentur ab ipso: Genimina viperarum, quis ostendit vobis fugere a ventura ira?
tr: ελεγεν ουν τοις εκπορευομενοις οχλοις βαπτισθηναι υπ αυτου γεννηματα εχιδνων τις υπεδειξεν υμιν φυγειν απο της μελλουσης οργης
kjv: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

vulg: facite ergo fructus dignos paenitentiae et ne coeperitis dicere patrem habemus Abraham dico enim vobis quia potest Deus de lapidibus istis suscitare filios Abrahae
clem: Facite ergo fructus dignos pnitenti, et ne cperitis dicere: Patrem habemus Abraham. Dico enim vobis quia potens est Deus de lapidibus istis suscitare filios Abrah.
tr: ποιησατε ουν καρπους αξιους της μετανοιας και μη αρξησθε λεγειν εν εαυτοις πατερα εχομεν τον αβρααμ λεγω γαρ υμιν οτι δυναται ο θεος εκ των λιθων τουτων εγειραι τεκνα τω αβρααμ
kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

vulg: iam enim securis ad radicem arborum posita est omnis ergo arbor non faciens fructum exciditur et in ignem mittitur
clem: Jam enim securis ad radicem arborum posita est. Omnis ergo arbor non faciens fructum bonum, excidetur, et in ignem mittetur.
tr: ηδη δε και η αξινη προς την ριζαν των δενδρων κειται παν ουν δενδρον μη ποιουν καρπον καλον εκκοπτεται και εις πυρ βαλλεται
kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

vulg: et interrogabant eum turbae dicentes quid ergo faciemus
clem: Et interrogabant eum turb, dicentes: Quid ergo faciemus?
tr: και επηρωτων αυτον οι οχλοι λεγοντες τι ουν ποιησομεν
kjv: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

vulg: respondens autem dicebat illis qui habet duas tunicas det non habenti et qui habet escas similiter faciat
clem: Respondens autem dicebat illis: Qui habet duas tunicas, det non habenti: et qui habet escas, similiter faciat.
tr: αποκριθεις δε λεγει αυτοις ο εχων δυο χιτωνας μεταδοτω τω μη εχοντι και ο εχων βρωματα ομοιως ποιειτω
kjv: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

vulg: venerunt autem et publicani ut baptizarentur et dixerunt ad illum magister quid faciemus
clem: Venerunt autem et publicani ut baptizarentur, et dixerunt ad illum: Magister, quid faciemus?
tr: ηλθον δε και τελωναι βαπτισθηναι και ειπον προς αυτον διδασκαλε τι ποιησομεν
kjv: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?

vulg: at ille dixit ad eos nihil amplius quam quod constitutum est vobis faciatis
clem: At ille dixit ad eos: Nihil amplius, quam quod constitutum est vobis, faciatis.
tr: ο δε ειπεν προς αυτους μηδεν πλεον παρα το διατεταγμενον υμιν πρασσετε
kjv: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.

vulg: interrogabant autem eum et milites dicentes quid faciemus et nos et ait illis neminem concutiatis neque calumniam faciatis et contenti estote stipendiis vestris
clem: Interrogabant autem eum et milites, dicentes: Quid faciemus et nos? Et ait illis: Neminem concutiatis, neque calumniam faciatis: et contenti estote stipendiis vestris.
tr: επηρωτων δε αυτον και στρατευομενοι λεγοντες και ημεις τι ποιησομεν και ειπεν προς αυτους μηδενα διασεισητε μηδε συκοφαντησητε και αρκεισθε τοις οψωνιοις υμων
kjv: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.

vulg: existimante autem populo et cogitantibus omnibus in cordibus suis de Iohanne ne forte ipse esset Christus
clem: Existimante autem populo, et cogitantibus omnibus in cordibus suis de Joanne, ne forte ipse esset Christus,
tr: προσδοκωντος δε του λαου και διαλογιζομενων παντων εν ταις καρδιαις αυτων περι του ιωαννου μηποτε αυτος ειη ο χριστος
kjv: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;

vulg: respondit Iohannes dicens omnibus ego quidem aqua baptizo vos venit autem fortior me cuius non sum dignus solvere corrigiam calciamentorum eius ipse vos baptizabit in Spiritu Sancto et igni
clem: respondit Joannes, dicens omnibus: Ego quidem aqua baptizo vos: veniet autem fortior me, cujus non sum dignus solvere corrigiam calceamentorum ejus: ipse vos baptizabit in Spiritu Sancto et igni:
tr: απεκρινατο ο ιωαννης απασιν λεγων εγω μεν υδατι βαπτιζω υμας ερχεται δε ο ισχυροτερος μου ου ουκ ειμι ικανος λυσαι τον ιμαντα των υποδηματων αυτου αυτος υμας βαπτισει εν πνευματι αγιω και πυρι
kjv: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:

vulg: cuius ventilabrum in manu eius et purgabit aream suam et congregabit triticum in horreum suum paleas autem conburet igni inextinguibili
clem: cujus ventilabrum in manu ejus, et purgabit aream suam, et congregabit triticum in horreum suum, paleas autem comburet igni inextinguibili.
tr: ου το πτυον εν τη χειρι αυτου και διακαθαριει την αλωνα αυτου και συναξει τον σιτον εις την αποθηκην αυτου το δε αχυρον κατακαυσει πυρι ασβεστω
kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

vulg: multa quidem et alia exhortans evangelizabat populum
clem: Multa quidem et alia exhortans evangelizabat populo.
tr: πολλα μεν ουν και ετερα παρακαλων ευηγγελιζετο τον λαον
kjv: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.

vulg: Herodes autem tetrarcha cum corriperetur ab illo de Herodiade uxore fratris sui et de omnibus malis quae fecit Herodes
clem: Herodes autem tetrarcha cum corriperetur ab illo de Herodiade uxore fratris sui, et de omnibus malis qu fecit Herodes,
tr: ο δε ηρωδης ο τετραρχης ελεγχομενος υπ αυτου περι ηρωδιαδος της γυναικος φιλιππου του αδελφου αυτου και περι παντων ων εποιησεν πονηρων ο ηρωδης
kjv: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

vulg: adiecit et hoc supra omnia et inclusit Iohannem in carcere
clem: adjecit et hoc super omnia, et inclusit Joannem in carcere.
tr: προσεθηκεν και τουτο επι πασιν και κατεκλεισεν τον ιωαννην εν τη φυλακη
kjv: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.

vulg: factum est autem cum baptizaretur omnis populus et Iesu baptizato et orante apertum est caelum
clem: Factum est autem cum baptizaretur omnis populus, et Jesu baptizato, et orante, apertum est clum:
tr: εγενετο δε εν τω βαπτισθηναι απαντα τον λαον και ιησου βαπτισθεντος και προσευχομενου ανεωχθηναι τον ουρανον
kjv: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,

vulg: et descendit Spiritus Sanctus corporali specie sicut columba in ipsum et vox de caelo facta est tu es Filius meus dilectus in te conplacuit mihi
clem: et descendit Spiritus Sanctus corporali specie sicut columba in ipsum: et vox de clo facta est: Tu es filius meus dilectus, in te complacui mihi.
tr: και καταβηναι το πνευμα το αγιον σωματικω ειδει ωσει περιστεραν επ αυτον και φωνην εξ ουρανου γενεσθαι λεγουσαν συ ει ο υιος μου ο αγαπητος εν σοι ηυδοκησα
kjv: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

vulg: et ipse Iesus erat incipiens quasi annorum triginta ut putabatur filius Ioseph qui fuit Heli
clem: Et ipse Jesus erat incipiens quasi annorum triginta, ut putabatur, filius Joseph, qui fuit Heli, qui fuit Mathat,
tr: και αυτος ην ο ιησους ωσει ετων τριακοντα αρχομενος ων ως ενομιζετο υιος ιωσηφ του ηλι
kjv: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,

vulg: qui fuit Matthat qui fuit Levi qui fuit Melchi qui fuit Iannae qui fuit Ioseph
clem: qui fuit Levi, qui fuit Melchi, qui fuit Janne, qui fuit Joseph,
tr: του ματθατ του λευι του μελχι του ιαννα του ιωσηφ
kjv: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,

vulg: qui fuit Matthathiae qui fuit Amos qui fuit Naum qui fuit Esli qui fuit Naggae
clem: qui fuit Mathathi, qui fuit Amos, qui fuit Nahum, qui fuit Hesli, qui fuit Nagge,
tr: του ματταθιου του αμως του ναουμ του εσλι του ναγγαι
kjv: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,

vulg: qui fuit Maath qui fuit Matthathiae qui fuit Semei qui fuit Iosech qui fuit Ioda
clem: qui fuit Mahath, qui fuit Mathathi, qui fuit Semei, qui fuit Joseph, qui fuit Juda,
tr: του μααθ του ματταθιου του σεμει του ιωσηφ του ιουδα
kjv: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,

vulg: qui fuit Iohanna qui fuit Resa qui fuit Zorobabel qui fuit Salathihel qui fuit Neri
clem: qui fuit Joanna, qui fuit Resa, qui fuit Zorobabel, qui fuit Salatheil, qui fuit Neri,
tr: του ιωαννα του ρησα του ζοροβαβελ του σαλαθιηλ του νηρι
kjv: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,

vulg: qui fuit Melchi qui fuit Addi qui fuit Cosam qui fuit Helmadam qui fuit Her
clem: qui fuit Melchi, qui fuit Addi, qui fuit Cosan, qui fuit Elmadan, qui fuit Her,
tr: του μελχι του αδδι του κωσαμ του ελμωδαμ του ηρ
kjv: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,

vulg: qui fuit Iesu qui fuit Eliezer qui fuit Iorim qui fuit Matthat qui fuit Levi
clem: qui fuit Jesu, qui fuit Eliezer, qui fuit Jorim, qui fuit Mathat, qui fuit Levi,
tr: του ιωση του ελιεζερ του ιωρειμ του ματθατ του λευι
kjv: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,

vulg: qui fuit Symeon qui fuit Iuda qui fuit Ioseph qui fuit Iona qui fuit Eliachim
clem: qui fuit Simeon, qui fuit Juda, qui fuit Joseph, qui fuit Jona, qui fuit Eliakim,
tr: του συμεων  σιμεων  του ιουδα του ιωσηφ του ιωναν του ελιακειμ
kjv: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,

vulg: qui fuit Melea qui fuit Menna qui fuit Matthata qui fuit Nathan qui fuit David
clem: qui fuit Melea, qui fuit Menna, qui fuit Mathatha, qui fuit Natham, qui fuit David,
tr: του μελεα του μαιναν  μεναμ 0   του ματταθα του ναθαν του δαβιδ
kjv: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,

vulg: qui fuit Iesse qui fuit Obed qui fuit Booz qui fuit Salmon qui fuit Naasson
clem: qui fuit Jesse, qui fuit Obed, qui fuit Booz, qui fuit Salmon, qui fuit Naasson,
tr: του ιεσσαι του ωβηδ του βοοζ του σαλμων του ναασσων
kjv: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,

vulg: qui fuit Aminadab qui fuit Aram qui fuit Esrom qui fuit Phares qui fuit Iudae
clem: qui fuit Aminadab, qui fuit Aram, qui fuit Esron, qui fuit Phares, qui fuit Jud,
tr: του αμιναδαβ του αραμ του εσρωμ του φαρες του ιουδα
kjv: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,

vulg: qui fuit Iacob qui fuit Isaac qui fuit Abraham qui fuit Thare qui fuit Nachor
clem: qui fuit Jacob, qui fuit Isaac, qui fuit Abrah, qui fuit Thare, qui fuit Nachor,
tr: του ιακωβ του ισαακ του αβρααμ του θαρα του ναχωρ
kjv: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,

vulg: qui fuit Seruch qui fuit Ragau qui fuit Phalec qui fuit Eber qui fuit Sale
clem: qui fuit Sarug, qui fuit Ragau, qui fuit Phaleg, qui fuit Heber, qui fuit Sale,
tr: του σαρουχ του ραγαυ του φαλεκ του εβερ του σαλα
kjv: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,

vulg: qui fuit Cainan qui fuit Arfaxat qui fuit Sem qui fuit Noe qui fuit Lamech
clem: qui fuit Cainan, qui fuit Arphaxad, qui fuit Sem, qui fuit No, qui fuit Lamech,
tr: του καιναν του αρφαξαδ του σημ του νωε του λαμεχ
kjv: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,

vulg: qui fuit Mathusalae qui fuit Enoch qui fuit Iared qui fuit Malelehel qui fuit Cainan
clem: qui fuit Methusale, qui fuit Henoch, qui fuit Jared, qui fuit Malaleel, qui fuit Cainan,
tr: του μαθουσαλα του ενωχ του ιαρεδ του μαλελεηλ του καιναν
kjv: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,

vulg: qui fuit Enos qui fuit Seth qui fuit Adam qui fuit Dei
clem: qui fuit Henos, qui fuit Seth, qui fuit Adam, qui fuit Dei.
tr: του ενως του σηθ του αδαμ του θεου
kjv: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.

vulg: Iesus autem plenus Spiritu Sancto regressus est ab Iordane et agebatur in Spiritu in desertum
clem: Jesus autem plenus Spiritu Sancto regressus est a Jordane: et agebatur a Spiritu in desertum
tr: ιησους δε πνευματος αγιου πληρης υπεστρεψεν απο του ιορδανου και ηγετο εν τω πνευματι εις την ερημον
kjv: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

vulg: diebus quadraginta et temptabatur a diabolo et nihil manducavit in diebus illis et consummatis illis esuriit
clem: diebus quadraginta, et tentabatur a diabolo. Et nihil manducavit in diebus illis: et consummatis illis esuriit.
tr: ημερας τεσσαρακοντα πειραζομενος υπο του διαβολου και ουκ εφαγεν ουδεν εν ταις ημεραις εκειναις και συντελεσθεισων αυτων υστερον επεινασεν
kjv: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.

vulg: dixit autem illi diabolus si Filius Dei es dic lapidi huic ut panis fiat
clem: Dixit autem illi diabolus: Si Filius Dei es, dic lapidi huic ut panis fiat.
tr: και ειπεν αυτω ο διαβολος ει υιος ει του θεου ειπε τω λιθω τουτω ινα γενηται αρτος
kjv: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.

vulg: et respondit ad illum Iesus scriptum est quia non in pane solo vivet homo sed in omni verbo Dei
clem: Et respondit ad illum Jesus: Scriptum est: Quia non in solo pane vivit homo, sed in omni verbo Dei.
tr: και απεκριθη ιησους προς αυτον λεγων γεγραπται οτι ουκ επ αρτω μονω ζησεται ο ανθρωπος αλλ επι παντι ρηματι θεου
kjv: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

vulg: et duxit illum diabolus et ostendit illi omnia regna orbis terrae in momento temporis
clem: Et duxit illum diabolus in montem excelsum, et ostendit illi omnia regna orbis terr in momento temporis,
tr: και αναγαγων αυτον ο διαβολος εις ορος υψηλον εδειξεν αυτω πασας τας βασιλειας της οικουμενης εν στιγμη χρονου
kjv: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

vulg: et ait ei tibi dabo potestatem hanc universam et gloriam illorum quia mihi tradita sunt et cui volo do illa
clem: et ait illi: Tibi dabo potestatem hanc universam, et gloriam illorum: quia mihi tradita sunt, et cui volo do illa.
tr: και ειπεν αυτω ο διαβολος σοι δωσω την εξουσιαν ταυτην απασαν και την δοξαν αυτων οτι εμοι παραδεδοται και ω εαν θελω διδωμι αυτην
kjv: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.

vulg: tu ergo si adoraveris coram me erunt tua omnia
clem: Tu ergo si adoraveris coram me, erunt tua omnia.
tr: συ ουν εαν προσκυνησης ενωπιον μου εσται σου παντα
kjv: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.

vulg: et respondens Iesus dixit illi scriptum est Dominum Deum tuum adorabis et illi soli servies
clem: Et respondens Jesus, dixit illi: Scriptum est: Dominum Deum tuum adorabis, et illi soli servies.
tr: και αποκριθεις αυτω ειπεν ο ιησους υπαγε οπισω μου σατανα γεγραπται γαρ προσκυνησεις κυριον τον θεον σου και αυτω μονω λατρευσεις
kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

vulg: et duxit illum in Hierusalem et statuit eum supra pinnam templi et dixit illi si Filius Dei es mitte te hinc deorsum
clem: Et duxit illum in Jerusalem, et statuit eum super pinnam templi, et dixit illi: Si Filius Dei es, mitte te hinc deorsum.
tr: και ηγαγεν αυτον εις ιερουσαλημ και εστησεν αυτον επι το πτερυγιον του ιερου και ειπεν αυτω ει ο υιος ει του θεου βαλε σεαυτον εντευθεν κατω
kjv: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:

vulg: scriptum est enim quod angelis suis mandabit de te ut conservent te
clem: Scriptum est enim quod angelis suis mandavit de te, ut conservent te:
tr: γεγραπται γαρ οτι τοις αγγελοις αυτου εντελειται περι σου του διαφυλαξαι σε
kjv: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:

vulg: et quia in manibus tollent te ne forte offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum
clem: et quia in manibus tollent te, ne forte offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum.
tr: και οτι επι χειρων αρουσιν σε μηποτε προσκοψης προς λιθον τον ποδα σου
kjv: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

vulg: et respondens Iesus ait illi dictum est non temptabis Dominum Deum tuum
clem: Et respondens Jesus, ait illi: Dictum est: Non tentabis Dominum Deum tuum.
tr: και αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτω ο ιησους οτι ειρηται ουκ εκπειρασεις κυριον τον θεον σου
kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

vulg: et consummata omni temptatione diabolus recessit ab illo usque ad tempus
clem: Et consummata omni tentatione, diabolus recessit ab illo, usque ad tempus.
tr: και συντελεσας παντα πειρασμον ο διαβολος απεστη απ αυτου αχρι καιρου
kjv: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.

vulg: et regressus est Iesus in virtute Spiritus in Galilaeam et fama exiit per universam regionem de illo
clem: Et regressus est Jesus in virtute Spiritus in Galilam, et fama exiit per universam regionem de illo.
tr: και υπεστρεψεν ο ιησους εν τη δυναμει του πνευματος εις την γαλιλαιαν και φημη εξηλθεν καθ ολης της περιχωρου περι αυτου
kjv: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.

vulg: et ipse docebat in synagogis eorum et magnificabatur ab omnibus
clem: Et ipse docebat in synagogis eorum, et magnificabatur ab omnibus.
tr: και αυτος εδιδασκεν εν ταις συναγωγαις αυτων δοξαζομενος υπο παντων
kjv: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

vulg: et venit Nazareth ubi erat nutritus et intravit secundum consuetudinem suam die sabbati in synagogam et surrexit legere
clem: Et venit Nazareth, ubi erat nutritus, et intravit secundum consuetudinem suam die sabbati in synagogam, et surrexit legere.
tr: και ηλθεν εις την ναζαρετ  ναζαρεθ  ου ην τεθραμμενος και εισηλθεν κατα το ειωθος αυτω εν τη ημερα των σαββατων εις την συναγωγην και ανεστη αναγνωναι
kjv: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

vulg: et traditus est illi liber prophetae Esaiae et ut revolvit librum invenit locum ubi scriptum erat
clem: Et traditus est illi liber Isai prophet. Et ut revolvit librum, invenit locum ubi scriptum erat:
tr: και επεδοθη αυτω βιβλιον ησαιου του προφητου και αναπτυξας το βιβλιον ευρεν τον τοπον ου ην γεγραμμενον
kjv: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

vulg: Spiritus Domini super me propter quod unxit me evangelizare pauperibus misit me
clem: Spiritus Domini super me: propter quod unxit me, evangelizare pauperibus misit me, sanare contritos corde,
tr: πνευμα κυριου επ εμε ου ενεκεν εχρισεν με ευαγγελιζεσθαι πτωχοις απεσταλκεν με ιασασθαι τους συντετριμμενους την καρδιαν κηρυξαι αιχμαλωτοις αφεσιν και τυφλοις αναβλεψιν αποστειλαι τεθραυσμενους εν αφεσει
kjv: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

vulg: praedicare captivis remissionem et caecis visum dimittere confractos in remissionem praedicare annum Domini acceptum et diem retributionis
clem: prdicare captivis remissionem, et ccis visum, dimittere confractos in remissionem, prdicare annum Domini acceptum et diem retributioni.
tr: κηρυξαι ενιαυτον κυριου δεκτον
kjv: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

vulg: et cum plicuisset librum reddidit ministro et sedit et omnium in synagoga oculi erant intendentes in eum
clem: Et cum plicuisset librum, reddit ministro, et sedit. Et omnium in synagoga oculi erant intendentes in eum.
tr: και πτυξας το βιβλιον αποδους τω υπηρετη εκαθισεν και παντων εν τη συναγωγη οι οφθαλμοι ησαν ατενιζοντες αυτω
kjv: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

vulg: coepit autem dicere ad illos quia hodie impleta est haec scriptura in auribus vestris
clem: Cpit autem dicere ad illos: Quia hodie impleta est hc scriptura in auribus vestris.
tr: ηρξατο δε λεγειν προς αυτους οτι σημερον πεπληρωται η γραφη αυτη εν τοις ωσιν υμων
kjv: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.

vulg: et omnes testimonium illi dabant et mirabantur in verbis gratiae quae procedebant de ore ipsius et dicebant nonne hic filius est Ioseph
clem: Et omnes testimonium illi dabant: et mirabantur in verbis grati, qu procedebant de ore ipsius, et dicebant: Nonne hic est filius Joseph?
tr: και παντες εμαρτυρουν αυτω και εθαυμαζον επι τοις λογοις της χαριτος τοις εκπορευομενοις εκ του στοματος αυτου και ελεγον ουχ ουτος εστιν ο υιος ιωσηφ
kjv: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?

vulg: et ait illis utique dicetis mihi hanc similitudinem medice cura te ipsum quanta audivimus facta in Capharnaum fac et hic in patria tua
clem: Et ait illis: Utique dicetis mihi hanc similitudinem: Medice cura teipsum: quanta audivimus facta in Capharnaum, fac et hic in patria tua.
