tr: και ειπεν προς αυτους παντως ερειτε μοι την παραβολην ταυτην ιατρε θεραπευσον σεαυτον οσα ηκουσαμεν γενομενα εν τη καπερναουμ ποιησον και ωδε εν τη πατριδι σου
kjv: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.

vulg: ait autem amen dico vobis quia nemo propheta acceptus est in patria sua
clem: Ait autem: Amen dico vobis, quia nemo propheta acceptus est in patria sua.
tr: ειπεν δε αμην λεγω υμιν οτι ουδεις προφητης δεκτος εστιν εν τη πατριδι αυτου
kjv: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.

vulg: in veritate dico vobis multae viduae erant in diebus Heliae in Israhel quando clusum est caelum annis tribus et mensibus sex cum facta est fames magna in omni terra
clem: In veritate dico vobis, mult vidu erant in diebus Eli in Isral, quando clausum est clum annis tribus et mensibus sex, cum facta esset fames magna in omni terra:
tr: επ αληθειας δε λεγω υμιν πολλαι χηραι ησαν εν ταις ημεραις ηλιου εν τω ισραηλ οτε εκλεισθη ο ουρανος επι ετη τρια και μηνας εξ ως εγενετο λιμος μεγας επι πασαν την γην
kjv: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

vulg: et ad nullam illarum missus est Helias nisi in Sareptha Sidoniae ad mulierem viduam
clem: et ad nullam illarum missus est Elias, nisi in Sarepta Sidoni, ad mulierem viduam.
tr: και προς ουδεμιαν αυτων επεμφθη ηλιας ει μη εις σαρεπτα της σιδωνος προς γυναικα χηραν
kjv: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.

vulg: et multi leprosi erant in Israhel sub Heliseo propheta et nemo eorum mundatus est nisi Neman Syrus
clem: Et multi leprosi erant in Isral sub Eliso propheta: et nemo eorum mundatus est nisi Naaman Syrus.
tr: και πολλοι λεπροι ησαν επι ελισσαιου του προφητου εν τω ισραηλ και ουδεις αυτων εκαθαρισθη ει μη νεεμαν ο συρος
kjv: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

vulg: et repleti sunt omnes in synagoga ira haec audientes
clem: Et repleti sunt omnes in synagoga ira, hc audientes.
tr: και επλησθησαν παντες θυμου εν τη συναγωγη ακουοντες ταυτα
kjv: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,

vulg: et surrexerunt et eiecerunt illum extra civitatem et duxerunt illum usque ad supercilium montis supra quem civitas illorum erat aedificata ut praecipitarent eum
clem: Et surrexerunt, et ejecerunt illum extra civitatem: et duxerunt illum usque ad supercilium montis, super quem civitas illorum erat dificata, ut prcipitarent eum.
tr: και ανασταντες εξεβαλον αυτον εξω της πολεως και ηγαγον αυτον εως της οφρυος του ορους εφ ου η πολις αυτων ωκοδομητο εις το κατακρημνισαι αυτον
kjv: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.

vulg: ipse autem transiens per medium illorum ibat
clem: Ipse autem transiens per medium illorum, ibat.
tr: αυτος δε διελθων δια μεσου αυτων επορευετο
kjv: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,

vulg: et descendit in Capharnaum civitatem Galilaeae ibique docebat illos sabbatis
clem: Et descendit in Capharnaum civitatem Galil, ibique docebat illos sabbatis.
tr: και κατηλθεν εις καπερναουμ πολιν της γαλιλαιας και ην διδασκων αυτους εν τοις σαββασιν
kjv: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.

vulg: et stupebant in doctrina eius quia in potestate erat sermo ipsius
clem: Et stupebant in doctrina ejus, quia in potestate erat sermo ipsius.
tr: και εξεπλησσοντο επι τη διδαχη αυτου οτι εν εξουσια ην ο λογος αυτου
kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

vulg: et in synagoga erat homo habens daemonium inmundum et exclamavit voce magna
clem: Et in synagoga erat homo habens dmonium immundum, et exclamavit voce magna,
tr: και εν τη συναγωγη ην ανθρωπος εχων πνευμα δαιμονιου ακαθαρτου και ανεκραξεν φωνη μεγαλη
kjv: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,

vulg: dicens sine quid nobis et tibi Iesu Nazarene venisti perdere nos scio te qui sis Sanctus Dei
clem: dicens: Sine, quid nobis et tibi, Jesu Nazarene? venisti perdere nos? scio te quis sis, Sanctus Dei.
tr: λεγων εα τι ημιν και σοι ιησου ναζαρηνε ηλθες απολεσαι ημας οιδα σε τις ει ο αγιος του θεου
kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.

vulg: et increpavit illi Iesus dicens obmutesce et exi ab illo et cum proiecisset illum daemonium in medium exiit ab illo nihilque illum nocuit
clem: Et increpavit illum Jesus, dicens: Obmutesce, et exi ab eo. Et cum projecisset illum dmonium in medium, exiit ab illo, nihilque illum nocuit.
tr: και επετιμησεν αυτω ο ιησους λεγων φιμωθητι και εξελθε εξ αυτου και ριψαν αυτον το δαιμονιον εις το μεσον εξηλθεν απ αυτου μηδεν βλαψαν αυτον
kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.

vulg: et factus est pavor in omnibus et conloquebantur ad invicem dicentes quod est hoc verbum quia in potestate et virtute imperat inmundis spiritibus et exeunt
clem: Et factus est pavor in omnibus, et colloquebantur ad invicem, dicentes: Quod est hoc verbum, quia in potestate et virtute imperat immundis spiritibus, et exeunt?
tr: και εγενετο θαμβος επι παντας και συνελαλουν προς αλληλους λεγοντες τις ο λογος ουτος οτι εν εξουσια και δυναμει επιτασσει τοις ακαθαρτοις πνευμασιν και εξερχονται
kjv: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.

vulg: et divulgabatur fama de illo in omnem locum regionis
clem: Et divulgabatur fama de illo in omnem locum regionis.
tr: και εξεπορευετο ηχος περι αυτου εις παντα τοπον της περιχωρου
kjv: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.

vulg: surgens autem de synagoga introivit in domum Simonis socrus autem Simonis tenebatur magnis febribus et rogaverunt illum pro ea
clem: Surgens autem Jesus de synagoga, introivit in domum Simonis. Socrus autem Simonis tenebatur magnis febribus: et rogaverunt illum pro ea.
tr: αναστας δε εκ της συναγωγης εισηλθεν εις την οικιαν σιμωνος η πενθερα δε του σιμωνος ην συνεχομενη πυρετω μεγαλω και ηρωτησαν αυτον περι αυτης
kjv: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

vulg: et stans super illam imperavit febri et dimisit illam et continuo surgens ministrabat illis
clem: Et stans super illam imperavit febri: et dimisit illam. Et continuo surgens, ministrabat illis.
tr: και επιστας επανω αυτης επετιμησεν τω πυρετω και αφηκεν αυτην παραχρημα δε αναστασα διηκονει αυτοις
kjv: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.

vulg: cum sol autem occidisset omnes qui habebant infirmos variis languoribus ducebant illos ad eum at ille singulis manus inponens curabat eos
clem: Cum autem sol occidisset, omnes qui habebant infirmos variis languoribus, ducebant illos ad eum. At ille singulis manus imponens, curabat eos.
tr: δυνοντος δε του ηλιου παντες οσοι ειχον ασθενουντας νοσοις ποικιλαις ηγαγον αυτους προς αυτον ο δε ενι εκαστω αυτων τας χειρας επιθεις εθεραπευσεν αυτους
kjv: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

vulg: exiebant autem etiam daemonia a multis clamantia et dicentia quia tu es Filius Dei et increpans non sinebat ea loqui quia sciebant ipsum esse Christum
clem: Exibant autem dmonia a multis clamantia, et dicentia: Quia tu es Filius Dei: et increpans non sinebat ea loqui: quia sciebant ipsum esse Christum.
tr: εξηρχετο δε και δαιμονια απο πολλων κραζοντα και λεγοντα οτι συ ει ο χριστος ο υιος του θεου και επιτιμων ουκ εια αυτα λαλειν οτι ηδεισαν τον χριστον αυτον ειναι
kjv: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.

vulg: facta autem die egressus ibat in desertum locum et turbae requirebant eum et venerunt usque ad ipsum et detinebant illum ne discederet ab eis
clem: Facta autem die egressus ibat in desertum locum, et turb requirebant eum, et venerunt usque ad ipsum: et detinebant illum ne discederet ab eis.
tr: γενομενης δε ημερας εξελθων επορευθη εις ερημον τοπον και οι οχλοι εζητουν αυτον και ηλθον εως αυτου και κατειχον αυτον του μη πορευεσθαι απ αυτων
kjv: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.

vulg: quibus ille ait quia et aliis civitatibus oportet me evangelizare regnum Dei quia ideo missus sum
clem: Quibus ille ait: Quia et aliis civitatibus oportet me evangelizare regnum Dei: quia ideo missus sum.
tr: ο δε ειπεν προς αυτους οτι και ταις ετεραις πολεσιν ευαγγελισασθαι με δει την βασιλειαν του θεου οτι εις τουτο απεσταλμαι
kjv: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.

vulg: et erat praedicans in synagogis Galilaeae
clem: Et erat prdicans in synagogis Galil.
tr: και ην κηρυσσων εν ταις συναγωγαις της γαλιλαιας
kjv: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.

vulg: factum est autem cum turbae inruerent in eum ut audirent verbum Dei et ipse stabat secus stagnum Gennesareth
clem: Factum est autem, cum turb irruerunt in eum ut audirent verbum Dei, et ipse stabat secus stagnum Genesareth.
tr: εγενετο δε εν τω τον οχλον επικεισθαι αυτω του ακουειν τον λογον του θεου και αυτος ην εστως παρα την λιμνην γεννησαρετ
kjv: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

vulg: et vidit duas naves stantes secus stagnum piscatores autem descenderant et lavabant retia
clem: Et vidit duas naves stantes secus stagnum: piscatores autem descenderant, et lavabant retia.
tr: και ειδεν δυο πλοια εστωτα παρα την λιμνην οι δε αλιεις αποβαντες απ αυτων απεπλυναν τα δικτυα
kjv: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

vulg: ascendens autem in unam navem quae erat Simonis rogavit eum a terra reducere pusillum et sedens docebat de navicula turbas
clem: Ascendens autem in unam navim, qu erat Simonis, rogavit eum a terra reducere pusillum. Et sedens docebat de navicula turbas.
tr: εμβας δε εις εν των πλοιων ο ην του σιμωνος ηρωτησεν αυτον απο της γης επαναγαγειν ολιγον και καθισας εδιδασκεν εκ του πλοιου τους οχλους
kjv: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.

vulg: ut cessavit autem loqui dixit ad Simonem duc in altum et laxate retia vestra in capturam
clem: Ut cessavit autem loqui, dixit ad Simonem: Duc in altum, et laxate retia vestra in capturam.
tr: ως δε επαυσατο λαλων ειπεν προς τον σιμωνα επαναγαγε εις το βαθος και χαλασατε τα δικτυα υμων εις αγραν
kjv: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

vulg: et respondens Simon dixit illi praeceptor per totam noctem laborantes nihil cepimus in verbo autem tuo laxabo rete
clem: Et respondens Simon, dixit illi: Prceptor, per totam noctem laborantes nihil cepimus: in verbo autem tuo laxabo rete.
tr: και αποκριθεις ο σιμων ειπεν αυτω επιστατα δι ολης της νυκτος κοπιασαντες ουδεν ελαβομεν επι δε τω ρηματι σου χαλασω το δικτυον
kjv: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

vulg: et cum hoc fecissent concluserunt piscium multitudinem copiosam rumpebatur autem rete eorum
clem: Et cum hoc fecissent, concluserunt piscium multitudinem copiosam: rumpebatur autem rete eorum.
tr: και τουτο ποιησαντες συνεκλεισαν ιχθυων πληθος πολυ διερρηγνυτο δε το δικτυον αυτων
kjv: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.

vulg: et annuerunt sociis qui erant in alia navi ut venirent et adiuvarent eos et venerunt et impleverunt ambas naviculas ita ut mergerentur
clem: Et annuerunt sociis, qui erant in alia navi, ut venirent, et adjuvarent eos. Et venerunt, et impleverunt ambas naviculas, ita ut pene mergerentur.
tr: και κατενευσαν τοις μετοχοις τοις εν τω ετερω πλοιω του ελθοντας συλλαβεσθαι αυτοις και ηλθον και επλησαν αμφοτερα τα πλοια ωστε βυθιζεσθαι αυτα
kjv: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.

vulg: quod cum videret Simon Petrus procidit ad genua Iesu dicens exi a me quia homo peccator sum Domine
clem: Quod cum vidisset Simon Petrus, procidit ad genua Jesu, dicens: Exi a me, quia homo peccator sum, Domine.
tr: ιδων δε σιμων πετρος προσεπεσεν τοις γονασιν του ιησου λεγων εξελθε απ εμου οτι ανηρ αμαρτωλος ειμι κυριε
kjv: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

vulg: stupor enim circumdederat eum et omnes qui cum illo erant in captura piscium quam ceperant
clem: Stupor enim circumdederat eum, et omnes qui cum illo erant, in captura piscium, quam ceperant:
tr: θαμβος γαρ περιεσχεν αυτον και παντας τους συν αυτω επι τη αγρα των ιχθυων η συνελαβον
kjv: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:

vulg: similiter autem Iacobum et Iohannem filios Zebedaei qui erant socii Simonis et ait ad Simonem Iesus noli timere ex hoc iam homines eris capiens
clem: similiter autem Jacobum et Joannem, filios Zebedi, qui erunt socii Simonis. Et ait ad Simonem Jesus: Noli timere: ex hoc jam homines eris capiens.
tr: ομοιως δε και ιακωβον και ιωαννην υιους ζεβεδαιου οι ησαν κοινωνοι τω σιμωνι και ειπεν προς τον σιμωνα ο ιησους μη φοβου απο του νυν ανθρωπους εση ζωγρων
kjv: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.

vulg: et subductis ad terram navibus relictis omnibus secuti sunt illum
clem: Et subductis ad terram navibus, relictis omnibus, secuti sunt eum.
tr: και καταγαγοντες τα πλοια επι την γην αφεντες απαντα ηκολουθησαν αυτω
kjv: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.

vulg: et factum est cum esset in una civitatum et ecce vir plenus lepra et videns Iesum et procidens in faciem rogavit eum dicens Domine si vis potes me mundare
clem: Et factum est, cum esset in una civitatum, et ecce vir plenus lepra, et videns Jesum, et procidens in faciem, rogavit eum, dicens: Domine, si vis, potes me mundare.
tr: και εγενετο εν τω ειναι αυτον εν μια των πολεων και ιδου ανηρ πληρης λεπρας και ιδων τον ιησουν πεσων επι προσωπον εδεηθη αυτου λεγων κυριε εαν θελης δυνασαι με καθαρισαι
kjv: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

vulg: et extendens manum tetigit illum dicens volo mundare et confestim lepra discessit ab illo
clem: Et extendens manum, tetigit eum dicens: Volo: mundare. Et confestim lepra discessit ab illo.
tr: και εκτεινας την χειρα ηψατο αυτου ειπων θελω καθαρισθητι και ευθεως η λεπρα απηλθεν απ αυτου
kjv: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

vulg: et ipse praecepit illi ut nemini diceret sed vade ostende te sacerdoti et offer pro emundatione tua sicut praecepit Moses in testimonium illis
clem: Et ipse prcepit illi ut nemini diceret: sed, Vade, ostende te sacerdoti, et offer pro emundatione tua, sicut prcepit Moyses, in testimonium illis.
tr: και αυτος παρηγγειλεν αυτω μηδενι ειπειν αλλα απελθων δειξον σεαυτον τω ιερει και προσενεγκε περι του καθαρισμου σου καθως προσεταξεν μωσης εις μαρτυριον αυτοις
kjv: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

vulg: perambulabat autem magis sermo de illo et conveniebant turbae multae ut audirent et curarentur ab infirmitatibus suis
clem: Perambulabat autem magis sermo de illo: et conveniebant turb mult ut audirent, et curarentur ab infirmitatibus suis.
tr: διηρχετο δε μαλλον ο λογος περι αυτου και συνηρχοντο οχλοι πολλοι ακουειν και θεραπευεσθαι υπ αυτου απο των ασθενειων αυτων
kjv: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

vulg: ipse autem secedebat in deserto et orabat
clem: Ipse autem secedebat in desertum, et orabat.
tr: αυτος δε ην υποχωρων εν ταις ερημοις και προσευχομενος
kjv: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

vulg: et factum est in una dierum et ipse sedebat docens et erant Pharisaei sedentes et legis doctores qui venerant ex omni castello Galilaeae et Iudaeae et Hierusalem et virtus erat Domini ad sanandum eos
clem: Et factum est in una dierum, et ipse sedebat docens. Et erant pharisi sedentes, et legis doctores, qui venerunt ex omni castello Galil, et Jud, et Jerusalem: et virtus Domini erat ad sanandum eos.
tr: και εγενετο εν μια των ημερων και αυτος ην διδασκων και ησαν καθημενοι φαρισαιοι και νομοδιδασκαλοι οι ησαν εληλυθοτες εκ πασης κωμης της γαλιλαιας και ιουδαιας και ιερουσαλημ και δυναμις κυριου ην εις το ιασθαι αυτους
kjv: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

vulg: et ecce viri portantes in lecto hominem qui erat paralyticus et quaerebant eum inferre et ponere ante eum
clem: Et ecce viri portantes in lecto hominem, qui erat paralyticus: et qurebant eum inferre, et ponere ante eum.
tr: και ιδου ανδρες φεροντες επι κλινης ανθρωπον ος ην παραλελυμενος και εζητουν αυτον εισενεγκειν και θειναι ενωπιον αυτου
kjv: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.

vulg: et non invenientes qua parte illum inferrent prae turba ascenderunt supra tectum per tegulas submiserunt illum cum lecto in medium ante Iesum
clem: Et non invenientes qua parte illum inferrent pr turba, ascenderunt supra tectum, et per tegulas summiserunt eum cum lecto in medium ante Jesum.
tr: και μη ευροντες δια ποιας εισενεγκωσιν αυτον δια τον οχλον αναβαντες επι το δωμα δια των κεραμων καθηκαν αυτον συν τω κλινιδιω εις το μεσον εμπροσθεν του ιησου
kjv: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.

vulg: quorum fidem ut vidit dixit homo remittuntur tibi peccata tua
clem: Quorum fidem ut vidit, dixit: Homo, remittuntur tibi peccata tua.
tr: και ιδων την πιστιν αυτων ειπεν αυτω ανθρωπε αφεωνται σοι αι αμαρτιαι σου
kjv: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.

vulg: et coeperunt cogitare scribae et Pharisaei dicentes quis est hic qui loquitur blasphemias quis potest dimittere peccata nisi solus Deus
clem: Et cperunt cogitare scrib et pharisi, dicentes: Quis est hic, qui loquitur blasphemias? quis potest dimittere peccata, nisi solus Deus?
tr: και ηρξαντο διαλογιζεσθαι οι γραμματεις και οι φαρισαιοι λεγοντες τις εστιν ουτος ος λαλει βλασφημιας τις δυναται αφιεναι αμαρτιας ει μη μονος ο θεος
kjv: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

vulg: ut cognovit autem Iesus cogitationes eorum respondens dixit ad illos quid cogitatis in cordibus vestris
clem: Ut cognovit autem Jesus cogitationes eorum, respondens, dixit ad illos: Quid cogitatis in cordibus vestris?
tr: επιγνους δε ο ιησους τους διαλογισμους αυτων αποκριθεις ειπεν προς αυτους τι διαλογιζεσθε εν ταις καρδιαις υμων
kjv: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?

vulg: quid est facilius dicere dimittuntur tibi peccata an dicere surge et ambula
clem: Quid est facilius dicere: Dimittuntur tibi peccata: an dicere: Surge, et ambula?
tr: τι εστιν ευκοπωτερον ειπειν αφεωνται σοι αι αμαρτιαι σου η ειπειν εγειραι και περιπατει
kjv: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?

vulg: ut autem sciatis quia Filius hominis potestatem habet in terra dimittere peccata ait paralytico tibi dico surge tolle lectum tuum et vade in domum tuam
clem: Ut autem sciatis quia Filius hominis habet potestatem in terra dimittendi peccata, (ait paralytico) tibi dico, surge, tolle lectum tuum, et vade in domum tuam.
tr: ινα δε ειδητε οτι εξουσιαν εχει ο υιος του ανθρωπου επι της γης αφιεναι αμαρτιας ειπεν τω παραλελυμενω σοι λεγω εγειραι και αρας το κλινιδιον σου πορευου εις τον οικον σου
kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.

vulg: et confestim surgens coram illis tulit in quo iacebat et abiit in domum suam magnificans Deum
clem: Et confestim consurgens coram illis, tulit lectum in quo jacebat: et abiit in domum suam, magnificans Deum.
tr: και παραχρημα αναστας ενωπιον αυτων αρας εφ ω κατεκειτο απηλθεν εις τον οικον αυτου δοξαζων τον θεον
kjv: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.

vulg: et stupor adprehendit omnes et magnificabant Deum et repleti sunt timore dicentes quia vidimus mirabilia hodie
clem: Et stupor apprehendit omnes, et magnificabant Deum. Et repleti sunt timore, dicentes: Quia vidimus mirabilia hodie.
tr: και εκστασις ελαβεν απαντας και εδοξαζον τον θεον και επλησθησαν φοβου λεγοντες οτι ειδομεν παραδοξα σημερον
kjv: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.

vulg: et post haec exiit et vidit publicanum nomine Levi sedentem ad teloneum et ait illi sequere me
clem: Et post hc exiit, et vidit publicanum nomine Levi, sedentem ad telonium, et ait illi: Sequere me.
tr: και μετα ταυτα εξηλθεν και εθεασατο τελωνην ονοματι λευιν καθημενον επι το τελωνιον και ειπεν αυτω ακολουθει μοι
kjv: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.

vulg: et relictis omnibus surgens secutus est eum
clem: Et relictis omnibus, surgens secutus est eum.
tr: και καταλιπων απαντα αναστας ηκολουθησεν αυτω
kjv: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.

vulg: et fecit ei convivium magnum Levi in domo sua et erat turba multa publicanorum et aliorum qui cum illis erant discumbentes
clem: Et fecit ei convivium magnum Levi in domo sua: et erat turba multa publicanorum, et aliorum qui cum illis erant discumbentes.
tr: και εποιησεν δοχην μεγαλην ο λευις αυτω εν τη οικια αυτου και ην οχλος τελωνων πολυς και αλλων οι ησαν μετ αυτων κατακειμενοι
kjv: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.

vulg: et murmurabant Pharisaei et scribae eorum dicentes ad discipulos eius quare cum publicanis et peccatoribus manducatis et bibitis
clem: Et murmurabant pharisi et scrib eorum, dicentes ad discipulos ejus: Quare cum publicanis et peccatoribus manducatis et bibitis?
tr: και εγογγυζον οι γραμματεις αυτων και οι φαρισαιοι προς τους μαθητας αυτου λεγοντες δια τι μετα τελωνων και αμαρτωλων εσθιετε και πινετε
kjv: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?

vulg: et respondens Iesus dixit ad illos non egent qui sani sunt medico sed qui male habent
clem: Et respondens Jesus, dixit ad illos: Non egent qui sani sunt medico, sed qui male habent.
tr: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν προς αυτους ου χρειαν εχουσιν οι υγιαινοντες ιατρου αλλ οι κακως εχοντες
kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.

vulg: non veni vocare iustos sed peccatores in paenitentiam
clem: Non veni vocare justos, sed peccatores ad pnitentiam.
tr: ουκ εληλυθα καλεσαι δικαιους αλλα αμαρτωλους εις μετανοιαν
kjv: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

vulg: at illi dixerunt ad eum quare discipuli Iohannis ieiunant frequenter et obsecrationes faciunt similiter et Pharisaeorum tui autem edunt et bibunt
clem: At illi dixerunt ad eum: Quare discipuli Joannis jejunant frequenter, et obsecrationes faciunt, similiter et pharisorum: tui autem edunt et bibunt?
tr: οι δε ειπον προς αυτον δια τι οι μαθηται ιωαννου νηστευουσιν πυκνα και δεησεις ποιουνται ομοιως και οι των φαρισαιων οι δε σοι εσθιουσιν και πινουσιν
kjv: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?

vulg: quibus ipse ait numquid potestis filios sponsi dum cum illis est sponsus facere ieiunare
clem: Quibus ipse ait: Numquid potestis filios sponsi, dum cum illis est sponsus, facere jejunare?
tr: ο δε ειπεν προς αυτους μη δυνασθε τους υιους του νυμφωνος εν ω ο νυμφιος μετ αυτων εστιν ποιησαι νηστευειν
kjv: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

vulg: venient autem dies et cum ablatus fuerit ab illis sponsus tunc ieiunabunt in illis diebus
clem: Venient autem dies, cum ablatus fuerit ab illis sponsus: tunc jejunabunt in illis diebus.
tr: ελευσονται δε ημεραι και οταν απαρθη απ αυτων ο νυμφιος τοτε νηστευσουσιν εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις
kjv: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

vulg: dicebat autem et similitudinem ad illos quia nemo commissuram a vestimento novo inmittit in vestimentum vetus alioquin et novum rumpit et veteri non convenit commissura a novo
clem: Dicebat autem et similitudinem ad illos: Quia nemo commissuram a novo vestimento immittit in vestimentum vetus: alioquin et novum rumpit, et veteri non convenit commissura a novo.
tr: ελεγεν δε και παραβολην προς αυτους οτι ουδεις επιβλημα ιματιου καινου επιβαλλει επι ιματιον παλαιον ει δε μηγε και το καινον σχιζει και τω παλαιω ου συμφωνει επιβλημα το απο του καινου
kjv: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.

vulg: et nemo mittit vinum novum in utres veteres alioquin rumpet vinum novum utres et ipsum effundetur et utres peribunt
clem: Et nemo mittit vinum novum in utres veteres: alioquin rumpet vinum novum utres, et ipsum effundetur, et utres peribunt:
tr: και ουδεις βαλλει οινον νεον εις ασκους παλαιους ει δε μηγε ρηξει ο νεος οινος τους ασκους και αυτος εκχυθησεται και οι ασκοι απολουνται
kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.

vulg: sed vinum novum in utres novos mittendum est et utraque conservantur
clem: sed vinum novum in utres novos mittendum est, et utraque conservantur.
tr: αλλα οινον νεον εις ασκους καινους βλητεον και αμφοτεροι συντηρουνται
kjv: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.

vulg: et nemo bibens vetus statim vult novum dicit enim vetus melius est
clem: Et nemo bibens vetus, statim vult novum: dicit enim: Vetus melius est.
tr: και ουδεις πιων παλαιον ευθεως θελει νεον λεγει γαρ ο παλαιος χρηστοτερος εστιν
kjv: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.

vulg: factum est autem in sabbato secundoprimo cum transiret per sata vellebant discipuli eius spicas et manducabant confricantes manibus
clem: Factum est autem in sabbato secundo, primo, cum transiret per sata, vellebant discipuli ejus spicas, et manducabant confricantes manibus.
tr: εγενετο δε εν σαββατω δευτεροπρωτω διαπορευεσθαι αυτον δια των σποριμων και ετιλλον οι μαθηται αυτου τους σταχυας και ησθιον ψωχοντες ταις χερσιν
kjv: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

vulg: quidam autem Pharisaeorum dicebant illis quid facitis quod non licet in sabbatis
clem: Quidam autem pharisorum, dicebant illis: Quid facitis quod non licet in sabbatis?
tr: τινες δε των φαρισαιων ειπον αυτοις τι ποιειτε ο ουκ εξεστιν ποιειν εν τοις σαββασιν
kjv: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?

vulg: et respondens Iesus ad eos dixit nec hoc legistis quod fecit David cum esurisset ipse et qui cum eo erant
clem: Et respondens Jesus ad eos, dixit: Nec hoc legistis quod fecit David, cum esurisset ipse, et qui cum illo erant?
tr: και αποκριθεις προς αυτους ειπεν ο ιησους ουδε τουτο ανεγνωτε ο εποιησεν δαβιδ οποτε επεινασεν αυτος και οι μετ αυτου οντες
kjv: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;

vulg: quomodo intravit in domum Dei et panes propositionis sumpsit et manducavit et dedit his qui cum ipso erant quos non licet manducare nisi tantum sacerdotibus
clem: quomodo intravit in domum Dei, et panes propositionis sumpsit, et manducavit, et dedit his qui cum ipso erant: quos non licet manducare nisi tantum sacerdotibus?
tr: ως εισηλθεν εις τον οικον του θεου και τους αρτους της προθεσεως ελαβεν και εφαγεν και εδωκεν και τοις μετ αυτου ους ουκ εξεστιν φαγειν ει μη μονους τους ιερεις
kjv: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?

vulg: et dicebat illis quia dominus est Filius hominis etiam sabbati
clem: Et dicebat illis: Quia dominus est Filius hominis etiam sabbati.
tr: και ελεγεν αυτοις οτι κυριος εστιν ο υιος του ανθρωπου και του σαββατου
kjv: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

vulg: factum est autem et in alio sabbato ut intraret in synagogam et doceret et erat ibi homo et manus eius dextra erat arida
clem: Factum est autem in alio sabbato, ut intraret in synagogam, et doceret. Et erat ibi homo, et manus ejus dextra erat arida.
tr: εγενετο δε και εν ετερω σαββατω εισελθειν αυτον εις την συναγωγην και διδασκειν και ην εκει ανθρωπος και η χειρ αυτου η δεξια ην ξηρα
kjv: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.

vulg: observabant autem scribae et Pharisaei si in sabbato curaret ut invenirent accusare illum
clem: Observabant autem scrib et pharisi si in sabbato curaret, ut invenirent unde accusarent eum.
tr: παρετηρουν δε αυτον οι γραμματεις και οι φαρισαιοι ει εν τω σαββατω θεραπευσει ινα ευρωσιν κατηγοριαν αυτου
kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.

vulg: ipse vero sciebat cogitationes eorum et ait homini qui habebat manum aridam surge et sta in medium et surgens stetit
clem: Ipse vero sciebat cogitationes eorum: et ait homini qui habebat manum aridam: Surge, et sta in medium. Et surgens stetit.
tr: αυτος δε ηδει τους διαλογισμους αυτων και ειπεν τω ανθρωπω τω ξηραν εχοντι την χειρα εγειραι και στηθι εις το μεσον ο δε αναστας εστη
kjv: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.

vulg: ait autem ad illos Iesus interrogo vos si licet sabbato bene facere an male animam salvam facere an perdere
clem: Ait autem ad illos Jesus: Interrogo vos si licet sabbatis benefacere, an male: animam salvam facere, an perdere?
tr: ειπεν ουν ο ιησους προς αυτους επερωτησω υμας τι  τι  εξεστιν τοις σαββασιν αγαθοποιησαι η κακοποιησαι ψυχην σωσαι η απολεσαι
kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?

vulg: et circumspectis omnibus dixit homini extende manum tuam et extendit et restituta est manus eius
clem: Et circumspectis omnibus dixit homini: Extende manum tuam. Et extendit: et restituta est manus ejus.
tr: και περιβλεψαμενος παντας αυτους ειπεν τω ανθρωπω εκτεινον την χειρα σου ο δε εποιησεν ουτως και αποκατεσταθη η χειρ αυτου υγιης ως η αλλη
kjv: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

vulg: ipsi autem repleti sunt insipientia et conloquebantur ad invicem quidnam facerent Iesu
clem: Ipsi autem repleti sunt insipientia, et colloquebantur ad invicem, quidnam facerent Jesu.
tr: αυτοι δε επλησθησαν ανοιας και διελαλουν προς αλληλους τι αν ποιησειαν τω ιησου
kjv: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.

vulg: factum est autem in illis diebus exiit in montem orare et erat pernoctans in oratione Dei
clem: Factum est autem in illis diebus, exiit in montem orare, et erat pernoctans in oratione Dei.
tr: εγενετο δε εν ταις ημεραις ταυταις εξηλθεν εις το ορος προσευξασθαι και ην διανυκτερευων εν τη προσευχη του θεου
kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.

vulg: et cum dies factus esset vocavit discipulos suos et elegit duodecim ex ipsis quos et apostolos nominavit
clem: Et cum dies factus esset, vocavit discipulos suos: et elegit duodecim ex ipsis (quos et apostolos nominavit):
tr: και οτε εγενετο ημερα προσεφωνησεν τους μαθητας αυτου και εκλεξαμενος απ αυτων δωδεκα ους και αποστολους ωνομασεν
kjv: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;

vulg: Simonem quem cognominavit Petrum et Andream fratrem eius Iacobum et Iohannem Philippum et Bartholomeum
clem: Simonem, quem cognominavit Petrum, et Andream fratrem ejus, Jacobum, et Joannem, Philippum, et Bartholomum,
tr: σιμωνα ον και ωνομασεν πετρον και ανδρεαν τον αδελφον αυτου ιακωβον και ιωαννην φιλιππον και βαρθολομαιον
kjv: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,

vulg: Mattheum et Thomam Iacobum Alphei et Simonem qui vocatur Zelotes
clem: Matthum, et Thomam, Jacobum Alphi, et Simonem, qui vocatur Zelotes,
tr: ματθαιον και θωμαν ιακωβον τον του αλφαιου και σιμωνα τον καλουμενον ζηλωτην
kjv: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,

vulg: Iudam Iacobi et Iudam Scarioth qui fuit proditor
clem: et Judam Jacobi, et Judam Iscariotem, qui fuit proditor.
tr: ιουδαν ιακωβου και ιουδαν ισκαριωτην ος και εγενετο προδοτης
kjv: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.

vulg: et descendens cum illis stetit in loco campestri et turba discipulorum eius et multitudo copiosa plebis ab omni Iudaea et Hierusalem et maritimae Tyri et Sidonis
clem: Et descendens cum illis, stetit in loco campestri, et turba discipulorum ejus, et multitudo copiosa plebis ab omni Juda, et Jerusalem, et maritima, et Tyri, et Sidonis,
tr: και καταβας μετ αυτων εστη επι τοπου πεδινου και οχλος μαθητων αυτου και πληθος πολυ του λαου απο πασης της ιουδαιας και ιερουσαλημ και της παραλιου τυρου και σιδωνος οι ηλθον ακουσαι αυτου και ιαθηναι απο των νοσων αυτων
kjv: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

vulg: qui venerunt ut audirent eum et sanarentur a languoribus suis et qui vexabantur ab spiritibus inmundis curabantur
clem: qui venerant ut audirent eum, et sanarentur a languoribus suis. Et qui vexabantur a spiritibus immundis, curabantur.
tr: και οι οχλουμενοι υπο πνευματων ακαθαρτων και εθεραπευοντο
kjv: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.

vulg: et omnis turba quaerebant eum tangere quia virtus de illo exiebat et sanabat omnes
clem: Et omnis turba qurebat eum tangere: quia virtus de illo exibat, et sanabat omnes.
tr: και πας ο οχλος εζητει απτεσθαι αυτου οτι δυναμις παρ αυτου εξηρχετο και ιατο παντας
kjv: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.

vulg: et ipse elevatis oculis in discipulos suos dicebat beati pauperes quia vestrum est regnum Dei
clem: Et ipse elevatis oculis in discipulis suis, dicebat: Beati pauperes, quia vestrum est regnum Dei.
tr: και αυτος επαρας τους οφθαλμους αυτου εις τους μαθητας αυτου ελεγεν μακαριοι οι πτωχοι οτι υμετερα εστιν η βασιλεια του θεου
kjv: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.

vulg: beati qui nunc esuritis quia saturabimini beati qui nunc fletis quia ridebitis
clem: Beati qui nunc esuritis, quia saturabimini. Beati qui nunc fletis, quia ridebitis.
tr: μακαριοι οι πεινωντες νυν οτι χορτασθησεσθε μακαριοι οι κλαιοντες νυν οτι γελασετε
kjv: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.

vulg: beati eritis cum vos oderint homines et cum separaverint vos et exprobraverint et eiecerint nomen vestrum tamquam malum propter Filium hominis
clem: Beati eritis cum vos oderint homines, et cum separaverint vos, et exprobraverint, et ejicerint nomen vestrum tamquam malum propter Filium hominis.
tr: μακαριοι εστε οταν μισησωσιν υμας οι ανθρωποι και οταν αφορισωσιν υμας και ονειδισωσιν και εκβαλωσιν το ονομα υμων ως πονηρον ενεκα του υιου του ανθρωπου
kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.

vulg: gaudete in illa die et exultate ecce enim merces vestra multa in caelo secundum haec enim faciebant prophetis patres eorum
clem: Gaudete in illa die, et exsultate: ecce enim merces vestra multa est in clo: secundum hc enim faciebant prophetis patres eorum.
tr: χαιρετε εν εκεινη τη ημερα και σκιρτησατε ιδου γαρ ο μισθος υμων πολυς εν τω ουρανω κατα ταυτα γαρ εποιουν τοις προφηταις οι πατερες αυτων
kjv: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.

vulg: verumtamen vae vobis divitibus quia habetis consolationem vestram
clem: Verumtamen v vobis divitibus, quia habetis consolationem vestram.
tr: πλην ουαι υμιν τοις πλουσιοις οτι απεχετε την παρακλησιν υμων
kjv: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.

vulg: vae vobis qui saturati estis quia esurietis vae vobis qui ridetis nunc quia lugebitis et flebitis
clem: V vobis, qui saturati estis: quia esurietis. V vobis, qui ridetis nunc: quia lugebitis et flebitis.
tr: ουαι υμιν οι εμπεπλησμενοι οτι πεινασετε ουαι υμιν οι γελωντες νυν οτι πενθησετε και κλαυσετε
kjv: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.

vulg: vae cum bene vobis dixerint omnes homines secundum haec faciebant prophetis patres eorum
clem: V cum benedixerint vobis homines: secundum hc enim faciebant pseudoprophetis patres eorum.
tr: ουαι υμιν οταν καλως υμας ειπωσιν παντες οι ανθρωποι κατα ταυτα γαρ εποιουν τοις ψευδοπροφηταις οι πατερες αυτων
kjv: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.

vulg: sed vobis dico qui auditis diligite inimicos vestros benefacite his qui vos oderunt
clem: Sed vobis dico, qui auditis: diligite inimicos vestros, benefacite his qui oderunt vos.
tr: αλλ υμιν λεγω τοις ακουουσιν αγαπατε τους εχθρους υμων καλως ποιειτε τοις μισουσιν υμας
kjv: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,

vulg: benedicite maledicentibus vobis orate pro calumniantibus vos
clem: Benedicite maledicentibus vobis, et orate pro calumniantibus vos.
tr: ευλογειτε τους καταρωμενους υμιν και προσευχεσθε υπερ των επηρεαζοντων υμας
kjv: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

vulg: ei qui te percutit in maxillam praebe et alteram et ab eo qui aufert tibi vestimentum etiam tunicam noli prohibere
clem: Et qui te percutit in maxillam, prbe et alteram. Et ab eo qui aufert tibi vestimentum, etiam tunicam noli prohibere.
tr: τω τυπτοντι σε επι την σιαγονα παρεχε και την αλλην και απο του αιροντος σου το ιματιον και τον χιτωνα μη κωλυσης
kjv: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloak forbid not to take thy coat also.

vulg: omni autem petenti te tribue et qui aufert quae tua sunt ne repetas
clem: Omni autem petenti te, tribue: et qui aufert qu tua sunt, ne repetas.
tr: παντι δε τω αιτουντι σε διδου και απο του αιροντος τα σα μη απαιτει
kjv: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.

vulg: et prout vultis ut faciant vobis homines et vos facite illis similiter
clem: Et prout vultis ut faciant vobis homines, et vos facite illis similiter.
tr: και καθως θελετε ινα ποιωσιν υμιν οι ανθρωποι και υμεις ποιειτε αυτοις ομοιως
kjv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

vulg: et si diligitis eos qui vos diligunt quae vobis est gratia nam et peccatores diligentes se diligunt
clem: Et si diligitis eos qui vos diligunt, qu vobis est gratia? nam et peccatores diligentes se diligunt.
tr: και ει αγαπατε τους αγαπωντας υμας ποια υμιν χαρις εστιν και γαρ οι αμαρτωλοι τους αγαπωντας αυτους αγαπωσιν
kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.

vulg: et si benefeceritis his qui vobis benefaciunt quae vobis est gratia siquidem et peccatores hoc faciunt
clem: Et si benefeceritis his qui vobis benefaciunt, qu vobis est gratia? siquidem et peccatores hoc faciunt.
tr: και εαν αγαθοποιητε τους αγαθοποιουντας υμας ποια υμιν χαρις εστιν και γαρ οι αμαρτωλοι το αυτο ποιουσιν
kjv: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

vulg: et si mutuum dederitis his a quibus speratis recipere quae gratia est vobis nam et peccatores peccatoribus fenerantur ut recipiant aequalia
clem: Et si mutuum dederitis his a quibus speratis recipere, qu gratia est vobis? nam et peccatores peccatoribus fnerantur, ut recipiant qualia.
tr: και εαν δανειζητε παρ ων ελπιζετε  ελπιζητε  απολαβειν ποια υμιν χαρις εστιν και γαρ οι αμαρτωλοι αμαρτωλοις δανειζουσιν ινα απολαβωσιν τα ισα
kjv: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

vulg: verumtamen diligite inimicos vestros et benefacite et mutuum date nihil desperantes et erit merces vestra multa et eritis filii Altissimi quia ipse benignus est super ingratos et malos
clem: Verumtamen diligite inimicos vestros: benefacite, et mutuum date, nihil inde sperantes: et erit merces vestra multa, et eritis filii Altissimi, quia ipse benignus est super ingratos et malos.
tr: πλην αγαπατε τους εχθρους υμων και αγαθοποιειτε και δανειζετε μηδεν απελπιζοντες και εσται ο μισθος υμων πολυς και εσεσθε υιοι του υψιστου οτι αυτος χρηστος εστιν επι τους αχαριστους και πονηρους
kjv: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

vulg: estote ergo misericordes sicut et Pater vester misericors est
clem: Estote ergo misericordes sicut et Pater vester misericors est.
tr: γινεσθε ουν οικτιρμονες καθως και ο πατηρ υμων οικτιρμων εστιν
kjv: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

vulg: nolite iudicare et non iudicabimini nolite condemnare et non condemnabimini dimittite et dimittemini
clem: Nolite judicare, et non judicabimini: nolite condemnare, et non condemnabimini. Dimitte, et dimittemini.
tr: και   μη κρινετε και ου μη κριθητε μη καταδικαζετε και ου μη καταδικασθητε απολυετε και απολυθησεσθε
kjv: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:

vulg: date et dabitur vobis mensuram bonam confersam et coagitatam et supereffluentem dabunt in sinum vestrum eadem quippe mensura qua mensi fueritis remetietur vobis
clem: Date, et dabitur vobis: mensuram bonam, et confertam, et coagitatam, et supereffluentem dabunt in sinum vestrum. Eadem quippe mensura, qua mensi fueritis, remetietur vobis.
tr: διδοτε και δοθησεται υμιν μετρον καλον πεπιεσμενον και σεσαλευμενον και υπερεκχυνομενον δωσουσιν εις τον κολπον υμων τω γαρ αυτω μετρω ω μετρειτε αντιμετρηθησεται υμιν
kjv: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

vulg: dicebat autem illis et similitudinem numquid potest caecus caecum ducere nonne ambo in foveam cadent
clem: Dicebat autem illis et similitudinem: Numquid potest ccus ccum ducere? nonne ambo in foveam cadunt?
tr: ειπεν δε παραβολην αυτοις μητι δυναται τυφλος τυφλον οδηγειν ουχι αμφοτεροι εις βοθυνον πεσουνται
kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?

vulg: non est discipulus super magistrum perfectus autem omnis erit sicut magister eius
clem: Non est discipulus super magistrum: perfectus autem omnis erit, si sit sicut magister ejus.
tr: ουκ εστιν μαθητης υπερ τον διδασκαλον αυτου κατηρτισμενος δε πας εσται ως ο διδασκαλος αυτου
kjv: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.

vulg: quid autem vides festucam in oculo fratris tui trabem autem quae in oculo tuo est non consideras
clem: Quid autem vides festucam in oculo fratris tui, trabem autem, qu in oculo tuo est, non consideras?
tr: τι δε βλεπεις το καρφος το εν τω οφθαλμω του αδελφου σου την δε δοκον την εν τω ιδιω οφθαλμω ου κατανοεις
kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

vulg: et quomodo potes dicere fratri tuo frater sine eiciam festucam de oculo tuo ipse in oculo tuo trabem non videns hypocrita eice primum trabem de oculo tuo et tunc perspicies ut educas festucam de oculo fratris tui
clem: aut quomodo potes dicere fratri tuo: Frater, sine ejiciam festucam de oculo tuo: ipse in oculo tuo trabem non videns? Hypocrita, ejice primum trabem de oculo tuo: et tunc perspicies ut educas festucam de oculo fratris tui.
tr: η πως δυνασαι λεγειν τω αδελφω σου αδελφε αφες εκβαλω το καρφος το εν τω οφθαλμω σου αυτος την εν τω οφθαλμω σου δοκον ου βλεπων υποκριτα εκβαλε πρωτον την δοκον εκ του οφθαλμου σου και τοτε διαβλεψεις εκβαλειν το καρφος το εν τω οφθαλμω του αδελφου σου
kjv: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.

vulg: non est enim arbor bona quae facit fructus malos neque arbor mala faciens fructum bonum
clem: Non est enim arbor bona, qu facit fructus malos: neque arbor mala, faciens fructum bonum.
tr: ου γαρ εστιν δενδρον καλον ποιουν καρπον σαπρον ουδε δενδρον σαπρον ποιουν καρπον καλον
kjv: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

vulg: unaquaeque enim arbor de fructu suo cognoscitur neque enim de spinis colligunt ficus neque de rubo vindemiant uvam
clem: Unaquque enim arbor de fructu suo cognoscitur. Neque enim de spinis colligunt ficus: neque de rubo vindemiant uvam.
tr: εκαστον γαρ δενδρον εκ του ιδιου καρπου γινωσκεται ου γαρ εξ ακανθων συλλεγουσιν συκα ουδε εκ βατου τρυγωσιν σταφυλην
kjv: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.

vulg: bonus homo de bono thesauro cordis sui profert bonum et malus homo de malo profert malum ex abundantia enim cordis os loquitur
clem: Bonus homo de bono thesauro cordis sui profert bonum: et malus homo de malo thesauro profert malum. Ex abundantia enim cordis os loquitur.
tr: ο αγαθος ανθρωπος εκ του αγαθου θησαυρου της καρδιας αυτου προφερει το αγαθον και ο πονηρος ανθρωπος εκ του πονηρου θησαυρου της καρδιας αυτου προφερει το πονηρον εκ γαρ του περισσευματος της καρδιας λαλει το στομα αυτου
kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.

vulg: quid autem vocatis me Domine Domine et non facitis quae dico
clem: Quid autem vocatis me Domine, Domine: et non facitis qu dico?
tr: τι δε με καλειτε κυριε κυριε και ου ποιειτε α λεγω
kjv: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

vulg: omnis qui venit ad me et audit sermones meos et facit eos ostendam vobis cui similis est
clem: Omnis qui venit ad me, et audit sermones meos, et facit eos, ostendam vobis cui similis sit:
tr: πας ο ερχομενος προς με και ακουων μου των λογων και ποιων αυτους υποδειξω υμιν τινι εστιν ομοιος
kjv: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:

vulg: similis est homini aedificanti domum qui fodit in altum et posuit fundamenta supra petram inundatione autem facta inlisum est flumen domui illi et non potuit eam movere fundata enim erat supra petram
clem: similis est homini dificanti domum, qui fodit in altum, et posuit fundamentum super petram: inundatione autem facta, illisum est flumen domui illi, et non potuit eam movere: fundata enim erat super petram.
tr: ομοιος εστιν ανθρωπω οικοδομουντι οικιαν ος εσκαψεν και εβαθυνεν και εθηκεν θεμελιον επι την πετραν πλημμυρας δε γενομενης προσερρηξεν ο ποταμος τη οικια εκεινη και ουκ ισχυσεν σαλευσαι αυτην τεθεμελιωτο γαρ επι την πετραν
kjv: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.

vulg: qui autem audivit et non fecit similis est homini aedificanti domum suam supra terram sine fundamento in quam inlisus est fluvius et continuo concidit et facta est ruina domus illius magna
clem: Qui autem audit, et non facit, similis est homini dificanti domum suam super terram sine fundamento: in quam illisus est fluvius, et continuo cecidit: et facta est ruina domus illius magna.
tr: ο δε ακουσας και μη ποιησας ομοιος εστιν ανθρωπω οικοδομησαντι οικιαν επι την γην χωρις θεμελιου η προσερρηξεν ο ποταμος και ευθεως επεσεν και εγενετο το ρηγμα της οικιας εκεινης μεγα
kjv: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.

vulg: cum autem implesset omnia verba sua in aures plebis intravit Capharnaum
clem: Cum autem implesset omnia verba sua in aures plebis, intravit Capharnaum.
tr: επει δε επληρωσεν παντα τα ρηματα αυτου εις τας ακοας του λαου εισηλθεν εις καπερναουμ
kjv: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

vulg: centurionis autem cuiusdam servus male habens erat moriturus qui illi erat pretiosus
clem: Centurionis autem cujusdam servus male habens, erat moriturus: qui illi erat pretiosus.
tr: εκατονταρχου δε τινος δουλος κακως εχων ημελλεν τελευταν ος ην αυτω εντιμος
kjv: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

vulg: et cum audisset de Iesu misit ad eum seniores Iudaeorum rogans eum ut veniret et salvaret servum eius
clem: Et cum audisset de Jesu, misit ad eum seniores Judorum, rogans eum ut veniret et salvaret servum ejus.
tr: ακουσας δε περι του ιησου απεστειλεν προς αυτον πρεσβυτερους των ιουδαιων ερωτων αυτον οπως ελθων διασωση τον δουλον αυτου
kjv: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.

vulg: at illi cum venissent ad Iesum rogabant eum sollicite dicentes ei quia dignus est ut hoc illi praestes
clem: At illi cum venissent ad Jesum, rogabant eum sollicite, dicentes ei: Quia dignus est ut hoc illi prstes:
tr: οι δε παραγενομενοι προς τον ιησουν παρεκαλουν αυτον σπουδαιως λεγοντες οτι αξιος εστιν ω παρεξει τουτο
kjv: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:

vulg: diligit enim gentem nostram et synagogam ipse aedificavit nobis
clem: diligit enim gentem nostram, et synagogam ipse dificavit nobis.
tr: αγαπα γαρ το εθνος ημων και την συναγωγην αυτος ωκοδομησεν ημιν
kjv: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.

vulg: Iesus autem ibat cum illis et cum iam non longe esset a domo misit ad eum centurio amicos dicens Domine noli vexari non enim dignus sum ut sub tectum meum intres
clem: Jesus autem ibat cum illis. Et cum jam non longe esset a domo, misit ad eum centurio amicos, dicens: Domine, noli vexari: non enim sum dignus ut sub tectum meum intres:
tr: ο δε ιησους επορευετο συν αυτοις ηδη δε αυτου ου μακραν απεχοντος απο της οικιας επεμψεν προς αυτον ο εκατονταρχος φιλους λεγων αυτω κυριε μη σκυλλου ου γαρ ειμι ικανος ινα υπο την στεγην μου εισελθης
kjv: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:

vulg: propter quod et me ipsum non sum dignum arbitratus ut venirem ad te sed dic verbo et sanabitur puer meus
clem: propter quod et meipsum non sum dignum arbitratus ut venirem ad te: sed dic verbo, et sanabitur puer meus.
tr: διο ουδε εμαυτον ηξιωσα προς σε ελθειν αλλα ειπε λογω και ιαθησεται ο παις μου
kjv: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.

vulg: nam et ego homo sum sub potestate constitutus habens sub me milites et dico huic vade et vadit et alio veni et venit et servo meo fac hoc et facit
clem: Nam et ego homo sum sub potestate constitutus, habens sub me milites: et dico huic, Vade, et vadit: et alii, Veni, et venit: et servo meo, Fac hoc, et facit.
tr: και γαρ εγω ανθρωπος ειμι υπο εξουσιαν τασσομενος εχων υπ εμαυτον στρατιωτας και λεγω τουτω πορευθητι και πορευεται και αλλω ερχου και ερχεται και τω δουλω μου ποιησον τουτο και ποιει
kjv: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

vulg: quo audito Iesus miratus est et conversus sequentibus se turbis dixit amen dico vobis nec in Israhel tantam fidem inveni
clem: Quo audito Jesus miratus est: et conversus sequentibus se turbis, dixit: Amen dico vobis, nec in Isral tantam fidem inveni.
tr: ακουσας δε ταυτα ο ιησους εθαυμασεν αυτον και στραφεις τω ακολουθουντι αυτω οχλω ειπεν λεγω υμιν ουδε εν τω ισραηλ τοσαυτην πιστιν ευρον
kjv: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

vulg: et reversi qui missi fuerant domum invenerunt servum qui languerat sanum
clem: Et reversi, qui missi fuerant, domum, invenerunt servum, qui languerat, sanum.
tr: και υποστρεψαντες οι πεμφθεντες εις τον οικον ευρον τον ασθενουντα δουλον υγιαινοντα
kjv: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.

vulg: et factum est deinceps ibat in civitatem quae vocatur Naim et ibant cum illo discipuli eius et turba copiosa
clem: Et factum est: deinceps ibat in civitatem qu vocatur Naim: et ibant cum eo discipuli ejus et turba copiosa.
tr: και εγενετο εν τη εξης επορευετο εις πολιν καλουμενην ναιν και συνεπορευοντο αυτω οι μαθηται αυτου ικανοι και οχλος πολυς
kjv: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.

vulg: cum autem adpropinquaret portae civitatis et ecce defunctus efferebatur filius unicus matri suae et haec vidua erat et turba civitatis multa cum illa
clem: Cum autem appropinquaret port civitatis, ecce defunctus efferebatur filius unicus matris su: et hc vidua erat: et turba civitatis multa cum illa.
tr: ως δε ηγγισεν τη πυλη της πολεως και ιδου εξεκομιζετο τεθνηκως υιος μονογενης τη μητρι αυτου και αυτη ην χηρα και οχλος της πολεως ικανος  ην  συν αυτη
kjv: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.

vulg: quam cum vidisset Dominus misericordia motus super ea dixit illi noli flere
clem: Quam cum vidisset Dominus, misericordia motus super eam, dixit illi: Noli flere.
tr: και ιδων αυτην ο κυριος εσπλαγχνισθη επ αυτη και ειπεν αυτη μη κλαιε
kjv: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.

vulg: et accessit et tetigit loculum hii autem qui portabant steterunt et ait adulescens tibi dico surge
clem: Et accessit, et tetigit loculum. (Hi autem qui portabant, steterunt.) Et ait: Adolescens, tibi dico, surge.
tr: και προσελθων ηψατο της σορου οι δε βασταζοντες εστησαν και ειπεν νεανισκε σοι λεγω εγερθητι
kjv: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.

vulg: et resedit qui erat mortuus et coepit loqui et dedit illum matri suae
clem: Et resedit qui erat mortuus, et cpit loqui. Et dedit illum matri su.
tr: και ανεκαθισεν ο νεκρος και ηρξατο λαλειν και εδωκεν αυτον τη μητρι αυτου
kjv: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.

vulg: accepit autem omnes timor et magnificabant Deum dicentes quia propheta magnus surrexit in nobis et quia Deus visitavit plebem suam
clem: Accepit autem omnes timor: et magnificabant Deum, dicentes: Quia propheta magnus surrexit in nobis: et quia Deus visitavit plebem suam.
tr: ελαβεν δε φοβος απαντας και εδοξαζον τον θεον λεγοντες οτι προφητης μεγας εγηγερται εν ημιν και οτι επεσκεψατο ο θεος τον λαον αυτου
kjv: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.

vulg: et exiit hic sermo in universam Iudaeam de eo et omnem circa regionem
clem: Et exiit hic sermo in universam Judam de eo, et in omnem circa regionem.
tr: και εξηλθεν ο λογος ουτος εν ολη τη ιουδαια περι αυτου και εν παση τη περιχωρω
kjv: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.

vulg: et nuntiaverunt Iohanni discipuli eius de omnibus his
clem: Et nuntiaverunt Joanni discipuli ejus de omnibus his.
tr: και απηγγειλαν ιωαννη οι μαθηται αυτου περι παντων τουτων
kjv: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.

vulg: et convocavit duos de discipulis suis Iohannes et misit ad Dominum dicens tu es qui venturus es an alium expectamus
clem: Et convocavit duos de discipulis suis Joannes, et misit ad Jesum, dicens: Tu es qui venturus es, an alium exspectamus?
tr: και προσκαλεσαμενος δυο τινας των μαθητων αυτου ο ιωαννης επεμψεν προς τον ιησουν λεγων συ ει ο ερχομενος η αλλον προσδοκωμεν
kjv: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

vulg: cum autem venissent ad eum viri dixerunt Iohannes Baptista misit nos ad te dicens tu es qui venturus es an alium expectamus
clem: Cum autem venissent ad eum viri, dixerunt: Joannes Baptista misit nos ad te dicens: Tu es qui venturus es, an alium exspectamus?
tr: παραγενομενοι δε προς αυτον οι ανδρες ειπον ιωαννης ο βαπτιστης απεσταλκεν ημας προς σε λεγων συ ει ο ερχομενος η αλλον προσδοκωμεν
kjv: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

vulg: in ipsa autem hora curavit multos a languoribus et plagis et spiritibus malis et caecis multis donavit visum
clem: (In ipsa autem hora multos curavit a languoribus, et plagis, et spiritibus malis, et ccis multis donavit visum.)
tr: εν αυτη δε τη ωρα εθεραπευσεν πολλους απο νοσων και μαστιγων και πνευματων πονηρων και τυφλοις πολλοις εχαρισατο το βλεπειν
kjv: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.

vulg: et respondens dixit illis euntes nuntiate Iohanni quae vidistis et audistis quia caeci vident claudi ambulant leprosi mundantur surdi audiunt mortui resurgunt pauperes evangelizantur
clem: Et respondens, dixit illis: Euntes renuntiate Joanni qu audistis et vidistis: quia cci vident, claudi ambulant, leprosi mundantur, surdi audiunt, mortui resurgunt, pauperes evangelizantur:
tr: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις πορευθεντες απαγγειλατε ιωαννη α ειδετε και ηκουσατε οτι τυφλοι αναβλεπουσιν χωλοι περιπατουσιν λεπροι καθαριζονται κωφοι ακουουσιν νεκροι εγειρονται πτωχοι ευαγγελιζονται
kjv: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.

vulg: et beatus est quicumque non fuerit scandalizatus in me
clem: et beatus est quicumque non fuerit scandalizatus in me.
tr: και μακαριος εστιν ος εαν μη σκανδαλισθη εν εμοι
kjv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

vulg: et cum discessissent nuntii Iohannis coepit dicere de Iohanne ad turbas quid existis in desertum videre harundinem vento moveri
clem: Et cum discessissent nuntii Joannis, cpit de Joanne dicere ad turbas: Quid existis in desertum videre? arundinem vento agitatam?
tr: απελθοντων δε των αγγελων ιωαννου ηρξατο λεγειν προς τους οχλους περι ιωαννου τι εξεληλυθατε εις την ερημον θεασασθαι καλαμον υπο ανεμου σαλευομενον
kjv: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

vulg: sed quid existis videre hominem mollibus vestimentis indutum ecce qui in veste pretiosa sunt et deliciis in domibus regum sunt
clem: Sed quid existis videre? hominem mollibus vestibus indutum? Ecce qui in veste pretiosa sunt et deliciis, in domibus regum sunt.
tr: αλλα τι εξεληλυθατε ιδειν ανθρωπον εν μαλακοις ιματιοις ημφιεσμενον ιδου οι εν ιματισμω ενδοξω και τρυφη υπαρχοντες εν τοις βασιλειοις εισιν
kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

vulg: sed quid existis videre prophetam utique dico vobis et plus quam prophetam
clem: Sed quid existis videre? prophetam? Utique dico vobis, et plus quam prophetam:
tr: αλλα τι εξεληλυθατε ιδειν προφητην ναι λεγω υμιν και περισσοτερον προφητου
kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.

vulg: hic est de quo scriptum est ecce mitto angelum meum ante faciem tuam qui praeparabit viam tuam ante te
clem: hic est, de quo scriptum est: Ecce mitto angelum meum ante faciem tuam, qui prparabit viam tuam ante te.
tr: ουτος εστιν περι ου γεγραπται ιδου εγω αποστελλω τον αγγελον μου προ προσωπου σου ος κατασκευασει την οδον σου εμπροσθεν σου
kjv: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

vulg: dico enim vobis maior inter natos mulierum propheta Iohanne Baptista nemo est qui autem minor est in regno Dei maior est illo
clem: Dico enim vobis: major inter natos mulierum propheta Joanne Baptista nemo est: qui autem minor est in regno Dei, major est illo.
tr: λεγω γαρ υμιν μειζων εν γεννητοις γυναικων προφητης ιωαννου του βαπτιστου ουδεις εστιν ο δε μικροτερος εν τη βασιλεια του θεου μειζων αυτου εστιν
kjv: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

vulg: et omnis populus audiens et publicani iustificaverunt Deum baptizati baptismo Iohannis
clem: Et omnis populus audiens et publicani, justificaverunt Deum, baptizati baptismo Joannis.
tr: και πας ο λαος ακουσας και οι τελωναι εδικαιωσαν τον θεον βαπτισθεντες το βαπτισμα ιωαννου
kjv: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.

vulg: Pharisaei autem et legis periti consilium Dei spreverunt in semet ipsos non baptizati ab eo
clem: Pharisi autem et legisperiti consilium Dei spreverunt in semetipsos, non baptizati ab eo.
tr: οι δε φαρισαιοι και οι νομικοι την βουλην του θεου ηθετησαν εις εαυτους μη βαπτισθεντες υπ αυτου
kjv: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.

vulg: cui ergo similes dicam homines generationis huius et cui similes sunt
clem: Ait autem Dominus: Cui ergo similes dicam homines generationis hujus? et cui similes sunt?
tr: ειπεν δε ο κυριος τινι ουν ομοιωσω τους ανθρωπους της γενεας ταυτης και τινι εισιν ομοιοι
kjv: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?

vulg: similes sunt pueris sedentibus in foro et loquentibus ad invicem et dicentibus cantavimus vobis tibiis et non saltastis lamentavimus et non plorastis
clem: Similes sunt pueris sedentibus in foro, et loquentibus ad invicem, et dicentibus: Cantavimus vobis tibiis, et non saltastis: lamentavimus, et non plorastis.
tr: ομοιοι εισιν παιδιοις τοις εν αγορα καθημενοις και προσφωνουσιν αλληλοις και λεγουσιν ηυλησαμεν υμιν και ουκ ωρχησασθε εθρηνησαμεν υμιν και ουκ εκλαυσατε
kjv: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.

vulg: venit enim Iohannes Baptista neque manducans panem neque bibens vinum et dicitis daemonium habet
clem: Venit enim Joannes Baptista, neque manducans panem, neque bibens vinum, et dicitis: Dmonium habet.
tr: εληλυθεν γαρ ιωαννης ο βαπτιστης μητε αρτον εσθιων μητε οινον πινων και λεγετε δαιμονιον εχει
kjv: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.

vulg: venit Filius hominis manducans et bibens et dicitis ecce homo devorator et bibens vinum amicus publicanorum et peccatorum
clem: Venit Filius hominis manducans, et bibens, et dicitis: Ecce homo devorator, et bibens vinum, amicus publicanorum et peccatorum.
tr: εληλυθεν ο υιος του ανθρωπου εσθιων και πινων και λεγετε ιδου ανθρωπος φαγος και οινοποτης τελωνων φιλος και αμαρτωλων
kjv: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!

vulg: et iustificata est sapientia ab omnibus filiis suis
clem: Et justificata est sapientia ab omnibus filiis suis.
tr: και εδικαιωθη η σοφια απο των τεκνων αυτης παντων
kjv: But wisdom is justified of all her children.

vulg: rogabat autem illum quidam de Pharisaeis ut manducaret cum illo et ingressus domum Pharisaei discubuit
clem: Rogabat autem illum quidam de pharisis ut manducaret cum illo. Et ingressus domum pharisi discubuit.
tr: ηρωτα δε τις αυτον των φαρισαιων ινα φαγη μετ αυτου και εισελθων εις την οικιαν του φαρισαιου ανεκλιθη
kjv: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.

vulg: et ecce mulier quae erat in civitate peccatrix ut cognovit quod accubuit in domo Pharisaei adtulit alabastrum unguenti
clem: Et ecce mulier, qu erat in civitate peccatrix, ut cognovit quod accubuisset in domo pharisi, attulit alabastrum unguenti:
tr: και ιδου γυνη εν τη πολει ητις ην αμαρτωλος επιγνουσα οτι ανακειται εν τη οικια του φαρισαιου κομισασα αλαβαστρον μυρου
kjv: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

vulg: et stans retro secus pedes eius lacrimis coepit rigare pedes eius et capillis capitis sui tergebat et osculabatur pedes eius et unguento unguebat
clem: et stans retro secus pedes ejus, lacrimis cpit rigare pedes ejus, et capillis capitis sui tergebat, et osculabatur pedes ejus, et unguento ungebat.
tr: και στασα παρα τους ποδας αυτου οπισω κλαιουσα ηρξατο βρεχειν τους ποδας αυτου τοις δακρυσιν και ταις θριξιν της κεφαλης αυτης εξεμασσεν και κατεφιλει τους ποδας αυτου και ηλειφεν τω μυρω
kjv: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

vulg: videns autem Pharisaeus qui vocaverat eum ait intra se dicens hic si esset propheta sciret utique quae et qualis mulier quae tangit eum quia peccatrix est
clem: Videns autem pharisus, qui vocaverat eum, ait intra se dicens: Hic si esset propheta, sciret utique qu et qualis est mulier, qu tangit eum: quia peccatrix est.
tr: ιδων δε ο φαρισαιος ο καλεσας αυτον ειπεν εν εαυτω λεγων ουτος ει ην προφητης εγινωσκεν αν τις και ποταπη η γυνη ητις απτεται αυτου οτι αμαρτωλος εστιν
kjv: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.

vulg: et respondens Iesus dixit ad illum Simon habeo tibi aliquid dicere at ille ait magister dic
clem: Et respondens Jesus, dixit ad illum: Simon, habeo tibi aliquid dicere. At ille ait: Magister, dic.
tr: και αποκριθεις ο ιησους ειπεν προς αυτον σιμων εχω σοι τι ειπειν ο δε φησιν διδασκαλε ειπε
kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.

vulg: duo debitores erant cuidam feneratori unus debebat denarios quingentos alius quinquaginta
clem: Duo debitores erant cuidam fneratori: unus debebat denarios quingentos, et alius quinquaginta.
tr: δυο χρεωφειλεται ησαν δανειστη τινι ο εις ωφειλεν δηναρια πεντακοσια ο δε ετερος πεντηκοντα
kjv: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

vulg: non habentibus illis unde redderent donavit utrisque quis ergo eum plus diliget
clem: Non habentibus illis unde redderent, donavit utrisque. Quis ergo eum plus diligit?
tr: μη εχοντων δε αυτων αποδουναι αμφοτεροις εχαρισατο τις ουν αυτων ειπε πλειον αυτον αγαπησει
kjv: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

vulg: respondens Simon dixit aestimo quia is cui plus donavit at ille dixit ei recte iudicasti
clem: Respondens Simon dixit: stimo quia is cui plus donavit. At ille dixit: Recte judicasti.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο σιμων ειπεν υπολαμβανω οτι ω το πλειον εχαρισατο ο δε ειπεν αυτω ορθως εκρινας
kjv: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.

vulg: et conversus ad mulierem dixit Simoni vides hanc mulierem intravi in domum tuam aquam pedibus meis non dedisti haec autem lacrimis rigavit pedes meos et capillis suis tersit
clem: Et conversus ad mulierem, dixit Simoni: Vides hanc mulierem? Intravi in domum tuam, aquam pedibus meis non dedisti: hc autem lacrimis rigavit pedes meos, et capillis suis tersit.
tr: και στραφεις προς την γυναικα τω σιμωνι εφη βλεπεις ταυτην την γυναικα εισηλθον σου εις την οικιαν υδωρ επι τους ποδας μου ουκ εδωκας αυτη δε τοις δακρυσιν εβρεξεν μου τους ποδας και ταις θριξιν της κεφαλης αυτης εξεμαξεν
kjv: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.

vulg: osculum mihi non dedisti haec autem ex quo intravit non cessavit osculari pedes meos
clem: Osculum mihi non dedisti: hc autem ex quo intravit, non cessavit osculari pedes meos.
tr: φιλημα μοι ουκ εδωκας αυτη δε αφ ης εισηλθον ου διελιπεν καταφιλουσα μου τους ποδας
kjv: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.

vulg: oleo caput meum non unxisti haec autem unguento unxit pedes meos
clem: Oleo caput meum non unxisti: hc autem unguento unxit pedes meos.
tr: ελαιω την κεφαλην μου ουκ ηλειψας αυτη δε μυρω ηλειψεν μου τους ποδας
kjv: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.

vulg: propter quod dico tibi remittentur ei peccata multa quoniam dilexit multum cui autem minus dimittitur minus diligit
clem: Propter quod dico tibi: remittuntur ei peccata multa, quoniam dilexit multum. Cui autem minus dimittitur, minus diligit.
tr: ου χαριν λεγω σοι αφεωνται αι αμαρτιαι αυτης αι πολλαι οτι ηγαπησεν πολυ ω δε ολιγον αφιεται ολιγον αγαπα
kjv: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.

vulg: dixit autem ad illam remittuntur tibi peccata
clem: Dixit autem ad illam: Remittuntur tibi peccata.
tr: ειπεν δε αυτη αφεωνται σου αι αμαρτιαι
kjv: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.

vulg: et coeperunt qui simul accumbebant dicere intra se quis est hic qui etiam peccata dimittit
clem: Et cperunt qui simul accumbebant, dicere intra se: Quis est hic qui etiam peccata dimittit?
tr: και ηρξαντο οι συνανακειμενοι λεγειν εν εαυτοις τις ουτος εστιν ος και αμαρτιας αφιησιν
kjv: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?

vulg: dixit autem ad mulierem fides tua te salvam fecit vade in pace
clem: Dixit autem ad mulierem: Fides tua te salvam fecit: vade in pace.
tr: ειπεν δε προς την γυναικα η πιστις σου σεσωκεν σε πορευου εις ειρηνην
kjv: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.

vulg: et factum est deinceps et ipse iter faciebat per civitatem et castellum praedicans et evangelizans regnum Dei et duodecim cum illo
clem: Et factum est deinceps, et ipse iter faciebat per civitates, et castella prdicans, et evangelizans regnum Dei: et duodecim cum illo,
tr: και εγενετο εν τω καθεξης και αυτος διωδευεν κατα πολιν και κωμην κηρυσσων και ευαγγελιζομενος την βασιλειαν του θεου και οι δωδεκα συν αυτω
kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,

vulg: et mulieres aliquae quae erant curatae ab spiritibus malignis et infirmitatibus Maria quae vocatur Magdalene de qua daemonia septem exierant
clem: et mulieres aliqu, qu erant curat a spiritibus malignis et infirmatibus: Maria, qu vocatur Magdalene, de qua septem dmonia exierant,
tr: και γυναικες τινες αι ησαν τεθεραπευμεναι απο πνευματων πονηρων και ασθενειων μαρια η καλουμενη μαγδαληνη αφ ης δαιμονια επτα εξεληλυθει
kjv: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,

vulg: et Iohanna uxor Chuza procuratoris Herodis et Susanna et aliae multae quae ministrabant eis de facultatibus suis
clem: et Joanna uxor Chus procuratoris Herodis, et Susanna, et ali mult, qu ministrabant ei de facultatibus suis.
tr: και ιωαννα γυνη χουζα επιτροπου ηρωδου και σουσαννα και ετεραι πολλαι αιτινες διηκονουν αυτω απο των υπαρχοντων αυταις
kjv: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.

vulg: cum autem turba plurima conveniret et de civitatibus properarent ad eum dixit per similitudinem
clem: Cum autem turba plurima convenirent, et de civitatibus properarent ad eum, dixit per similitudinem:
tr: συνιοντος δε οχλου πολλου και των κατα πολιν επιπορευομενων προς αυτον ειπεν δια παραβολης
kjv: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:

vulg: exiit qui seminat seminare semen suum et dum seminat aliud cecidit secus viam et conculcatum est et volucres caeli comederunt illud
clem: Exiit qui seminat, seminare semen suum. Et dum seminat, aliud cecidit secus viam, et conculcatum est, et volucres cli comederunt illud.
tr: εξηλθεν ο σπειρων του σπειραι τον σπορον αυτου και εν τω σπειρειν αυτον ο μεν επεσεν παρα την οδον και κατεπατηθη και τα πετεινα του ουρανου κατεφαγεν αυτο
kjv: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.

vulg: et aliud cecidit supra petram et natum aruit quia non habebat humorem
clem: Et aliud cecidit supra petrum: et natum aruit, quia non habebat humorem.
tr: και ετερον επεσεν επι την πετραν και φυεν εξηρανθη δια το μη εχειν ικμαδα
kjv: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

vulg: et aliud cecidit inter spinas et simul exortae spinae suffocaverunt illud
clem: Et aliud cecidit inter spinas, et simul exort spin suffocaverunt illud.
tr: και ετερον επεσεν εν μεσω των ακανθων και συμφυεισαι αι ακανθαι απεπνιξαν αυτο
kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.

vulg: et aliud cecidit in terram bonam et ortum fecit fructum centuplum haec dicens clamabat qui habet aures audiendi audiat
clem: Et aliud cecidit in terram bonam: et ortum fecit fructum centuplum. Hc dicens clamabat: Qui habet aures audiendi, audiat.
tr: και ετερον επεσεν επι την γην την αγαθην και φυεν εποιησεν καρπον εκατονταπλασιονα ταυτα λεγων εφωνει ο εχων ωτα ακουειν ακουετω
kjv: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

vulg: interrogabant autem eum discipuli eius quae esset haec parabola
clem: Interrogabant autem eum discipuli ejus, qu esset hc parabola.
tr: επηρωτων δε αυτον οι μαθηται αυτου λεγοντες τις ειη η παραβολη αυτη
kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
