vulg: quibus ipse dixit vobis datum est nosse mysterium regni Dei ceteris autem in parabolis ut videntes non videant et audientes non intellegant
clem: Quibus ipse dixit: Vobis datum est nosse mysterium regni Dei, ceteris autem in parabolis: ut videntes non videant, et audientes non intelligant.
tr: ο δε ειπεν υμιν δεδοται γνωναι τα μυστηρια της βασιλειας του θεου τοις δε λοιποις εν παραβολαις ινα βλεποντες μη βλεπωσιν και ακουοντες μη συνιωσιν
kjv: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.

vulg: est autem haec parabola semen est verbum Dei
clem: Est autem hc parabola: Semen est verbum Domini.
tr: εστιν δε αυτη η παραβολη ο σπορος εστιν ο λογος του θεου
kjv: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

vulg: qui autem secus viam sunt qui audiunt deinde venit diabolus et tollit verbum de corde eorum ne credentes salvi fiant
clem: Qui autem secus viam, hi sunt qui audiunt: deinde venit diabolus, et tollit verbum de corde eorum, ne credentes salvi fiant.
tr: οι δε παρα την οδον εισιν οι ακουοντες ειτα ερχεται ο διαβολος και αιρει τον λογον απο της καρδιας αυτων ινα μη πιστευσαντες σωθωσιν
kjv: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

vulg: nam qui supra petram qui cum audierint cum gaudio suscipiunt verbum et hii radices non habent qui ad tempus credunt et in tempore temptationis recedunt
clem: Nam qui supra petram, qui cum audierint, cum gaudio suscipiunt verbum: et hi radices non habent: qui ad tempus credunt, et in tempore tentationis recedunt.
tr: οι δε επι της πετρας οι οταν ακουσωσιν μετα χαρας δεχονται τον λογον και ουτοι ριζαν ουκ εχουσιν οι προς καιρον πιστευουσιν και εν καιρω πειρασμου αφιστανται
kjv: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

vulg: quod autem in spinis cecidit hii sunt qui audierunt et a sollicitudinibus et divitiis et voluptatibus vitae euntes suffocantur et non referunt fructum
clem: Quod autem in spinas cecidit: hi sunt qui audierunt, et a sollicitudinibus, et divitiis, et voluptatibus vit euntes, suffocantur, et non referunt fructum.
tr: το δε εις τας ακανθας πεσον ουτοι εισιν οι ακουσαντες και υπο μεριμνων και πλουτου και ηδονων του βιου πορευομενοι συμπνιγονται και ου τελεσφορουσιν
kjv: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

vulg: quod autem in bonam terram hii sunt qui in corde bono et optimo audientes verbum retinent et fructum adferunt in patientia
clem: Quod autem in bonam terram: hi sunt qui in corde bono et optimo audientes verbum retinent, et fructum afferunt in patientia.
tr: το δε εν τη καλη γη ουτοι εισιν οιτινες εν καρδια καλη και αγαθη ακουσαντες τον λογον κατεχουσιν και καρποφορουσιν εν υπομονη
kjv: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.

vulg: nemo autem lucernam accendens operit eam vaso aut subtus lectum ponit sed supra candelabrum ponit ut intrantes videant lumen
clem: Nemo autem lucernam accendens, operit eam vase, aut subtus lectum ponit: sed supra candelabrum ponit, ut intrantes videant lumen.
tr: ουδεις δε λυχνον αψας καλυπτει αυτον σκευει η υποκατω κλινης τιθησιν αλλ επι λυχνιας επιτιθησιν ινα οι εισπορευομενοι βλεπωσιν το φως
kjv: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

vulg: non enim est occultum quod non manifestetur nec absconditum quod non cognoscatur et in palam veniat
clem: Non est enim occultum, quod non manifestetur: nec absconditum, quod non cognoscatur, et in palam veniat.
tr: ου γαρ εστιν κρυπτον ο ου φανερον γενησεται ουδε αποκρυφον ο ου γνωσθησεται και εις φανερον ελθη
kjv: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.

vulg: videte ergo quomodo auditis qui enim habet dabitur illi et quicumque non habet etiam quod putat se habere auferetur ab illo
clem: Videte ergo quomodo audiatis? Qui enim habet, dabitur illi: et quicumque non habet, etiam quod putat se habere, auferetur ab illo.
tr: βλεπετε ουν πως ακουετε ος γαρ αν εχη δοθησεται αυτω και ος αν μη εχη και ο δοκει εχειν αρθησεται απ αυτου
kjv: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.

vulg: venerunt autem ad illum mater et fratres eius et non poterant adire ad eum prae turba
clem: Venerunt autem ad illum mater et fratres ejus, et non poterant adire eum pr turba.
tr: παρεγενοντο δε προς αυτον η μητηρ και οι αδελφοι αυτου και ουκ ηδυναντο συντυχειν αυτω δια τον οχλον
kjv: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.

vulg: et nuntiatum est illi mater tua et fratres tui stant foris volentes te videre
clem: Et nuntiatum est illi: Mater tua et fratres tui stant foris, volentes te videre.
tr: και απηγγελη αυτω λεγοντων η μητηρ σου και οι αδελφοι σου εστηκασιν εξω ιδειν σε θελοντες
kjv: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.

vulg: qui respondens dixit ad eos mater mea et fratres mei hii sunt qui verbum Dei audiunt et faciunt
clem: Qui respondens, dixit ad eos: Mater mea et fratres mei hi sunt, qui verbum Dei audiunt et faciunt.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν προς αυτους μητηρ μου και αδελφοι μου ουτοι εισιν οι τον λογον του θεου ακουοντες και ποιουντες αυτον
kjv: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.

vulg: factum est autem in una dierum et ipse ascendit in naviculam et discipuli eius et ait ad illos transfretemus trans stagnum et ascenderunt
clem: Factum est autem in una dierum: et ipse ascendit in naviculam, et discipuli ejus, et ait ad illos: Transfretemus trans stagnum. Et ascenderunt.
tr: και εγενετο εν μια των ημερων και αυτος ενεβη εις πλοιον και οι μαθηται αυτου και ειπεν προς αυτους διελθωμεν εις το περαν της λιμνης και ανηχθησαν
kjv: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.

vulg: navigantibus autem illis obdormiit et descendit procella venti in stagnum et conplebantur et periclitabantur
clem: Et navigantibus illis, obdormivit, et descendit procella venti in stagnum, et complebantur, et periclitabantur.
tr: πλεοντων δε αυτων αφυπνωσεν και κατεβη λαιλαψ ανεμου εις την λιμνην και συνεπληρουντο και εκινδυνευον
kjv: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.

vulg: accedentes autem suscitaverunt eum dicentes praeceptor perimus at ille surgens increpavit ventum et tempestatem aquae et cessavit et facta est tranquillitas
clem: Accedentes autem suscitaverunt eum, dicentes: Prceptor, perimus. At ille surgens, increpavit ventum, et tempestatem aqu, et cessavit: et facta est tranquillitas.
tr: προσελθοντες δε διηγειραν αυτον λεγοντες επιστατα επιστατα απολλυμεθα ο δε εγερθεις επετιμησεν τω ανεμω και τω κλυδωνι του υδατος και επαυσαντο και εγενετο γαληνη
kjv: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.

vulg: dixit autem illis ubi est fides vestra qui timentes mirati sunt dicentes ad invicem quis putas hic est quia et ventis imperat et mari et oboediunt ei
clem: Dixit autem illis: Ubi est fides vestra? Qui timentes, mirati sunt ad invicem, dicentes: Quis putas hic est, quia et ventis, et mari imperat, et obediunt ei?
tr: ειπεν δε αυτοις που εστιν η πιστις υμων φοβηθεντες δε εθαυμασαν λεγοντες προς αλληλους τις αρα ουτος εστιν οτι και τοις ανεμοις επιτασσει και τω υδατι και υπακουουσιν αυτω
kjv: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.

vulg: enavigaverunt autem ad regionem Gerasenorum quae est contra Galilaeam
clem: Et navigaverunt ad regionem Gerasenorum, qu est contra Galilam.
tr: και κατεπλευσαν εις την χωραν των γαδαρηνων ητις εστιν αντιπεραν της γαλιλαιας
kjv: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.

vulg: et cum egressus esset ad terram occurrit illi vir quidam qui habebat daemonium iam temporibus multis et vestimento non induebatur neque in domo manebat sed in monumentis
clem: Et cum egressus esset ad terram, occurrit illi vir quidam, qui habebat dmonium jam temporibus multis, et vestimento non induebatur, neque in domo manebat, sed in monumentis.
tr: εξελθοντι δε αυτω επι την γην υπηντησεν αυτω ανηρ τις εκ της πολεως ος ειχεν δαιμονια εκ χρονων ικανων και ιματιον ουκ ενεδιδυσκετο και εν οικια ουκ εμενεν αλλ εν τοις μνημασιν
kjv: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.

vulg: is ut vidit Iesum procidit ante illum et exclamans voce magna dixit quid mihi et tibi est Iesu Fili Dei altissimi obsecro te ne me torqueas
clem: Is, ut vidit Jesum, procidit ante illum: et exclamans voce magna, dixit: Quid mihi et tibi est, Jesu Fili Dei Altissimi? obsecro te, ne me torqueas.
tr: ιδων δε τον ιησουν και ανακραξας προσεπεσεν αυτω και φωνη μεγαλη ειπεν τι εμοι και σοι ιησου υιε του θεου του υψιστου δεομαι σου μη με βασανισης
kjv: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.

vulg: praecipiebat enim spiritui inmundo ut exiret ab homine multis enim temporibus arripiebat illum et vinciebatur catenis et conpedibus custoditus et ruptis vinculis agebatur a daemonio in deserta
clem: Prcipiebat enim spiritui immundo ut exiret ab homine. Multis enim temporibus arripiebat illum, et vinciebatur catenis, et compedibus custoditus. Et ruptis vinculis agebatur a dmonio in deserta.
tr: παρηγγελλεν  παρηγγειλεν  γαρ τω πνευματι τω ακαθαρτω εξελθειν απο του ανθρωπου πολλοις γαρ χρονοις συνηρπακει αυτον και εδεσμειτο αλυσεσιν και πεδαις φυλασσομενος και διαρρησσων τα δεσμα ηλαυνετο υπο του δαιμονος εις τας ερημους
kjv: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)

vulg: interrogavit autem illum Iesus dicens quod tibi nomen est at ille dixit Legio quia intraverunt daemonia multa in eum
clem: Interrogavit autem illum Jesus, dicens: Quod tibi nomen est? At ille dixit: Legio: quia intraverant dmonia multa in eum.
tr: επηρωτησεν δε αυτον ο ιησους λεγων τι σοι εστιν ονομα ο δε ειπεν λεγεων οτι δαιμονια πολλα εισηλθεν εις αυτον
kjv: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.

vulg: et rogabant illum ne imperaret illis ut in abyssum irent
clem: Et rogabant illum ne imperaret illis ut in abyssum irent.
tr: και παρεκαλει  παρεκαλουν  αυτον ινα μη επιταξη αυτοις εις την αβυσσον απελθειν
kjv: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.

vulg: erat autem ibi grex porcorum multorum pascentium in monte et rogabant eum ut permitteret eos in illos ingredi et permisit illos
clem: Erat autem ibi grex porcorum multorum pascentium in monte: et rogabant eum, ut permitteret eis in illos ingredi. Et permisit illis.
tr: ην δε εκει αγελη χοιρων ικανων βοσκομενων εν τω ορει και παρεκαλουν αυτον ινα επιτρεψη αυτοις εις εκεινους εισελθειν και επετρεψεν αυτοις
kjv: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.

vulg: exierunt ergo daemonia ab homine et intraverunt in porcos et impetu abiit grex per praeceps in stagnum et suffocatus est
clem: Exierunt ergo dmonia ab homine, et intraverunt in porcos: et impetu abiit grex per prceps in stagnum, et suffocatus est.
tr: εξελθοντα δε τα δαιμονια απο του ανθρωπου εισηλθεν εις τους χοιρους και ωρμησεν η αγελη κατα του κρημνου εις την λιμνην και απεπνιγη
kjv: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.

vulg: quod ut viderunt factum qui pascebant fugerunt et nuntiaverunt in civitatem et in villas
clem: Quod ut viderunt factum qui pascebant, fugerunt, et nuntiaverunt in civitatem et in villas.
tr: ιδοντες δε οι βοσκοντες το γεγενημενον εφυγον και απελθοντες απηγγειλαν εις την πολιν και εις τους αγρους
kjv: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.

vulg: exierunt autem videre quod factum est et venerunt ad Iesum et invenerunt hominem sedentem a quo daemonia exierant vestitum ac sana mente ad pedes eius et timuerunt
clem: Exierunt autem videre quod factum est, et venerunt ad Jesum, et invenerunt hominem sedentem, a quo dmonia exierant, vestitum ac sana mente, ad pedes ejus, et timuerunt.
tr: εξηλθον δε ιδειν το γεγονος και ηλθον προς τον ιησουν και ευρον καθημενον τον ανθρωπον αφ ου τα δαιμονια εξεληλυθει ιματισμενον και σωφρονουντα παρα τους ποδας του ιησου και εφοβηθησαν
kjv: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

vulg: nuntiaverunt autem illis et qui viderant quomodo sanus factus esset a Legione
clem: Nuntiaverunt autem illis et qui viderant, quomodo sanus factus esset a legione:
tr: απηγγειλαν δε αυτοις και οι ιδοντες πως εσωθη ο δαιμονισθεις
kjv: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.

vulg: et rogaverunt illum omnis multitudo regionis Gerasenorum ut discederet ab ipsis quia timore magno tenebantur ipse autem ascendens navem reversus est
clem: et rogaverunt illum omnis multitudo regionis Gerasenorum ut discederet ab ipsis: quia magno timore tenebantur. Ipse autem ascendens navim, reversus est.
tr: και ηρωτησαν αυτον απαν το πληθος της περιχωρου των γαδαρηνων απελθειν απ αυτων οτι φοβω μεγαλω συνειχοντο αυτος δε εμβας εις το πλοιον υπεστρεψεν
kjv: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.

vulg: et rogabat illum vir a quo daemonia exierant ut cum eo esset dimisit autem eum Iesus dicens
clem: Et rogabat illum vir, a quo dmonia exierant, ut cum eo esset. Dimisit autem eum Jesus, dicens:
tr: εδεετο δε αυτου ο ανηρ αφ ου εξεληλυθει τα δαιμονια ειναι συν αυτω απελυσεν δε αυτον ο ιησους λεγων
kjv: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,

vulg: redi domum tuam et narra quanta tibi fecit Deus et abiit per universam civitatem praedicans quanta illi fecisset Iesus
clem: Redi in domum tuam, et narra quanta tibi fecit Deus. Et abiit per universam civitatem, prdicans quanta illi fecisset Jesus.
tr: υποστρεφε εις τον οικον σου και διηγου οσα εποιησεν σοι ο θεος και απηλθεν καθ ολην την πολιν κηρυσσων οσα εποιησεν αυτω ο ιησους
kjv: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.

vulg: factum est autem cum redisset Iesus excepit illum turba erant enim omnes expectantes eum
clem: Factum est autem cum rediisset Jesus, excepit illum turba: erunt enim omnes exspectantes eum.
tr: εγενετο δε εν τω υποστρεψαι τον ιησουν απεδεξατο αυτον ο οχλος ησαν γαρ παντες προσδοκωντες αυτον
kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.

vulg: et ecce venit vir cui nomen Iairus et ipse princeps synagogae erat et cecidit ad pedes Iesu rogans eum ut intraret in domum eius
clem: Et ecce venit vir, cui nomen Jairus, et ipse princeps synagog erat: et cecidit ad pedes Jesu, rogans eum ut intraret in domum ejus,
tr: και ιδου ηλθεν ανηρ ω ονομα ιαειρος και αυτος αρχων της συναγωγης υπηρχεν και πεσων παρα τους ποδας του ιησου παρεκαλει αυτον εισελθειν εις τον οικον αυτου
kjv: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:

vulg: quia filia unica erat illi fere annorum duodecim et haec moriebatur et contigit dum iret a turbis conprimebatur
clem: quia unica filia erat ei fere annorum duodecim, et hc moriebatur. Et contigit, dum iret, a turba comprimebatur.
tr: οτι θυγατηρ μονογενης ην αυτω ως ετων δωδεκα και αυτη απεθνησκεν εν δε τω υπαγειν αυτον οι οχλοι συνεπνιγον αυτον
kjv: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.

vulg: et mulier quaedam erat in fluxu sanguinis ab annis duodecim quae in medicos erogaverat omnem substantiam suam nec ab ullo potuit curari
clem: Et mulier qudam erat in fluxu sanguinis ab annis duodecim, qu in medicos erogaverat omnem substantiam suam, nec ab ullo potuit curari:
tr: και γυνη ουσα εν ρυσει αιματος απο ετων δωδεκα ητις εις ιατρους προσαναλωσασα ολον τον βιον ουκ ισχυσεν υπ ουδενος θεραπευθηναι
kjv: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,

vulg: accessit retro et tetigit fimbriam vestimenti eius et confestim stetit fluxus sanguinis eius
clem: accessit retro, et tetigit fimbriam vestimenti ejus: et confestim stetit fluxus sanguinis ejus.
tr: προσελθουσα οπισθεν ηψατο του κρασπεδου του ιματιου αυτου και παραχρημα εστη η ρυσις του αιματος αυτης
kjv: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.

vulg: et ait Iesus quis est qui me tetigit negantibus autem omnibus dixit Petrus et qui cum illo erant praeceptor turbae te conprimunt et adfligunt et dicis quis me tetigit
clem: Et ait Jesus: Quis est, qui me tetigit? Negantibus autem omnibus, dixit Petrus, et qui cum illo erant: Prceptor, turb te comprimunt, et affligunt, et dicis: Quis me tetigit?
tr: και ειπεν ο ιησους τις ο αψαμενος μου αρνουμενων δε παντων ειπεν ο πετρος και οι μετ αυτου επιστατα οι οχλοι συνεχουσιν σε και αποθλιβουσιν και λεγεις τις ο αψαμενος μου
kjv: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

vulg: et dixit Iesus tetigit me aliquis nam ego novi virtutem de me exisse
clem: Et dicit Jesus: Tetigit me aliquis: nam ego novi virtutem de me exiisse.
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν ηψατο μου τις εγω γαρ εγνων δυναμιν εξελθουσαν απ εμου
kjv: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.

vulg: videns autem mulier quia non latuit tremens venit et procidit ante pedes illius et ob quam causam tetigerit eum indicavit coram omni populo et quemadmodum confestim sanata sit
clem: Videns autem mulier, quia non latuit, tremens venit, et procidit ante pedes ejus: et ob quam causam tetigerit eum, indicavit coram omni populo: et quemadmodum confestim sanata sit.
tr: ιδουσα δε η γυνη οτι ουκ ελαθεν τρεμουσα ηλθεν και προσπεσουσα αυτω δι ην αιτιαν ηψατο αυτου απηγγειλεν αυτω ενωπιον παντος του λαου και ως ιαθη παραχρημα
kjv: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

vulg: at ipse dixit illi filia fides tua te salvam fecit vade in pace
clem: At ipse dixit ei: Filia, fides tua salvam te fecit: vade in pace.
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτη θαρσει θυγατερ η πιστις σου σεσωκεν σε πορευου εις ειρηνην
kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.

vulg: adhuc illo loquente venit a principe synagogae dicens ei quia mortua est filia tua noli vexare illum
clem: Adhuc illo loquente, venit quidam ad principem synagog, dicens ei: Quia mortua est filia tua, noli vexare illum.
tr: ετι αυτου λαλουντος ερχεται τις παρα του αρχισυναγωγου λεγων αυτω οτι τεθνηκεν η θυγατηρ σου μη σκυλλε τον διδασκαλον
kjv: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.

vulg: Iesus autem audito hoc verbo respondit patri puellae noli timere crede tantum et salva erit
clem: Jesus autem, audito hoc verbo, respondit patri puell: Noli timere, crede tantum, et salva erit.
tr: ο δε ιησους ακουσας απεκριθη αυτω λεγων μη φοβου μονον πιστευε και σωθησεται
kjv: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.

vulg: et cum venisset domum non permisit intrare secum quemquam nisi Petrum et Iohannem et Iacobum et patrem et matrem puellae
clem: Et cum venisset domum, non permisit intrare secum quemquam, nisi Petrum, et Jacobum, et Joannem, et patrem, et matrem puell.
tr: εισελθων δε εις την οικιαν ουκ αφηκεν εισελθειν ουδενα ει μη πετρον και ιακωβον και ιωαννην και τον πατερα της παιδος και την μητερα
kjv: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.

vulg: flebant autem omnes et plangebant illam at ille dixit nolite flere non est mortua sed dormit
clem: Flebant autem omnes, et plangebant illam. At ille dixit: Nolite flere: non est mortua puella, sed dormit.
tr: εκλαιον δε παντες και εκοπτοντο αυτην ο δε ειπεν μη κλαιετε ουκ απεθανεν αλλα καθευδει
kjv: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.

vulg: et deridebant eum scientes quia mortua esset
clem: Et deridebant eum, scientes quod mortua esset.
tr: και κατεγελων αυτου ειδοτες οτι απεθανεν
kjv: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.

vulg: ipse autem tenens manum eius clamavit dicens puella surge
clem: Ipse autem tenens manum ejus clamavit, dicens: Puella, surge.
tr: αυτος δε εκβαλων εξω παντας και κρατησας της χειρος αυτης εφωνησεν λεγων η παις εγειρου
kjv: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.

vulg: et reversus est spiritus eius et surrexit continuo et iussit illi dari manducare
clem: Et reversus est spiritus ejus, et surrexit continuo. Et jussit illi dari manducare.
tr: και επεστρεψεν το πνευμα αυτης και ανεστη παραχρημα και διεταξεν αυτη δοθηναι φαγειν
kjv: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.

vulg: et stupuerunt parentes eius quibus praecepit ne alicui dicerent quod factum erat
clem: Et stupuerunt parentes ejus, quibus prcepit ne alicui dicerent quod factum erat.
tr: και εξεστησαν οι γονεις αυτης ο δε παρηγγειλεν αυτοις μηδενι ειπειν το γεγονος
kjv: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.

vulg: convocatis autem duodecim apostolis dedit illis virtutem et potestatem super omnia daemonia et ut languores curarent
clem: Convocatis autem duodecim Apostolis, dedit illis virtutem et potestatem super omnia dmonia, et ut languores curarent.
tr: συγκαλεσαμενος δε τους δωδεκα μαθητας αυτου εδωκεν αυτοις δυναμιν και εξουσιαν επι παντα τα δαιμονια και νοσους θεραπευειν
kjv: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

vulg: et misit illos praedicare regnum Dei et sanare infirmos
clem: Et misit illos prdicare regnum Dei, et sanare infirmos.
tr: και απεστειλεν αυτους κηρυσσειν την βασιλειαν του θεου και ιασθαι τους ασθενουντας
kjv: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

vulg: et ait ad illos nihil tuleritis in via neque virgam neque peram neque panem neque pecuniam neque duas tunicas habeatis
clem: Et ait ad illos: Nihil tuleritis in via, neque virgam, neque peram, neque panem, neque pecuniam, neque duas tunicas habeatis.
tr: και ειπεν προς αυτους μηδεν αιρετε εις την οδον μητε ραβδους μητε πηραν μητε αρτον μητε αργυριον μητε ανα δυο χιτωνας εχειν
kjv: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.

vulg: et in quamcumque domum intraveritis ibi manete et inde ne exeatis
clem: Et in quamcumque domum intraveritis, ibi manete, et inde ne exeatis.
tr: και εις ην αν οικιαν εισελθητε εκει μενετε και εκειθεν εξερχεσθε
kjv: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.

vulg: et quicumque non receperint vos exeuntes de civitate illa etiam pulverem pedum vestrorum excutite in testimonium supra illos
clem: Et quicumque non receperint vos: exeuntes de civitate illa, etiam pulverem pedum vestrorum excutite in testimonium supra illos.
tr: και οσοι αν μη δεξωνται υμας εξερχομενοι απο της πολεως εκεινης και τον κονιορτον απο των ποδων υμων αποτιναξατε εις μαρτυριον επ αυτους
kjv: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

vulg: egressi autem circumibant per castella evangelizantes et curantes ubique
clem: Egressi autem circuibant per castella evangelizantes, et curantes ubique.
tr: εξερχομενοι δε διηρχοντο κατα τας κωμας ευαγγελιζομενοι και θεραπευοντες πανταχου
kjv: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.

vulg: audivit autem Herodes tetrarcha omnia quae fiebant ab eo et haesitabat eo quod diceretur
clem: Audivit autem Herodes tetrarcha omnia qu fiebant ab eo, et hsitabat eo quod diceretur
tr: ηκουσεν δε ηρωδης ο τετραρχης τα γινομενα υπ αυτου παντα και διηπορει δια το λεγεσθαι υπο τινων οτι ιωαννης εγηγερται εκ νεκρων
kjv: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;

vulg: a quibusdam quia Iohannes surrexit a mortuis a quibusdam vero quia Helias apparuit ab aliis autem quia propheta unus de antiquis surrexit
clem: a quibusdam: Quia Joannes surrexit a mortuis: a quibusdam vero: Quia Elias apparuit: ab aliis autem: Quia propheta unus de antiquis surrexit.
tr: υπο τινων δε οτι ηλιας εφανη αλλων δε οτι προφητης εις των αρχαιων ανεστη
kjv: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.

vulg: et ait Herodes Iohannem ego decollavi quis autem est iste de quo audio ego talia et quaerebat videre eum
clem: Et ait Herodes: Joannem ego decollavit: quis est autem iste, de quo ego talia audio? Et qurebat videre eum.
tr: και ειπεν ο ηρωδης ιωαννην εγω απεκεφαλισα τις δε εστιν ουτος περι ου εγω ακουω τοιαυτα και εζητει ιδειν αυτον
kjv: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.

vulg: et reversi apostoli narraverunt illi quaecumque fecerunt et adsumptis illis secessit seorsum in locum desertum qui est Bethsaida
clem: Et reversi Apostoli, narraverunt illi qucumque fecerunt: et assumptis illis secessit seorsum in locum desertum, qui est Bethsaid.
tr: και υποστρεψαντες οι αποστολοι διηγησαντο αυτω οσα εποιησαν και παραλαβων αυτους υπεχωρησεν κατ ιδιαν εις τοπον ερημον πολεως καλουμενης βηθσαιδα
kjv: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

vulg: quod cum cognovissent turbae secutae sunt illum et excepit illos et loquebatur illis de regno Dei et eos qui cura indigebant sanabat
clem: Quod cum cognovissent turb, secut sunt illum: et excepit eos, et loquebatur illis de regno Dei, et eos, qui cura indigebant, sanabat.
tr: οι δε οχλοι γνοντες ηκολουθησαν αυτω και δεξαμενος αυτους ελαλει αυτοις περι της βασιλειας του θεου και τους χρειαν εχοντας θεραπειας ιατο
kjv: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.

vulg: dies autem coeperat declinare et accedentes duodecim dixerunt illi dimitte turbas ut euntes in castella villasque quae circa sunt devertant et inveniant escas quia hic in loco deserto sumus
clem: Dies autem cperat declinare, et accedentes duodecim dixerunt illi: Dimitte turbas, ut euntes in castella villasque qu circa sunt, divertant, et inveniant escas: quia hic in loco deserto sumus.
tr: η δε ημερα ηρξατο κλινειν προσελθοντες δε οι δωδεκα ειπον αυτω απολυσον τον οχλον ινα απελθοντες εις τας κυκλω κωμας και τους αγρους καταλυσωσιν και ευρωσιν επισιτισμον οτι ωδε εν ερημω τοπω εσμεν
kjv: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.

vulg: ait autem ad illos vos date illis manducare at illi dixerunt non sunt nobis plus quam quinque panes et duo pisces nisi forte nos eamus et emamus in omnem hanc turbam escas
clem: Ait autem ad illos: Vos date illis manducare. At illi dixerunt: Non sunt nobis plus quam quinque panes et duo pisces: nisi forte nos eamus, et emamus in omnem hanc turbam escas.
tr: ειπεν δε προς αυτους δοτε αυτοις υμεις φαγειν οι δε ειπον ουκ εισιν ημιν πλειον η πεντε αρτοι και δυο ιχθυες ει μητι πορευθεντες ημεις αγορασωμεν εις παντα τον λαον τουτον βρωματα
kjv: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.

vulg: erant autem fere viri quinque milia ait autem ad discipulos suos facite illos discumbere per convivia quinquagenos
clem: Erant autem fere viri quinque millia. Ait autem ad discipulos suos: Facite illos discumbere per convivia quinquagenos.
tr: ησαν γαρ ωσει ανδρες πεντακισχιλιοι ειπεν δε προς τους μαθητας αυτου κατακλινατε αυτους κλισιας ανα πεντηκοντα
kjv: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

vulg: et ita fecerunt et discumbere fecerunt omnes
clem: Et ita fecerunt: et discumbere fecerunt omnes.
tr: και εποιησαν ουτως και ανεκλιναν απαντας
kjv: And they did so, and made them all sit down.

vulg: acceptis autem quinque panibus et duobus piscibus respexit in caelum et benedixit illis et fregit et distribuit discipulis suis ut ponerent ante turbas
clem: Acceptis autem quinque panibus et duobus piscibus, respexit in clum, et benedixit illis: et fregit, et distribuit discipulis suis, ut ponerent ante turbas.
tr: λαβων δε τους πεντε αρτους και τους δυο ιχθυας αναβλεψας εις τον ουρανον ευλογησεν αυτους και κατεκλασεν και εδιδου τοις μαθηταις παρατιθεναι τω οχλω
kjv: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.

vulg: et manducaverunt omnes et saturati sunt et sublatum est quod superfuit illis fragmentorum cofini duodecim
clem: Et manducaverunt omnes, et saturati sunt. Et sublatum est quod superfuit illis, fragmentorum cophini duodecim.
tr: και εφαγον και εχορτασθησαν παντες και ηρθη το περισσευσαν αυτοις κλασματων κοφινοι δωδεκα
kjv: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

vulg: et factum est cum solus esset orans erant cum illo et discipuli et interrogavit illos dicens quem me dicunt esse turbae
clem: Et factum est cum solus esset orans, erant cum illo et discipuli: et interrogavit illos, dicens: Quem me dicunt esse turb?
tr: και εγενετο εν τω ειναι αυτον προσευχομενον καταμονας συνησαν αυτω οι μαθηται και επηρωτησεν αυτους λεγων τινα με λεγουσιν οι οχλοι ειναι
kjv: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?

vulg: at illi responderunt et dixerunt Iohannem Baptistam alii autem Heliam alii quia propheta unus de prioribus surrexit
clem: At illi responderunt, et dixerunt: Joannem Baptistam, alii autem Eliam, alii vero unus propheta de prioribus surrexit.
tr: οι δε αποκριθεντες ειπον ιωαννην τον βαπτιστην αλλοι δε ηλιαν αλλοι δε οτι προφητης τις των αρχαιων ανεστη
kjv: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.

vulg: dixit autem illis vos autem quem me esse dicitis respondens Simon Petrus dixit Christum Dei
clem: Dixit autem illis: Vos autem quem me esse dicitis? Respondens Simon Petrus, dixit: Christum Dei.
tr: ειπεν δε αυτοις υμεις δε τινα με λεγετε ειναι αποκριθεις δε ο πετρος ειπεν τον χριστον του θεου
kjv: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.

vulg: at ille increpans illos praecepit ne cui dicerent hoc
clem: At ille increpans illos, prcepit ne cui dicerent hoc,
tr: ο δε επιτιμησας αυτοις παρηγγειλεν μηδενι ειπειν τουτο
kjv: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;

vulg: dicens quia oportet Filium hominis multa pati et reprobari a senioribus et principibus sacerdotum et scribis et occidi et tertia die resurgere
clem: dicens: Quia oportet Filium hominis multa pati, et reprobari a senioribus, et principibus sacerdotum, et scribis, et occidi, et tertia die resurgere.
tr: ειπων οτι δει τον υιον του ανθρωπου πολλα παθειν και αποδοκιμασθηναι απο των πρεσβυτερων και αρχιερεων και γραμματεων και αποκτανθηναι και τη τριτη ημερα εγερθηναι
kjv: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.

vulg: dicebat autem ad omnes si quis vult post me venire abneget se ipsum et tollat crucem suam cotidie et sequatur me
clem: Dicebat autem ad omnes: Si quis vult post me venire, abneget semetipsum, et tollat crucem suam quotidie, et sequatur me.
tr: ελεγεν δε προς παντας ει τις θελει οπισω μου ελθειν απαρνησασθω εαυτον και αρατω τον σταυρον αυτου καθ ημεραν και ακολουθειτω μοι
kjv: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

vulg: qui enim voluerit animam suam salvam facere perdet illam nam qui perdiderit animam suam propter me salvam faciet illam
clem: Qui enim voluerit animam suam salvam facere, perdet illam: nam qui perdiderit animam suam propter me, salvam faciet illam.
tr: ος γαρ αν θελη την ψυχην αυτου σωσαι απολεσει αυτην ος δ αν απολεση την ψυχην αυτου ενεκεν εμου ουτος σωσει αυτην
kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.

vulg: quid enim proficit homo si lucretur universum mundum se autem ipsum perdat et detrimentum sui faciat
clem: Quid enim proficit homo, si lucretur universum mundum, se autem ipsum perdat, et detrimentum sui faciat?
tr: τι γαρ ωφελειται ανθρωπος κερδησας τον κοσμον ολον εαυτον δε απολεσας η ζημιωθεις
kjv: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?

vulg: nam qui me erubuerit et meos sermones hunc Filius hominis erubescet cum venerit in maiestate sua et Patris et sanctorum angelorum
clem: Nam qui me erubuerit, et meos sermones: hunc Filius hominis erubescet cum venerit in majestate sua, et Patris, et sanctorum angelorum.
tr: ος γαρ αν επαισχυνθη με και τους εμους λογους τουτον ο υιος του ανθρωπου επαισχυνθησεται οταν ελθη εν τη δοξη αυτου και του πατρος και των αγιων αγγελων
kjv: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.

vulg: dico autem vobis vere sunt aliqui hic stantes qui non gustabunt mortem donec videant regnum Dei
clem: Dico autem vobis vere: sunt aliqui hic stantes, qui non gustabunt mortem donec videant regnum Dei.
tr: λεγω δε υμιν αληθως εισιν τινες των ωδε εστηκοτων οι ου μη γευσονται θανατου εως αν ιδωσιν την βασιλειαν του θεου
kjv: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.

vulg: factum est autem post haec verba fere dies octo et adsumpsit Petrum et Iohannem et Iacobum et ascendit in montem ut oraret
clem: Factum est autem post hc verba fere dies octo, et assumpsit Petrum, et Jacobum, et Joannem, et ascendit in montem ut oraret.
tr: εγενετο δε μετα τους λογους τουτους ωσει ημεραι οκτω και παραλαβων τον πετρον και ιωαννην και ιακωβον ανεβη εις το ορος προσευξασθαι
kjv: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.

vulg: et factum est dum oraret species vultus eius altera et vestitus eius albus refulgens
clem: Et facta est, dum oraret, species vultus ejus altera: et vestitus ejus albus et refulgens.
tr: και εγενετο εν τω προσευχεσθαι αυτον το ειδος του προσωπου αυτου ετερον και ο ιματισμος αυτου λευκος εξαστραπτων
kjv: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.

vulg: et ecce duo viri loquebantur cum illo erant autem Moses et Helias
clem: Et ecce duo viri loquebantur cum illo. Erant autem Moyses et Elias,
tr: και ιδου ανδρες δυο συνελαλουν αυτω οιτινες ησαν μωσης και ηλιας
kjv: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:

vulg: visi in maiestate et dicebant excessum eius quem conpleturus erat in Hierusalem
clem: visi in majestate: et dicebant excessum ejus, quem completurus erat in Jerusalem.
tr: οι οφθεντες εν δοξη ελεγον την εξοδον αυτου ην εμελλεν πληρουν εν ιερουσαλημ
kjv: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.

vulg: Petrus vero et qui cum illo gravati erant somno et evigilantes viderunt maiestatem eius et duos viros qui stabant cum illo
clem: Petrus vero, et qui cum illo erant, gravati erant somno. Et evigilantes viderunt majestatem ejus, et duos viros qui stabant cum illo.
tr: ο δε πετρος και οι συν αυτω ησαν βεβαρημενοι υπνω διαγρηγορησαντες δε ειδον την δοξαν αυτου και τους δυο ανδρας τους συνεστωτας αυτω
kjv: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.

vulg: et factum est cum discederent ab illo ait Petrus ad Iesum praeceptor bonum est nos hic esse et faciamus tria tabernacula unum tibi et unum Mosi et unum Heliae nesciens quid diceret
clem: Et factum est cum discederent ab illo, ait Petrus ad Jesum: Prceptor, bonum est nos hic esse: et faciamus tria tabernacula, unum tibi, et unum Moysi, et unum Eli: nesciens quid diceret.
tr: και εγενετο εν τω διαχωριζεσθαι αυτους απ αυτου ειπεν ο πετρος προς τον ιησουν επιστατα καλον εστιν ημας ωδε ειναι και ποιησωμεν σκηνας τρεις μιαν σοι και μωσει μιαν και μιαν ηλια μη ειδως ο λεγει
kjv: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.

vulg: haec autem illo loquente facta est nubes et obumbravit eos et timuerunt intrantibus illis in nubem
clem: Hc autem illo loquente, facta est nubes, et obumbravit eos: et timuerunt, intrantibus illis in nubem.
tr: ταυτα δε αυτου λεγοντος εγενετο νεφελη και επεσκιασεν αυτους εφοβηθησαν δε εν τω εκεινους εισελθειν εις την νεφελην
kjv: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.

vulg: et vox facta est de nube dicens hic est Filius meus electus ipsum audite
clem: Et vox facta est de nube, dicens: Hic est Filius meus dilectus, ipsum audite.
tr: και φωνη εγενετο εκ της νεφελης λεγουσα ουτος εστιν ο υιος μου ο αγαπητος αυτου ακουετε
kjv: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

vulg: et dum fieret vox inventus est Iesus solus et ipsi tacuerunt et nemini dixerunt in illis diebus quicquam ex his quae viderant
clem: Et dum fieret vox, inventus est Jesus solus. Et ipsi tacuerunt, et nemini dixerunt in illis diebus quidquam ex his qu viderant.
tr: και εν τω γενεσθαι την φωνην ευρεθη ο ιησους μονος και αυτοι εσιγησαν και ουδενι απηγγειλαν εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις ουδεν ων εωρακασιν 3708
kjv: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.

vulg: factum est autem in sequenti die descendentibus illis de monte occurrit illi turba multa
clem: Factum est autem in sequenti die, descendentibus illis de monte, occurrit illis turba multa.
tr: εγενετο δε εν τη εξης ημερα κατελθοντων αυτων απο του ορους συνηντησεν αυτω οχλος πολυς
kjv: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.

vulg: et ecce vir de turba exclamavit dicens magister obsecro te respice in filium meum quia unicus est mihi
clem: Et ecce vir de turba exclamavit, dicens: Magister, obsecro te, respice in filium meum quia unicus est mihi:
tr: και ιδου ανηρ απο του οχλου ανεβοησεν λεγων διδασκαλε δεομαι σου επιβλεψον επι τον υιον μου οτι μονογενης εστιν μοι
kjv: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.

vulg: et ecce spiritus adprehendit illum et subito clamat et elidit et dissipat eum cum spuma et vix discedit dilanians eum
clem: et ecce spiritus apprehendit eum, et subito clamat, et elidit, et dissipat eum cum spuma, et vix discedit dilanians eum:
tr: και ιδου πνευμα λαμβανει αυτον και εξαιφνης κραζει και σπαρασσει αυτον μετα αφρου και μογις αποχωρει απ αυτου συντριβον αυτον
kjv: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.

vulg: et rogavi discipulos tuos ut eicerent illum et non potuerunt
clem: et rogavi discipulos tuos ut ejicerent illum, et non potuerunt.
tr: και εδεηθην των μαθητων σου ινα εκβαλλωσιν αυτο και ουκ ηδυνηθησαν
kjv: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.

vulg: respondens autem Iesus dixit o generatio infidelis et perversa usquequo ero apud vos et patiar vos adduc huc filium tuum
clem: Respondens autem Jesus, dixit: O generatio infidelis, et perversa, usquequo ero apud vos, et patiar vos? adduc huc filium tuum.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ιησους ειπεν ω γενεα απιστος και διεστραμμενη εως ποτε εσομαι προς υμας και ανεξομαι υμων προσαγαγε ωδε τον υιον σου
kjv: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.

vulg: et cum accederet elisit illum daemonium et dissipavit
clem: Et cum accederet, elisit illum dmonium, et dissipavit.
tr: ετι δε προσερχομενου αυτου ερρηξεν αυτον το δαιμονιον και συνεσπαραξεν επετιμησεν δε ο ιησους τω πνευματι τω ακαθαρτω και ιασατο τον παιδα και απεδωκεν αυτον τω πατρι αυτου
kjv: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.

vulg: et increpavit Iesus spiritum inmundum et sanavit puerum et reddidit illum patri eius
clem: Et increpavit Jesus spiritum immundum, et sanavit puerum, et reddidit illum patri ejus.
tr: εξεπλησσοντο δε παντες επι τη μεγαλειοτητι του θεου παντων δε θαυμαζοντων επι πασιν οις εποιησεν ο ιησους ειπεν προς τους μαθητας αυτου
kjv: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,

vulg: stupebant autem omnes in magnitudine Dei omnibusque mirantibus in omnibus quae faciebat dixit ad discipulos suos ponite vos in cordibus vestris sermones istos Filius enim hominis futurum est ut tradatur in manus hominum
clem: Stupebant autem omnes in magnitudine Dei: omnibusque mirantibus in omnibus qu faciebat, dixit ad discipulos suos: Ponite vos in cordibus vestris sermones istos: Filius enim hominis futurum est ut tradatur in manus hominum.
tr: θεσθε υμεις εις τα ωτα υμων τους λογους τουτους ο γαρ υιος του ανθρωπου μελλει παραδιδοσθαι εις χειρας ανθρωπων
kjv: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.

vulg: at illi ignorabant verbum istud et erat velatum ante eos ut non sentirent illud et timebant interrogare eum de hoc verbo
clem: At illi ignorabant verbum istud, et erat velatum ante eos ut non sentirent illud: et timebant eum interrogare de hoc verbo.
tr: οι δε ηγνοουν το ρημα τουτο και ην παρακεκαλυμμενον απ αυτων ινα μη αισθωνται αυτο και εφοβουντο ερωτησαι αυτον περι του ρηματος τουτου
kjv: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.

vulg: intravit autem cogitatio in eos quis eorum maior esset
clem: Intravit autem cogitatio in eos quis eorum major esset.
tr: εισηλθεν δε διαλογισμος εν αυτοις το τις αν ειη μειζων αυτων
kjv: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.

vulg: at Iesus videns cogitationes cordis illorum adprehendens puerum statuit eum secus se
clem: At Jesus videns cogitationes cordis illorum, apprehendit puerum, et statuit illum secus se,
tr: ο δε ιησους ιδων τον διαλογισμον της καρδιας αυτων επιλαβομενος παιδιου εστησεν αυτο παρ εαυτω
kjv: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,

vulg: et ait illis quicumque susceperit puerum istum in nomine meo me recipit et quicumque me recipit recipit eum qui me misit nam qui minor est inter omnes vos hic maior est
clem: et ait illis: Quicumque susceperit puerum istum in nomine meo, me recipit: et quicumque me receperit, recipit eum qui me misit. Nam qui minor est inter vos omnes, hic major est.
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις ος εαν δεξηται τουτο το παιδιον επι τω ονοματι μου εμε δεχεται και ος εαν εμε δεξηται δεχεται τον αποστειλαντα με ο γαρ μικροτερος εν πασιν υμιν υπαρχων ουτος εσται μεγας
kjv: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

vulg: respondens autem Iohannes dixit praeceptor vidimus quendam in nomine tuo eicientem daemonia et prohibuimus eum quia non sequitur nobiscum
clem: Respondens autem Joannes dixit: Prceptor, vidimus quemdam in nomine tuo ejicientem dmonia, et prohibuimus eum: quia non sequitur nobiscum.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ιωαννης ειπεν επιστατα ειδομεν τινα επι τω ονοματι σου εκβαλλοντα τα δαιμονια και εκωλυσαμεν αυτον οτι ουκ ακολουθει μεθ ημων
kjv: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.

vulg: et ait ad illum Iesus nolite prohibere qui enim non est adversum vos pro vobis est
clem: Et ait ad illum Jesus: Nolite prohibere: qui enim non est adversum vos, pro vobis est.
tr: και ειπεν προς αυτον ο ιησους μη κωλυετε ος γαρ ουκ εστιν καθ ημων υπερ ημων εστιν
kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.

vulg: factum est autem dum conplerentur dies adsumptionis eius et ipse faciem suam firmavit ut iret Hierusalem
clem: Factum est autem dum complerentur dies assumptionis ejus, et ipse faciem suam firmavit ut iret in Jerusalem.
tr: εγενετο δε εν τω συμπληρουσθαι τας ημερας της αναληψεως αυτου και αυτος το προσωπον αυτου εστηριξεν του πορευεσθαι εις ιερουσαλημ
kjv: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,

vulg: et misit nuntios ante conspectum suum et euntes intraverunt in civitatem Samaritanorum ut pararent illi
clem: Et misit nuntios ante conspectum suum: et euntes intraverunt in civitatem Samaritanorum ut parerent illi.
tr: και απεστειλεν αγγελους προ προσωπου αυτου και πορευθεντες εισηλθον εις κωμην σαμαρειτων ωστε ετοιμασαι αυτω
kjv: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.

vulg: et non receperunt eum quia facies eius erat euntis Hierusalem
clem: Et non receperunt eum, quia facies ejus erat euntis in Jerusalem.
tr: και ουκ εδεξαντο αυτον οτι το προσωπον αυτου ην πορευομενον εις ιερουσαλημ
kjv: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.

vulg: cum vidissent autem discipuli eius Iacobus et Iohannes dixerunt Domine vis dicimus ut ignis descendat de caelo et consumat illos
clem: Cum vidissent autem discipuli ejus Jacobus et Joannes, dixerunt: Domine, vis dicimus ut ignis descendat de clo, et consumat illos?
tr: ιδοντες δε οι μαθηται αυτου ιακωβος και ιωαννης ειπον κυριε θελεις ειπωμεν πυρ καταβηναι απο του ουρανου και αναλωσαι αυτους ως και ηλιας εποιησεν
kjv: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

vulg: et conversus increpavit illos
clem: Et conversus increpavit illos, dicens: Nescitis cujus spiritus estis.
tr: στραφεις δε επετιμησεν αυτοις και ειπεν ουκ οιδατε οιου πνευματος εστε υμεις
kjv: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.

vulg: et abierunt in aliud castellum
clem: Filius hominis non venit animas perdere, sed salvare. Et abierunt in aliud castellum.
tr: ο γαρ υιος του ανθρωπου ουκ ηλθεν ψυχας ανθρωπων απολεσαι αλλα σωσαι και επορευθησαν εις ετεραν κωμην
kjv: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.

vulg: factum est autem ambulantibus illis in via dixit quidam ad illum sequar te quocumque ieris
clem: Factum est autem: ambulantibus illis in via, dixit quidam ad illum: Sequar te quocumque ieris.
tr: εγενετο δε πορευομενων αυτων εν τη οδω ειπεν τις προς αυτον ακολουθησω σοι οπου αν απερχη κυριε
kjv: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

vulg: et ait illi Iesus vulpes foveas habent et volucres caeli nidos Filius autem hominis non habet ubi caput reclinet
clem: Dixit illi Jesus: Vulpes foveas habent, et volucres cli nidos: Filius autem hominis non habet ubi caput reclinet.
tr: και ειπεν αυτω ο ιησους αι αλωπεκες φωλεους εχουσιν και τα πετεινα του ουρανου κατασκηνωσεις ο δε υιος του ανθρωπου ουκ εχει που την κεφαλην κλινη
kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

vulg: ait autem ad alterum sequere me ille autem dixit Domine permitte mihi primum ire sepelire patrem meum
clem: Ait autem ad alterum: Sequere me: ille autem dixit: Domine, permitte mihi primum ire, et sepelire patrem meum.
tr: ειπεν δε προς ετερον ακολουθει μοι ο δε ειπεν κυριε επιτρεψον μοι απελθοντι πρωτον θαψαι τον πατερα μου
kjv: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

vulg: dixitque ei Iesus sine ut mortui sepeliant mortuos suos tu autem vade adnuntia regnum Dei
clem: Dixitque ei Jesus: Sine ut mortui sepeliant mortuos suos: tu autem vade, et annuntia regnum Dei.
tr: ειπεν δε αυτω ο ιησους αφες τους νεκρους θαψαι τους εαυτων νεκρους συ δε απελθων διαγγελλε την βασιλειαν του θεου
kjv: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.

vulg: et ait alter sequar te Domine sed primum permitte mihi renuntiare his qui domi sunt
clem: Et ait alter: Sequar te Domine, sed permitte mihi primum renuntiare his qu domi sunt.
tr: ειπεν δε και ετερος ακολουθησω σοι κυριε πρωτον δε επιτρεψον μοι αποταξασθαι τοις εις τον οικον μου
kjv: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.

vulg: ait ad illum Iesus nemo mittens manum suam in aratrum et aspiciens retro aptus est regno Dei
clem: Ait ad illum Jesus: Nemo mittens manum suam ad aratrum, et respiciens retro, aptus est regno Dei.
tr: ειπεν δε προς αυτον ο ιησους ουδεις επιβαλων την χειρα αυτου επ αροτρον και βλεπων εις τα οπισω ευθετος εστιν εις την βασιλειαν του θεου
kjv: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

vulg: post haec autem designavit Dominus et alios septuaginta duos et misit illos binos ante faciem suam in omnem civitatem et locum quo erat ipse venturus
clem: Post hc autem designavit Dominus et alios septuaginta duos: et misit illos binos ante faciem suam in omnem civitatem et locum, quo erat ipse venturus.
tr: μετα δε ταυτα ανεδειξεν ο κυριος και ετερους εβδομηκοντα και απεστειλεν αυτους ανα δυο προ προσωπου αυτου εις πασαν πολιν και τοπον ου εμελλεν αυτος ερχεσθαι
kjv: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.

vulg: et dicebat illis messis quidem multa operarii autem pauci rogate ergo Dominum messis ut mittat operarios in messem
clem: Et dicebat illis: Messis quidem multa, operarii autem pauci. Rogate ergo dominum messis ut mittat operarios in messem suam.
tr: ελεγεν ουν προς αυτους ο μεν θερισμος πολυς οι δε εργαται ολιγοι δεηθητε ουν του κυριου του θερισμου οπως εκβαλλη εργατας εις τον θερισμον αυτου
kjv: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

vulg: ite ecce ego mitto vos sicut agnos inter lupos
clem: Ite: ecce ego mitto vos sicut agnos inter lupos.
tr: υπαγετε ιδου εγω αποστελλω υμας ως αρνας εν μεσω λυκων
kjv: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

vulg: nolite portare sacculum neque peram neque calciamenta et neminem per viam salutaveritis
clem: Nolite portare sacculum, neque peram, neque calceamenta, et neminem per viam salutaveritis.
tr: μη βασταζετε βαλαντιον μη πηραν μηδε υποδηματα και μηδενα κατα την οδον ασπασησθε
kjv: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.

vulg: in quamcumque domum intraveritis primum dicite pax huic domui
clem: In quamcumque domum intraveritis, primum dicite: Pax huic domui:
tr: εις ην δ αν οικιαν εισερχησθε πρωτον λεγετε ειρηνη τω οικω τουτω
kjv: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.

vulg: et si ibi fuerit filius pacis requiescet super illam pax vestra sin autem ad vos revertetur
clem: et si ibi fuerit filius pacis, requiescet super illum pax vestra: sin autem, ad vos revertetur.
tr: και εαν μεν η εκει  ο  υιος ειρηνης επαναπαυσεται επ αυτον η ειρηνη υμων ει δε μηγε εφ υμας ανακαμψει
kjv: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

vulg: in eadem autem domo manete edentes et bibentes quae apud illos sunt dignus enim est operarius mercede sua nolite transire de domo in domum
clem: In eadem autem domo manete, edentes et bibentes qu apud illos sunt: dignus est enim operarius mercede sua. Nolite transire de domo in domum.
tr: εν αυτη δε τη οικια μενετε εσθιοντες και πινοντες τα παρ αυτων αξιος γαρ ο εργατης του μισθου αυτου εστιν μη μεταβαινετε εξ οικιας εις οικιαν
kjv: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.

vulg: et in quamcumque civitatem intraveritis et susceperint vos manducate quae adponuntur vobis
clem: Et in quamcumque civitatem intraveritis, et susceperint vos, manducate qu apponuntur vobis:
tr: και εις ην δ αν πολιν εισερχησθε και δεχωνται υμας εσθιετε τα παρατιθεμενα υμιν
kjv: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:

vulg: et curate infirmos qui in illa sunt et dicite illis adpropinquavit in vos regnum Dei
clem: et curate infirmos, qui in illa sunt, et dicite illis: Appropinquavit in vos regnum Dei.
tr: και θεραπευετε τους εν αυτη ασθενεις και λεγετε αυτοις ηγγικεν εφ υμας η βασιλεια του θεου
kjv: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

vulg: in quamcumque civitatem intraveritis et non receperint vos exeuntes in plateas eius dicite
clem: In quamcumque autem civitatem intraveritis, et non susceperint vos, exeuntes in plateas ejus, dicite:
tr: εις ην δ αν πολιν εισερχησθε και μη δεχωνται υμας εξελθοντες εις τας πλατειας αυτης ειπατε
kjv: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,

vulg: etiam pulverem qui adhesit nobis de civitate vestra extergimus in vos tamen hoc scitote quia adpropinquavit regnum Dei
clem: Etiam pulverem, qui adhsit nobis de civitate vestra, extergimus in vos: tamen hoc scitote, quia appropinquavit regnum Dei.
tr: και τον κονιορτον τον κολληθεντα ημιν εκ της πολεως υμων απομασσομεθα υμιν πλην τουτο γινωσκετε οτι ηγγικεν εφ υμας η βασιλεια του θεου
kjv: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

vulg: dico vobis quia Sodomis in die illa remissius erit quam illi civitati
clem: Dico vobis, quia Sodomis in die illa remissius erit, quam illi civitati.
tr: λεγω δε υμιν οτι σοδομοις εν τη ημερα εκεινη ανεκτοτερον εσται η τη πολει εκεινη
kjv: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

vulg: vae tibi Corazain vae tibi Bethsaida quia si in Tyro et Sidone factae fuissent virtutes quae in vobis factae sunt olim in cilicio et cinere sedentes paeniterent
clem: V tibi Corozain! v tibi Bethsaida! quia si in Tyro et Sidone fact fuissent virtutes qu fact sunt in vobis, olim in cilicio et cinere sedentes pniterent.
tr: ουαι σοι χωραζιν ουαι σοι βηθσαιδα οτι ει εν τυρω και σιδωνι εγενοντο αι δυναμεις αι γενομεναι εν υμιν παλαι αν εν σακκω και σποδω καθημεναι μετενοησαν
kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

vulg: verumtamen Tyro et Sidoni remissius erit in iudicio quam vobis
clem: Verumtamen Tyro et Sidoni remissius erit in judicio, quam vobis.
tr: πλην τυρω και σιδωνι ανεκτοτερον εσται εν τη κρισει η υμιν
kjv: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.

vulg: et tu Capharnaum usque in caelum exaltata usque ad infernum demergeris
clem: Et tu Capharnaum, usque ad clum exaltata, usque ad infernum demergeris.
tr: και συ καπερναουμ η εως του ουρανου υψωθεισα εως αδου καταβιβασθηση
kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.

vulg: qui vos audit me audit et qui vos spernit me spernit qui autem me spernit spernit eum qui me misit
clem: Qui vos audit, me audit: et qui vos spernit, me spernit. Qui autem me spernit, spernit eum qui misit me.
tr: ο ακουων υμων εμου ακουει και ο αθετων υμας εμε αθετει ο δε εμε αθετων αθετει τον αποστειλαντα με
kjv: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.

vulg: reversi sunt autem septuaginta duo cum gaudio dicentes Domine etiam daemonia subiciuntur nobis in nomine tuo
clem: Reversi sunt autem septuaginta duo cum gaudio, dicentes: Domine, etiam dmonia subjiciuntur nobis in nomine tuo.
tr: υπεστρεψαν δε οι εβδομηκοντα μετα χαρας λεγοντες κυριε και τα δαιμονια υποτασσεται ημιν εν τω ονοματι σου
kjv: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.

vulg: et ait illis videbam Satanan sicut fulgur de caelo cadentem
clem: Et ait illis: Videbam Satanam sicut fulgor de clo cadentem.
tr: ειπεν δε αυτοις εθεωρουν τον σαταναν ως αστραπην εκ του ουρανου πεσοντα
kjv: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

vulg: ecce dedi vobis potestatem calcandi supra serpentes et scorpiones et supra omnem virtutem inimici et nihil vobis nocebit
clem: Ecce dedi vobis potestatem calcandi supra serpentes, et scorpiones, et super omnem virtutem inimici: et nihil vobis nocebit.
tr: ιδου διδωμι υμιν την εξουσιαν του πατειν επανω οφεων και σκορπιων και επι πασαν την δυναμιν του εχθρου και ουδεν υμας ου μη αδικηση  αδικησει
kjv: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

vulg: verumtamen in hoc nolite gaudere quia spiritus vobis subiciuntur gaudete autem quod nomina vestra scripta sunt in caelis
clem: Verumtamen in hoc nolite gaudere quia spiritus vobis subjiciuntur: gaudete autem, quod nomina vestra scripta sunt in clis.
tr: πλην εν τουτω μη χαιρετε οτι τα πνευματα υμιν υποτασσεται χαιρετε δε μαλλον οτι τα ονοματα υμων εγραφη εν τοις ουρανοις
kjv: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

vulg: in ipsa hora exultavit Spiritu Sancto et dixit confiteor tibi Pater Domine caeli et terrae quod abscondisti haec a sapientibus et prudentibus et revelasti ea parvulis etiam Pater quia sic placuit ante te
clem: In ipsa hora exsultavit Spiritu Sancto, et dixit: Confiteor tibi Pater, Domine cli et terr, quod abscondisti hc a sapientibus et prudentibus, et revelasti ea parvulis. Etiam Pater: quoniam sic placuit ante te.
tr: εν αυτη τη ωρα ηγαλλιασατο τω πνευματι ο ιησους και ειπεν εξομολογουμαι σοι πατερ κυριε του ουρανου και της γης οτι απεκρυψας ταυτα απο σοφων και συνετων και απεκαλυψας αυτα νηπιοις ναι ο πατηρ οτι ουτως εγενετο ευδοκια εμπροσθεν σου
kjv: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.

vulg: omnia mihi tradita sunt a Patre meo et nemo scit qui sit Filius nisi Pater et qui sit Pater nisi Filius et cui voluerit Filius revelare
clem: Omnia mihi tradita sunt a Patre meo. Et nemo scit quis sit Filius, nisi Pater: et quis sit Pater, nisi Filius, et cui voluerit Filius revelare.
tr: και στραφεις προς τους μαθητας ειπεν   παντα παρεδοθη μοι υπο του πατρος μου και ουδεις γινωσκει τις εστιν ο υιος ει μη ο πατηρ και τις εστιν ο πατηρ ει μη ο υιος και ω εαν βουληται ο υιος αποκαλυψαι
kjv: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.

vulg: et conversus ad discipulos suos dixit beati oculi qui vident quae videtis
clem: Et conversus ad discipulos suos, dixit: Beati oculi qui vident qu vos videtis.
tr: και στραφεις προς τους μαθητας κατ ιδιαν ειπεν μακαριοι οι οφθαλμοι οι βλεποντες α βλεπετε
kjv: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:

vulg: dico enim vobis quod multi prophetae et reges voluerunt videre quae vos videtis et non viderunt et audire quae auditis et non audierunt
clem: Dico enim vobis quod multi prophet et reges voluerunt videre qu vos videtis, et non viderunt: et audire qu auditis, et non audierunt.
tr: λεγω γαρ υμιν οτι πολλοι προφηται και βασιλεις ηθελησαν ιδειν α υμεις βλεπετε και ουκ ειδον και ακουσαι α ακουετε και ουκ ηκουσαν
kjv: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

vulg: et ecce quidam legis peritus surrexit temptans illum et dicens magister quid faciendo vitam aeternam possidebo
clem: Et ecce quidam legisperitus surrexit tentans illum, et dicens: Magister, quid faciendo vitam ternam possidebo?
tr: και ιδου νομικος τις ανεστη εκπειραζων αυτον και λεγων διδασκαλε τι ποιησας ζωην αιωνιον κληρονομησω
kjv: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

vulg: at ille dixit ad eum in lege quid scriptum est quomodo legis
clem: At ille dixit ad eum: In lege quid scriptum est? quomodo legis?
tr: ο δε ειπεν προς αυτον εν τω νομω τι γεγραπται πως αναγινωσκεις
kjv: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?

vulg: ille respondens dixit diliges Dominum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo et ex tota anima tua et ex omnibus viribus tuis et ex omni mente tua et proximum tuum sicut te ipsum
clem: Ille respondens dixit: Diliges Dominum Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo, et ex tota anima tua, et ex omnibus virtutibus tuis, et ex omni mente tua: et proximum tuum sicut teipsum.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν αγαπησεις κυριον τον θεον σου εξ ολης της καρδιας σου και εξ ολης της ψυχης σου και εξ ολης της ισχυος σου και εξ ολης της διανοιας σου και τον πλησιον σου ως σεαυτον
kjv: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

vulg: dixitque illi recte respondisti hoc fac et vives
clem: Dixitque illi: Recte respondisti: hoc fac, et vives.
tr: ειπεν δε αυτω ορθως απεκριθης τουτο ποιει και ζηση
kjv: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.

vulg: ille autem volens iustificare se ipsum dixit ad Iesum et quis est meus proximus
clem: Ille autem volens justificare seipsum, dixit ad Jesum: Et quis est meus proximus?
tr: ο δε θελων δικαιουν εαυτον ειπεν προς τον ιησουν και τις εστιν μου πλησιον
kjv: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?

vulg: suscipiens autem Iesus dixit homo quidam descendebat ab Hierusalem in Hiericho et incidit in latrones qui etiam despoliaverunt eum et plagis inpositis abierunt semivivo relicto
clem: Suscipiens autem Jesus, dixit: Homo quidam descendebat ab Jerusalem in Jericho, et incidit in latrones, qui etiam despoliaverunt eum: et plagis impositis abierunt semivivo relicto.
tr: υπολαβων δε ο ιησους ειπεν ανθρωπος τις κατεβαινεν απο ιερουσαλημ εις ιεριχω και λησταις περιεπεσεν οι και εκδυσαντες αυτον και πληγας επιθεντες απηλθον αφεντες ημιθανη τυγχανοντα
kjv: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

vulg: accidit autem ut sacerdos quidam descenderet eadem via et viso illo praeterivit
clem: Accidit autem ut sacerdos quidam descenderet eadem via: et viso illo prterivit.
tr: κατα συγκυριαν δε ιερευς τις κατεβαινεν εν τη οδω εκεινη και ιδων αυτον αντιπαρηλθεν
kjv: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

vulg: similiter et Levita cum esset secus locum et videret eum pertransiit
clem: Similiter et Levita, cum esset secus locum, et videret eum, pertransiit.
tr: ομοιως δε και λευιτης γενομενος κατα τον τοπον ελθων και ιδων αντιπαρηλθεν
kjv: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.

vulg: Samaritanus autem quidam iter faciens venit secus eum et videns eum misericordia motus est
clem: Samaritanus autem quidam iter faciens, venit secus eum: et videns eum, misericordia motus est.
tr: σαμαρειτης δε τις οδευων ηλθεν κατ αυτον και ιδων αυτον εσπλαγχνισθη
kjv: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,

vulg: et adpropians alligavit vulnera eius infundens oleum et vinum et inponens illum in iumentum suum duxit in stabulum et curam eius egit
clem: Et appropians alligavit vulnera ejus, infundens oleum et vinum: et imponens illum in jumentum suum, duxit in stabulum, et curam ejus egit.
tr: και προσελθων κατεδησεν τα τραυματα αυτου επιχεων ελαιον και οινον επιβιβασας δε αυτον επι το ιδιον κτηνος ηγαγεν αυτον εις πανδοχειον και επεμεληθη αυτου
kjv: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

vulg: et altera die protulit duos denarios et dedit stabulario et ait curam illius habe et quodcumque supererogaveris ego cum rediero reddam tibi
clem: Et altera die protulit duos denarios, et dedit stabulario, et ait: Curam illius habe: et quodcumque supererogaveris, ego cum rediero reddam tibi.
tr: και επι την αυριον εξελθων εκβαλων δυο δηναρια εδωκεν τω πανδοχει και ειπεν αυτω επιμεληθητι αυτου και ο τι αν προσδαπανησης εγω εν τω επανερχεσθαι με αποδωσω σοι
kjv: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

vulg: quis horum trium videtur tibi proximus fuisse illi qui incidit in latrones
clem: Quis horum trium videtur tibi proximus fuisse illi, qui incidit in latrones?
tr: τις ουν τουτων των τριων δοκει σοι πλησιον γεγονεναι του εμπεσοντος εις τους ληστας
kjv: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?

vulg: at ille dixit qui fecit misericordiam in illum et ait illi Iesus vade et tu fac similiter
clem: At ille dixit: Qui fecit misericordiam in illum. Et ait illi Jesus: Vade, et tu fac similiter.
tr: ο δε ειπεν ο ποιησας το ελεος μετ αυτου ειπεν ουν αυτω ο ιησους πορευου και συ ποιει ομοιως
kjv: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

vulg: factum est autem dum irent et ipse intravit in quoddam castellum et mulier quaedam Martha nomine excepit illum in domum suam
clem: Factum est autem, dum irent, et ipse intravit in quoddam castellum: et mulier qudam, Martha nomine, excepit illum in domum suam,
tr: εγενετο δε εν τω πορευεσθαι αυτους και αυτος εισηλθεν εις κωμην τινα γυνη δε τις ονοματι μαρθα υπεδεξατο αυτον εις τον οικον αυτης
kjv: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

vulg: et huic erat soror nomine Maria quae etiam sedens secus pedes Domini audiebat verbum illius
clem: et huic erat soror nomine Maria, qu etiam sedens secus pedes Domini, audiebat verbum illius.
tr: και τηδε ην αδελφη καλουμενη μαρια η και παρακαθισασα παρα τους ποδας του ιησου ηκουεν τον λογον αυτου
kjv: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

vulg: Martha autem satagebat circa frequens ministerium quae stetit et ait Domine non est tibi curae quod soror mea reliquit me solam ministrare dic ergo illi ut me adiuvet
clem: Martha autem satagebat circa frequens ministerium: qu stetit, et ait: Domine, non est tibi cur quod soror mea reliquit me solam ministrare? dic ergo illi ut me adjuvet.
tr: η δε μαρθα περιεσπατο περι πολλην διακονιαν επιστασα δε ειπεν κυριε ου μελει σοι οτι η αδελφη μου μονην με κατελιπεν διακονειν ειπε ουν αυτη ινα μοι συναντιλαβηται
kjv: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

vulg: et respondens dixit illi Dominus Martha Martha sollicita es et turbaris erga plurima
clem: Et respondens dixit illis Dominus: Martha, Martha, sollicita es, et turbaris erga plurima,
tr: αποκριθεις δε ειπεν αυτη ο ιησους μαρθα μαρθα μεριμνας και τυρβαζη περι πολλα
kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:

vulg: porro unum est necessarium Maria optimam partem elegit quae non auferetur ab ea
clem: porro unum est necessarium. Maria optimam partem elegit, qu non auferetur ab ea.
tr: ενος δε εστιν χρεια μαρια δε την αγαθην μεριδα εξελεξατο ητις ουκ αφαιρεθησεται απ αυτης
kjv: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

vulg: et factum est cum esset in loco quodam orans ut cessavit dixit unus ex discipulis eius ad eum Domine doce nos orare sicut et Iohannes docuit discipulos suos
clem: Et factum est: cum esset in quodam loco orans, ut cessavit, dixit unus ex discipulis ejus ad eum: Domine, doce nos orare, sicut docuit et Joannes discipulos suos.
tr: και εγενετο εν τω ειναι αυτον εν τοπω τινι προσευχομενον ως επαυσατο ειπεν τις των μαθητων αυτου προς αυτον κυριε διδαξον ημας προσευχεσθαι καθως και ιωαννης εδιδαξεν τους μαθητας αυτου
kjv: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

vulg: et ait illis cum oratis dicite Pater sanctificetur nomen tuum adveniat regnum tuum
clem: Et ait illis: Cum oratis, dicite: Pater, sanctificetur nomen tuum. Adveniat regnum tuum.
tr: ειπεν δε αυτοις οταν προσευχησθε λεγετε πατερ ημων ο εν τοις ουρανοις αγιασθητω το ονομα σου ελθετω η βασιλεια σου γενηθητω το θελημα σου ως εν ουρανω και επι της γης
kjv: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.

vulg: panem nostrum cotidianum da nobis cotidie
clem: Panem nostrum quotidianum da nobis hodie.
tr: τον αρτον ημων τον επιουσιον διδου ημιν το καθ ημεραν
kjv: Give us day by day our daily bread.

vulg: et dimitte nobis peccata nostra siquidem et ipsi dimittimus omni debenti nobis et ne nos inducas in temptationem
clem: Et dimitte nobis peccata nostra, siquidem et ipsi dimittimus omni debenti nobis. Et ne nos inducas in tentationem.
tr: και αφες ημιν τας αμαρτιας ημων και γαρ αυτοι αφιεμεν παντι οφειλοντι ημιν και μη εισενεγκης ημας εις πειρασμον αλλα ρυσαι ημας απο του πονηρου
kjv: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.

vulg: et ait ad illos quis vestrum habebit amicum et ibit ad illum media nocte et dicit illi amice commoda mihi tres panes
clem: Et ait ad illos: Quis vestrum habebit amicum, et ibit ad illum media nocte, et dicet illi: Amice, commoda mihi tres panes,
tr: και ειπεν προς αυτους τις εξ υμων εξει φιλον και πορευσεται προς αυτον μεσονυκτιου και ειπη αυτω φιλε χρησον μοι τρεις αρτους
kjv: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

vulg: quoniam amicus meus venit de via ad me et non habeo quod ponam ante illum
clem: quoniam amicus meus venit de via ad me, et non habeo quod ponam ante illum,
tr: επειδη φιλος μου παρεγενετο εξ οδου προς με και ουκ εχω ο παραθησω αυτω
kjv: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?

vulg: et ille de intus respondens dicat noli mihi molestus esse iam ostium clausum est et pueri mei mecum sunt in cubili non possum surgere et dare tibi
clem: et ille de intus respondens dicat: Noli mihi molestus esse, jam ostrium clausum est, et pueri mei mecum sunt in cubili: non possum surgere, et dare tibi.
tr: κακεινος εσωθεν αποκριθεις ειπη μη μοι κοπους παρεχε ηδη η θυρα κεκλεισται και τα παιδια μου μετ εμου εις την κοιτην εισιν ου δυναμαι αναστας δουναι σοι
kjv: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

vulg: dico vobis et si non dabit illi surgens eo quod amicus eius sit propter inprobitatem tamen eius surget et dabit illi quotquot habet necessarios
clem: Et si ille perseveraverit pulsans: dico vobis, etsi non dabit illi surgens eo quod amicus ejus sit, propter improbitatem tamen ejus surget, et dabit illi quotquot habet necessarios.
tr: λεγω υμιν ει και ου δωσει αυτω αναστας δια το ειναι αυτου φιλον δια γε την αναιδειαν αυτου εγερθεις δωσει αυτω οσων χρηζει
kjv: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.

vulg: et ego vobis dico petite et dabitur vobis quaerite et invenietis pulsate et aperietur vobis
clem: Et ego dico vobis: Petite, et dabitur vobis; qurite, et invenietis; pulsate, et aperietur vobis.
tr: καγω υμιν λεγω αιτειτε και δοθησεται υμιν ζητειτε και ευρησετε κρουετε και ανοιγησεται υμιν
kjv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

vulg: omnis enim qui petit accipit et qui quaerit invenit et pulsanti aperietur
clem: Omnis enim qui petit, accipit: et qui qurit, invenit: et pulsanti aperietur.
tr: πας γαρ ο αιτων λαμβανει και ο ζητων ευρισκει και τω κρουοντι ανοιγησεται
kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

vulg: quis autem ex vobis patrem petet panem numquid lapidem dabit illi aut piscem numquid pro pisce serpentem dabit illi
clem: Quis autem ex vobis patrem petit panem, numquid lapidem dabit illi? aut piscem, numquid pro pisce serpentem dabit illi?
tr: τινα δε υμων τον πατερα αιτησει ο υιος αρτον μη λιθον επιδωσει αυτω ει και ιχθυν μη αντι ιχθυος οφιν επιδωσει αυτω
kjv: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?

vulg: aut si petierit ovum numquid porriget illi scorpionem
clem: aut si petierit ovum, numquid porriget illi scorpionem?
tr: η και εαν αιτηση ωον μη επιδωσει αυτω σκορπιον
kjv: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?

vulg: si ergo vos cum sitis mali nostis bona data dare filiis vestris quanto magis Pater vester de caelo dabit spiritum bonum petentibus se
clem: Si ergo vos, cum sitis mali, nostis bona data dare filiis vestris: quanto magis Pater vester de clo dabit spiritum bonum petentibus se?
tr: ει ουν υμεις πονηροι υπαρχοντες οιδατε αγαθα δοματα διδοναι τοις τεκνοις υμων ποσω μαλλον ο πατηρ ο εξ ουρανου δωσει πνευμα αγιον τοις αιτουσιν αυτον
kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

vulg: et erat eiciens daemonium et illud erat mutum et cum eiecisset daemonium locutus est mutus et admiratae sunt turbae
clem: Et erat ejiciens dmonium, et illud erat mutum. Et cum ejecisset dmonium, locutus est mutus, et admirat sunt turb.
tr: και ην εκβαλλων δαιμονιον και αυτο ην κωφον εγενετο δε του δαιμονιου εξελθοντος ελαλησεν ο κωφος και εθαυμασαν οι οχλοι
kjv: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.

vulg: quidam autem ex eis dixerunt in Beelzebub principe daemoniorum eicit daemonia
clem: Quidam autem ex eis dixerunt: In Beelzebub principe dmoniorum ejicit dmonia.
tr: τινες δε εξ αυτων ειπον εν βεελζεβουλ αρχοντι των δαιμονιων εκβαλλει τα δαιμονια
kjv: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.

vulg: et alii temptantes signum de caelo quaerebant ab eo
clem: Et alii tentantes, signum de clo qurebant ab eo.
tr: ετεροι δε πειραζοντες σημειον παρ αυτου εζητουν εξ ουρανου
