vulg: dico vobis quod ita gaudium erit in caelo super uno peccatore paenitentiam habente quam super nonaginta novem iustis qui non indigent paenitentia
clem: Dico vobis quod ita gaudium erit in clo super uno peccatore pnitentiam agente, quam super nonaginta novem justis, qui non indigent pnitentia.
tr: λεγω υμιν οτι ουτως χαρα εσται εν τω ουρανω επι ενι αμαρτωλω μετανοουντι η επι εννενηκονταεννεα δικαιοις οιτινες ου χρειαν εχουσιν μετανοιας
kjv: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

vulg: aut quae mulier habens dragmas decem si perdiderit dragmam unam nonne accendit lucernam et everrit domum et quaerit diligenter donec inveniat
clem: Aut qu mulier habens drachmas decem, si perdiderit drachmam unam, nonne accendit lucernam, et everrit domum, et qurit diligenter, donec inveniat?
tr: η τις γυνη δραχμας εχουσα δεκα εαν απολεση δραχμην μιαν ουχι απτει λυχνον και σαροι την οικιαν και ζητει επιμελως εως οτου ευρη
kjv: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

vulg: et cum invenerit convocat amicas et vicinas dicens congratulamini mihi quia inveni dragmam quam perdideram
clem: Et cum invenerit convocat amicas et vicinas, dicens: Congratulamini mihi, quia inveni drachmam quam perdideram.
tr: και ευρουσα συγκαλειται τας φιλας και τας γειτονας λεγουσα συγχαρητε μοι οτι ευρον την δραχμην ην απωλεσα
kjv: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

vulg: ita dico vobis gaudium erit coram angelis Dei super uno peccatore paenitentiam agente
clem: Ita, dico vobis, gaudium erit coram angelis Dei super uno peccatore pnitentiam agente.
tr: ουτως λεγω υμιν χαρα γινεται ενωπιον των αγγελων του θεου επι ενι αμαρτωλω μετανοουντι
kjv: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

vulg: ait autem homo quidam habuit duos filios
clem: Ait autem: Homo quidam habuit duos filios:
tr: ειπεν δε ανθρωπος τις ειχεν δυο υιους
kjv: And he said, A certain man had two sons:

vulg: et dixit adulescentior ex illis patri pater da mihi portionem substantiae quae me contingit et divisit illis substantiam
clem: et dixit adolescentior ex illis patri: Pater, da mihi portionem substanti, qu me contingit. Et divisit illis substantiam.
tr: και ειπεν ο νεωτερος αυτων τω πατρι πατερ δος μοι το επιβαλλον μερος της ουσιας και διειλεν αυτοις τον βιον
kjv: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.

vulg: et non post multos dies congregatis omnibus adulescentior filius peregre profectus est in regionem longinquam et ibi dissipavit substantiam suam vivendo luxuriose
clem: Et non post multos dies, congregatis omnibus, adolescentior filius peregre profectus est in regionem longinquam, et ibi dissipavit substantiam suam vivendo luxuriose.
tr: και μετ ου πολλας ημερας συναγαγων απαντα ο νεωτερος υιος απεδημησεν εις χωραν μακραν και εκει διεσκορπισεν την ουσιαν αυτου ζων ασωτως
kjv: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.

vulg: et postquam omnia consummasset facta est fames valida in regione illa et ipse coepit egere
clem: Et postquam omnia consummasset, facta est fames valida in regione illa, et ipse cpit egere.
tr: δαπανησαντος δε αυτου παντα εγενετο λιμος ισχυρος κατα την χωραν εκεινην και αυτος ηρξατο υστερεισθαι
kjv: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.

vulg: et abiit et adhesit uni civium regionis illius et misit illum in villam suam ut pasceret porcos
clem: Et abiit, et adhsit uni civium regionis illius: et misit illum in villam suam ut pasceret porcos.
tr: και πορευθεις εκολληθη ενι των πολιτων της χωρας εκεινης και επεμψεν αυτον εις τους αγρους αυτου βοσκειν χοιρους
kjv: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

vulg: et cupiebat implere ventrem suum de siliquis quas porci manducabant et nemo illi dabat
clem: Et cupiebat implere ventrem suum de siliquis, quas porci manducabant: et nemo illi dabat.
tr: και επεθυμει γεμισαι την κοιλιαν αυτου απο των κερατιων ων ησθιον οι χοιροι και ουδεις εδιδου αυτω
kjv: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.

vulg: in se autem reversus dixit quanti mercennarii patris mei abundant panibus ego autem hic fame pereo
clem: In se autem reversus, dixit: Quanti mercenarii in domo patris mei abundant panibus, ego autem hic fame pereo!
tr: εις εαυτον δε ελθων ειπεν ποσοι μισθιοι του πατρος μου περισσευουσιν αρτων εγω δε λιμω απολλυμαι
kjv: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!

vulg: surgam et ibo ad patrem meum et dicam illi pater peccavi in caelum et coram te
clem: surgam, et ibo ad patrem meum, et dicam ei: Pater, peccavi in clum, et coram te:
tr: αναστας πορευσομαι προς τον πατερα μου και ερω αυτω πατερ ημαρτον εις τον ουρανον και ενωπιον σου
kjv: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,

vulg: et iam non sum dignus vocari filius tuus fac me sicut unum de mercennariis tuis
clem: jam non sum dignus vocari filius tuus: fac me sicut unum de mercenariis tuis.
tr: και ουκετι ειμι αξιος κληθηναι υιος σου ποιησον με ως ενα των μισθιων σου
kjv: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

vulg: et surgens venit ad patrem suum cum autem adhuc longe esset vidit illum pater ipsius et misericordia motus est et adcurrens cecidit supra collum eius et osculatus est illum
clem: Et surgens venit ad patrem suum. Cum autem adhuc longe esset, vidit illum pater ipsius, et misericordia motus est, et accurrens cecidit super collum ejus, et osculatus est eum.
tr: και αναστας ηλθεν προς τον πατερα εαυτου ετι δε αυτου μακραν απεχοντος ειδεν αυτον ο πατηρ αυτου και εσπλαγχνισθη και δραμων επεπεσεν επι τον τραχηλον αυτου και κατεφιλησεν αυτον
kjv: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

vulg: dixitque ei filius pater peccavi in caelum et coram te iam non sum dignus vocari filius tuus
clem: Dixitque ei filius: Pater, peccavi in clum, et coram te: jam non sum dignus vocari filius tuus.
tr: ειπεν δε αυτω ο υιος πατερ ημαρτον εις τον ουρανον και ενωπιον σου και ουκετι ειμι αξιος κληθηναι υιος σου
kjv: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.

vulg: dixit autem pater ad servos suos cito proferte stolam primam et induite illum et date anulum in manum eius et calciamenta in pedes
clem: Dixit autem pater ad servos suos: Cito proferte stolam primam, et induite illum, et date annulum in manum ejus, et calceamenta in pedes ejus:
tr: ειπεν δε ο πατηρ προς τους δουλους αυτου εξενεγκατε την στολην την πρωτην και ενδυσατε αυτον και δοτε δακτυλιον εις την χειρα αυτου και υποδηματα εις τους ποδας
kjv: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:

vulg: et adducite vitulum saginatum et occidite et manducemus et epulemur
clem: et adducite vitulum saginatum, et occidite, et manducemus, et epulemur:
tr: και ενεγκαντες τον μοσχον τον σιτευτον θυσατε και φαγοντες ευφρανθωμεν
kjv: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:

vulg: quia hic filius meus mortuus erat et revixit perierat et inventus est et coeperunt epulari
clem: quia hic filius meus mortuus erat, et revixit: perierat, et inventus est. Et cperunt epulari.
tr: οτι ουτος ο υιος μου νεκρος ην και ανεζησεν και απολωλως ην και ευρεθη και ηρξαντο ευφραινεσθαι
kjv: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

vulg: erat autem filius eius senior in agro et cum veniret et adpropinquaret domui audivit symphoniam et chorum
clem: Erat autem filius ejus senior in agro: et cum veniret, et appropinquaret domui, audivit symphoniam et chorum:
tr: ην δε ο υιος αυτου ο πρεσβυτερος εν αγρω και ως ερχομενος ηγγισεν τη οικια ηκουσεν συμφωνιας και χορων
kjv: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.

vulg: et vocavit unum de servis et interrogavit quae haec essent
clem: et vocavit unum de servis, et interrogavit quid hc essent.
tr: και προσκαλεσαμενος ενα των παιδων αυτου   επυνθανετο τι ειη ταυτα
kjv: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.

vulg: isque dixit illi frater tuus venit et occidit pater tuus vitulum saginatum quia salvum illum recepit
clem: Isque dixit illi: Frater tuus venit, et occidit pater tuus vitulum saginatum, quia salvum illum recepit.
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτω οτι ο αδελφος σου ηκει και εθυσεν ο πατηρ σου τον μοσχον τον σιτευτον οτι υγιαινοντα αυτον απελαβεν
kjv: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.

vulg: indignatus est autem et nolebat introire pater ergo illius egressus coepit rogare illum
clem: Indignatus est autem, et nolebat introire. Pater ergo illius egressus, cpit rogare illum.
tr: ωργισθη δε και ουκ ηθελεν εισελθειν ο ουν πατηρ αυτου εξελθων παρεκαλει αυτον
kjv: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.

vulg: at ille respondens dixit patri suo ecce tot annis servio tibi et numquam mandatum tuum praeterii et numquam dedisti mihi hedum ut cum amicis meis epularer
clem: At ille respondens, dixit patri suo: Ecce tot annis servio tibi, et numquam mandatum tuum prterivi: et numquam dedisti mihi hdum ut cum amicis meis epularer.
tr: ο δε αποκριθεις ειπεν τω πατρι ιδου τοσαυτα ετη δουλευω σοι και ουδεποτε εντολην σου παρηλθον και εμοι ουδεποτε εδωκας εριφον ινα μετα των φιλων μου ευφρανθω
kjv: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

vulg: sed postquam filius tuus hic qui devoravit substantiam suam cum meretricibus venit occidisti illi vitulum saginatum
clem: Sed postquam filius tuus hic, qui devoravit substantiam suam cum meretricibus, venit, occidisti illi vitulum saginatum.
tr: οτε δε ο υιος σου ουτος ο καταφαγων σου τον βιον μετα πορνων ηλθεν εθυσας αυτω τον μοσχον τον σιτευτον
kjv: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.

vulg: at ipse dixit illi fili tu semper mecum es et omnia mea tua sunt
clem: At ipse dixit illi: Fili, tu semper mecum es, et omnia mea tua sunt:
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτω τεκνον συ παντοτε μετ εμου ει και παντα τα εμα σα εστιν
kjv: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.

vulg: epulari autem et gaudere oportebat quia frater tuus hic mortuus erat et revixit perierat et inventus est
clem: epulari autem, et gaudere oportebat, quia frater tuus hic mortuus erat, et revixit; perierat, et inventus est.
tr: ευφρανθηναι δε και χαρηναι εδει οτι ο αδελφος σου ουτος νεκρος ην και ανεζησεν και απολωλως ην και ευρεθη
kjv: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

vulg: dicebat autem et ad discipulos suos homo quidam erat dives qui habebat vilicum et hic diffamatus est apud illum quasi dissipasset bona ipsius
clem: Dicebat autem et ad discipulos suos: Homo quidam erat dives, qui habebat villicum: et hic diffamatus est apud illum quasi dissipasset bona ipsius.
tr: ελεγεν δε και προς τους μαθητας αυτου ανθρωπος τις ην πλουσιος ος ειχεν οικονομον και ουτος διεβληθη αυτω ως διασκορπιζων τα υπαρχοντα αυτου
kjv: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.

vulg: et vocavit illum et ait illi quid hoc audio de te redde rationem vilicationis tuae iam enim non poteris vilicare
clem: Et vocavit illum, et ait illi: Quid hoc audio de te? redde rationem villicationis tu: jam enim non poteris villicare.
tr: και φωνησας αυτον ειπεν αυτω τι τουτο ακουω περι σου αποδος τον λογον της οικονομιας σου ου γαρ δυνηση ετι οικονομειν
kjv: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.

vulg: ait autem vilicus intra se quid faciam quia dominus meus aufert a me vilicationem fodere non valeo mendicare erubesco
clem: Ait autem villicus intra se: Quid faciam? quia dominus meus aufert a me villicationem. Fodere non valeo, mendicare erubesco.
tr: ειπεν δε εν εαυτω ο οικονομος τι ποιησω οτι ο κυριος μου αφαιρειται την οικονομιαν απ εμου σκαπτειν ουκ ισχυω επαιτειν αισχυνομαι
kjv: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

vulg: scio quid faciam ut cum amotus fuero a vilicatione recipiant me in domos suas
clem: Scio quid faciam, ut, cum amotus fuero a villicatione, recipiant me in domos suas.
tr: εγνων τι ποιησω ινα οταν μετασταθω της οικονομιας δεξωνται με εις τους οικους αυτων
kjv: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

vulg: convocatis itaque singulis debitoribus domini sui dicebat primo quantum debes domino meo
clem: Convocatis itaque singulis debitoribus domini sui, dicebat primo: Quantum debes domino meo?
tr: και προσκαλεσαμενος ενα εκαστον των χρεωφειλετων του κυριου εαυτου ελεγεν τω πρωτω ποσον οφειλεις τω κυριω μου
kjv: So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?

vulg: at ille dixit centum cados olei dixitque illi accipe cautionem tuam et sede cito scribe quinquaginta
clem: At ille dixit: Centum cados olei. Dixitque illi: Accipe cautionem tuam: et sede cito, scribe quinquaginta.
tr: ο δε ειπεν εκατον βατους ελαιου και ειπεν αυτω δεξαι σου το γραμμα και καθισας ταχεως γραψον πεντηκοντα
kjv: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.

vulg: deinde alio dixit tu vero quantum debes qui ait centum choros tritici ait illi accipe litteras tuas et scribe octoginta
clem: Deinde alii dixit: Tu vero quantum debes? Qui ait: Centum coros tritici. Ait illi: Accipe litteras tuas, et scribe octoginta.
tr: επειτα ετερω ειπεν συ δε ποσον οφειλεις ο δε ειπεν εκατον κορους σιτου και λεγει αυτω δεξαι σου το γραμμα και γραψον ογδοηκοντα
kjv: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.

vulg: et laudavit dominus vilicum iniquitatis quia prudenter fecisset quia filii huius saeculi prudentiores filiis lucis in generatione sua sunt
clem: Et laudavit dominus villicum iniquitatis, quia prudenter fecisset: quia filii hujus sculi prudentiores filiis lucis in generatione sua sunt.
tr: και επηνεσεν ο κυριος τον οικονομον της αδικιας οτι φρονιμως εποιησεν οτι οι υιοι του αιωνος τουτου φρονιμωτεροι υπερ τους υιους του φωτος εις την γενεαν την   εαυτων εισιν
kjv: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.

vulg: et ego vobis dico facite vobis amicos de mamona iniquitatis ut cum defeceritis recipiant vos in aeterna tabernacula
clem: Et ego vobis dico: facite vobis amicos de mammona iniquitatis: ut, cum defeceritis, recipiant vos in terna tabernacula.
tr: καγω υμιν λεγω ποιησατε εαυτοις φιλους εκ του μαμωνα της αδικιας ινα οταν εκλιπητε δεξωνται υμας εις τας αιωνιους σκηνας
kjv: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.

vulg: qui fidelis est in minimo et in maiori fidelis est et qui in modico iniquus est et in maiori iniquus est
clem: Qui fidelis est in minimo, et in majori fidelis est: et qui in modico iniquus est, et in majori iniquus est.
tr: ο πιστος εν ελαχιστω και εν πολλω πιστος εστιν και ο εν ελαχιστω αδικος και εν πολλω αδικος εστιν
kjv: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

vulg: si ergo in iniquo mamona fideles non fuistis quod verum est quis credet vobis
clem: Si ergo in iniquo mammona fideles non fuistis quod verum est, quis credet vobis?
tr: ει ουν εν τω αδικω μαμωνα πιστοι ουκ εγενεσθε το αληθινον τις υμιν πιστευσει
kjv: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

vulg: et si in alieno fideles non fuistis quod vestrum est quis dabit vobis
clem: Et si in alieno fideles non fuistis, quod vestrum est, quis dabit vobis?
tr: και ει εν τω αλλοτριω πιστοι ουκ εγενεσθε το υμετερον τις υμιν δωσει
kjv: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?

vulg: nemo servus potest duobus dominis servire aut enim unum odiet et alterum diliget aut uni adherebit et alterum contemnet non potestis Deo servire et mamonae
clem: Nemo servus potest duobus dominis servire: aut enim unum odiet, et alterum diliget: aut uni adhrebit, et alterum contemnet. Non potestis Deo servire et mammon.
tr: ουδεις οικετης δυναται δυσιν κυριοις δουλευειν η γαρ τον ενα μισησει και τον ετερον αγαπησει η ενος ανθεξεται και του ετερου καταφρονησει ου δυνασθε θεω δουλευειν και μαμωνα
kjv: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

vulg: audiebant autem omnia haec Pharisaei qui erant avari et deridebant illum
clem: Audiebant autem omnia hc pharisi, qui erant avari: et deridebant illum.
tr: ηκουον δε ταυτα παντα και οι φαρισαιοι φιλαργυροι υπαρχοντες και εξεμυκτηριζον αυτον
kjv: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.

vulg: et ait illis vos estis qui iustificatis vos coram hominibus Deus autem novit corda vestra quia quod hominibus altum est abominatio est ante Deum
clem: Et ait illis: Vos estis qui justificatis vos coram hominibus: Deus autem novit corda vestra: quia quod hominibus altum est, abominatio est ante Deum.
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις υμεις εστε οι δικαιουντες εαυτους ενωπιον των ανθρωπων ο δε θεος γινωσκει τας καρδιας υμων οτι το εν ανθρωποις υψηλον βδελυγμα ενωπιον του θεου εστιν
kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

vulg: lex et prophetae usque ad Iohannem ex eo regnum Dei evangelizatur et omnis in illud vim facit
clem: Lex et prophet usque ad Joannem: ex eo regnum Dei evangelizatur, et omnis in illud vim facit.
tr: ο νομος και οι προφηται εως ιωαννου απο τοτε η βασιλεια του θεου ευαγγελιζεται και πας εις αυτην βιαζεται
kjv: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.

vulg: facilius est autem caelum et terram praeterire quam de lege unum apicem cadere
clem: Facilius est autem clum et terram prterire, quam de lege unum apicem cadere.
tr: ευκοπωτερον δε εστιν τον ουρανον και την γην παρελθειν η του νομου μιαν κεραιαν πεσειν
kjv: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.

vulg: omnis qui dimittit uxorem suam et ducit alteram moechatur et qui dimissam a viro ducit moechatur
clem: Omnis qui dimittit uxorem suam et alteram ducit, mchatur: et qui dimissam a viro ducit, mchatur.
tr: πας ο απολυων την γυναικα αυτου και γαμων ετεραν μοιχευει και πας ο απολελυμενην απο ανδρος γαμων μοιχευει
kjv: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.

vulg: homo quidam erat dives et induebatur purpura et bysso et epulabatur cotidie splendide
clem: Homo quidam erat dives, qui induebatur purpura et bysso, et epulabatur quotidie splendide.
tr: ανθρωπος δε τις ην πλουσιος και ενεδιδυσκετο πορφυραν και βυσσον ευφραινομενος καθ ημεραν λαμπρως
kjv: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:

vulg: et erat quidam mendicus nomine Lazarus qui iacebat ad ianuam eius ulceribus plenus
clem: Et erat quidam mendicus, nomine Lazarus, qui jacebat ad januam ejus, ulceribus plenus,
tr: πτωχος δε τις ην ονοματι λαζαρος ος εβεβλητο προς τον πυλωνα αυτου ηλκωμενος
kjv: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,

vulg: cupiens saturari de micis quae cadebant de mensa divitis sed et canes veniebant et lingebant ulcera eius
clem: cupiens saturari de micis qu cadebant de mensa divitis, et nemo illi dabat: sed et canes veniebant, et lingebant ulcera ejus.
tr: και επιθυμων χορτασθηναι απο των ψιχιων των πιπτοντων απο της τραπεζης του πλουσιου αλλα και οι κυνες ερχομενοι απελειχον τα ελκη αυτου
kjv: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.

vulg: factum est autem ut moreretur mendicus et portaretur ab angelis in sinum Abrahae mortuus est autem et dives et sepultus est in inferno
clem: Factum est autem ut moreretur mendicus, et portaretur ab angelis in sinum Abrah. Mortuus est autem et dives, et sepultus est in inferno.
tr: εγενετο δε αποθανειν τον πτωχον και απενεχθηναι αυτον υπο των αγγελων εις τον κολπον του αβρααμ απεθανεν δε και ο πλουσιος και εταφη
kjv: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

vulg: elevans oculos suos cum esset in tormentis videbat Abraham a longe et Lazarum in sinu eius
clem: Elevans autem oculos suos, cum esset in tormentis, vidit Abraham a longe, et Lazarum in sinu ejus:
tr: και εν τω αδη επαρας τους οφθαλμους αυτου υπαρχων εν βασανοις ορα τον αβρααμ απο μακροθεν και λαζαρον εν τοις κολποις αυτου
kjv: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

vulg: et ipse clamans dixit pater Abraham miserere mei et mitte Lazarum ut intinguat extremum digiti sui in aqua ut refrigeret linguam meam quia crucior in hac flamma
clem: et ipse clamans dixit: Pater Abraham, miserere mei, et mitte Lazarum ut intingat extremum digiti sui in aquam, ut refrigeret linguam meam, quia crucior in hac flamma.
tr: και αυτος φωνησας ειπεν πατερ αβρααμ ελεησον με και πεμψον λαζαρον ινα βαψη το ακρον του δακτυλου αυτου υδατος και καταψυξη την γλωσσαν μου οτι οδυνωμαι εν τη φλογι ταυτη
kjv: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.

vulg: et dixit illi Abraham fili recordare quia recepisti bona in vita tua et Lazarus similiter mala nunc autem hic consolatur tu vero cruciaris
clem: Et dixit illi Abraham: Fili, recordare quia recepisti bona in vita tua, et Lazarus similiter mala: nunc autem hic consolatur, tu vero cruciaris:
tr: ειπεν δε αβρααμ τεκνον μνησθητι οτι απελαβες συ τα αγαθα σου εν τη ζωη σου και λαζαρος ομοιως τα κακα νυν δε οδε παρακαλειται συ δε οδυνασαι
kjv: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.

vulg: et in his omnibus inter nos et vos chasma magnum firmatum est ut hii qui volunt hinc transire ad vos non possint neque inde huc transmeare
clem: et in his omnibus inter nos et vos chaos magnum firmatum est: ut hi qui volunt hinc transire ad vos, non possint, neque inde huc transmeare.
tr: και επι πασιν τουτοις μεταξυ ημων και υμων χασμα μεγα εστηρικται οπως οι θελοντες διαβηναι εντευθεν προς υμας μη δυνωνται μηδε οι εκειθεν προς ημας διαπερωσιν
kjv: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.

vulg: et ait rogo ergo te pater ut mittas eum in domum patris mei
clem: Et ait: Rogo ergo te, pater, ut mittas eum in domum patris mei:
tr: ειπεν δε ερωτω ουν σε πατερ ινα πεμψης αυτον εις τον οικον του πατρος μου
kjv: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:

vulg: habeo enim quinque fratres ut testetur illis ne et ipsi veniant in locum hunc tormentorum
clem: habeo enim quinque fratres: ut testetur illis, ne et ipsi veniant in hunc locum tormentorum.
tr: εχω γαρ πεντε αδελφους οπως διαμαρτυρηται αυτοις ινα μη και αυτοι ελθωσιν εις τον τοπον τουτον της βασανου
kjv: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

vulg: et ait illi Abraham habent Mosen et prophetas audiant illos
clem: Et ait illi Abraham: Habent Moysen et prophetas: audiant illos.
tr: λεγει αυτω αβρααμ εχουσιν μωσεα και τους προφητας ακουσατωσαν αυτων
kjv: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.

vulg: at ille dixit non pater Abraham sed si quis ex mortuis ierit ad eos paenitentiam agent
clem: At ille dixit: Non, pater Abraham: sed si quis ex mortuis ierit ad eos, pnitentiam agent.
tr: ο δε ειπεν ουχι πατερ αβρααμ αλλ εαν τις απο νεκρων πορευθη προς αυτους μετανοησουσιν
kjv: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.

vulg: ait autem illi si Mosen et prophetas non audiunt neque si quis ex mortuis resurrexerit credent
clem: Ait autem illi: Si Moysen et prophetas non audiunt, neque si quis ex mortuis resurrexerit, credent.
tr: ειπεν δε αυτω ει μωσεως και των προφητων ουκ ακουουσιν ουδε εαν τις εκ νεκρων αναστη πεισθησονται
kjv: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.

vulg: et ad discipulos suos ait inpossibile est ut non veniant scandala vae autem illi per quem veniunt
clem: Et ait ad discipulos suos: Impossibile est ut non veniant scandala: v autem illi per quem veniunt.
tr: ειπεν δε προς τους μαθητας ανενδεκτον εστιν του μη ελθειν τα σκανδαλα ουαι δε δι ου ερχεται
kjv: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!

vulg: utilius est illi si lapis molaris inponatur circa collum eius et proiciatur in mare quam ut scandalizet unum de pusillis istis
clem: Utilius est illi si lapis molaris imponatur circa collum ejus, et projiciatur in mare quam ut scandalizet unum de pusillis istis.
tr: λυσιτελει αυτω ει μυλος ονικος περικειται περι τον τραχηλον αυτου και ερριπται εις την θαλασσαν η ινα σκανδαλιση ενα των μικρων τουτων
kjv: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.

vulg: adtendite vobis si peccaverit frater tuus increpa illum et si paenitentiam egerit dimitte illi
clem: Attendite vobis: Si peccaverit in te frater tuus, increpa illum: et si pnitentiam egerit, dimitte illi.
tr: προσεχετε εαυτοις εαν δε αμαρτη εις σε ο αδελφος σου επιτιμησον αυτω και εαν μετανοηση αφες αυτω
kjv: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.

vulg: et si septies in die peccaverit in te et septies in die conversus fuerit ad te dicens paenitet me dimitte illi
clem: Et si septies in die peccaverit in te, et septies in die conversus fuerit ad te, dicens: Pnitet me, dimitte illi.
tr: και εαν επτακις της ημερας αμαρτη εις σε και επτακις της ημερας επιστρεψη επι σε λεγων μετανοω αφησεις αυτω
kjv: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.

vulg: et dixerunt apostoli Domino adauge nobis fidem
clem: Et dixerunt apostoli Domino: Adauge nobis fidem.
tr: και ειπον οι αποστολοι τω κυριω προσθες ημιν πιστιν
kjv: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.

vulg: dixit autem Dominus si haberetis fidem sicut granum sinapis diceretis huic arbori moro eradicare et transplantare in mare et oboediret vobis
clem: Dixit autem Dominus: Si habueritis fidem sicut granum sinapis, dicetis huic arbori moro: Eradicare, et transplantare in mare, et obediet vobis.
tr: ειπεν δε ο κυριος ει ειχετε πιστιν ως κοκκον σιναπεως ελεγετε αν τη συκαμινω ταυτη εκριζωθητι και φυτευθητι εν τη θαλασση και υπηκουσεν αν υμιν
kjv: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

vulg: quis autem vestrum habens servum arantem aut pascentem qui regresso de agro dicet illi statim transi recumbe
clem: Quis autem vestrum habens servum arantem aut pascentem, qui regresso de agro dicat illi: Statim transi, recumbe:
tr: τις δε εξ υμων δουλον εχων αροτριωντα η ποιμαινοντα ος εισελθοντι εκ του αγρου ερει ευθεως παρελθων αναπεσαι
kjv: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?

vulg: et non dicet ei para quod cenem et praecinge te et ministra mihi donec manducem et bibam et post haec tu manducabis et bibes
clem: et non dicat ei: Para quod cnem, et prcinge te, et ministra mihi donec manducem, et bibam, et post hc tu manducabis, et bibes?
tr: αλλ ουχι ερει αυτω ετοιμασον τι δειπνησω και περιζωσαμενος διακονει μοι εως φαγω και πιω και μετα ταυτα φαγεσαι και πιεσαι συ
kjv: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?

vulg: numquid gratiam habet servo illi quia fecit quae sibi imperaverat non puto
clem: Numquid gratiam habet servo illi, quia fecit qu ei imperaverat?
tr: μη χαριν εχει τω δουλω εκεινω οτι εποιησεν τα διαταχθεντα αυτω ου δοκω
kjv: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.

vulg: sic et vos cum feceritis omnia quae praecepta sunt vobis dicite servi inutiles sumus quod debuimus facere fecimus
clem: non puto. Sic et vos cum feceritis omnia qu prcepta sunt vobis, dicite: Servi inutiles sumus: quod debuimus facere, fecimus.
tr: ουτως και υμεις οταν ποιησητε παντα τα διαταχθεντα υμιν λεγετε οτι δουλοι αχρειοι εσμεν οτι ο ωφειλομεν ποιησαι πεποιηκαμεν
kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.

vulg: et factum est dum iret in Hierusalem transiebat per mediam Samariam et Galilaeam
clem: Et factum est, dum iret in Jerusalem, transibat per mediam Samariam et Galilam.
tr: και εγενετο εν τω πορευεσθαι αυτον εις ιερουσαλημ και αυτος διηρχετο δια μεσου σαμαρειας και γαλιλαιας
kjv: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

vulg: et cum ingrederetur quoddam castellum occurrerunt ei decem viri leprosi qui steterunt a longe
clem: Et cum ingrederetur quoddam castellum, occurrerunt ei decem viri leprosi, qui steterunt a longe:
tr: και εισερχομενου αυτου εις τινα κωμην απηντησαν αυτω δεκα λεπροι ανδρες οι εστησαν πορρωθεν
kjv: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:

vulg: et levaverunt vocem dicentes Iesu praeceptor miserere nostri
clem: et levaverunt vocem, dicentes: Jesu prceptor, miserere nostri.
tr: και αυτοι ηραν φωνην λεγοντες ιησου επιστατα ελεησον ημας
kjv: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

vulg: quos ut vidit dixit ite ostendite vos sacerdotibus et factum est dum irent mundati sunt
clem: Quos ut vidit, dixit: Ite, ostendite vos sacerdotibus. Et factum est, dum irent, mundati sunt.
tr: και ιδων ειπεν αυτοις πορευθεντες επιδειξατε εαυτους τοις ιερευσιν και εγενετο εν τω υπαγειν αυτους εκαθαρισθησαν
kjv: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.

vulg: unus autem ex illis ut vidit quia mundatus est regressus est cum magna voce magnificans Deum
clem: Unus autem ex illis, ut vidit quia mundatus est, regressus est, cum magna voce magnificans Deum,
tr: εις δε εξ αυτων ιδων οτι ιαθη υπεστρεψεν μετα φωνης μεγαλης δοξαζων τον θεον
kjv: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,

vulg: et cecidit in faciem ante pedes eius gratias agens et hic erat Samaritanus
clem: et cecidit in faciem ante pedes ejus, gratias agens: et hic erat Samaritanus.
tr: και επεσεν επι προσωπον παρα τους ποδας αυτου ευχαριστων αυτω και αυτος ην σαμαρειτης
kjv: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

vulg: respondens autem Iesus dixit nonne decem mundati sunt et novem ubi sunt
clem: Respondens autem Jesus, dixit: Nonne decem mundati sunt? et novem ubi sunt?
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ιησους ειπεν ουχι οι δεκα εκαθαρισθησαν οι δε εννεα που
kjv: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?

vulg: non est inventus qui rediret et daret gloriam Deo nisi hic alienigena
clem: Non est inventus qui rediret, et daret gloriam Deo, nisi hic alienigena.
tr: ουχ ευρεθησαν υποστρεψαντες δουναι δοξαν τω θεω ει μη ο αλλογενης ουτος
kjv: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.

vulg: et ait illi surge vade quia fides tua te salvum fecit
clem: Et ait illi: Surge, vade: quia fides tua te salvum fecit.
tr: και ειπεν αυτω αναστας πορευου η πιστις σου σεσωκεν σε
kjv: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.

vulg: interrogatus autem a Pharisaeis quando venit regnum Dei respondit eis et dixit non venit regnum Dei cum observatione
clem: Interrogatus autem a pharisis: Quando venit regnum Dei? respondens eis, dixit: Non venit regnum Dei cum observatione:
tr: επερωτηθεις δε υπο των φαρισαιων ποτε ερχεται η βασιλεια του θεου απεκριθη αυτοις και ειπεν ουκ ερχεται η βασιλεια του θεου μετα παρατηρησεως
kjv: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

vulg: neque dicent ecce hic aut ecce illic ecce enim regnum Dei intra vos est
clem: neque dicent: Ecce hic, aut ecce illic. Ecce enim regnum Dei intra vos est.
tr: ουδε ερουσιν ιδου ωδε η ιδου εκει ιδου γαρ η βασιλεια του θεου εντος υμων εστιν
kjv: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

vulg: et ait ad discipulos venient dies quando desideretis videre unum diem Filii hominis et non videbitis
clem: Et ait ad discipulos suos: Venient dies quando desideretis videre unum diem Filii hominis, et non videbitis.
tr: ειπεν δε προς τους μαθητας ελευσονται ημεραι οτε επιθυμησετε μιαν των ημερων του υιου του ανθρωπου ιδειν και ουκ οψεσθε
kjv: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.

vulg: et dicent vobis ecce hic ecce illic nolite ire neque sectemini
clem: Et dicent vobis: Ecce hic, et ecce illic. Nolite ire, neque sectemini:
tr: και ερουσιν υμιν ιδου ωδε η ιδου εκει μη απελθητε μηδε διωξητε
kjv: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.

vulg: nam sicut fulgur coruscans de sub caelo in ea quae sub caelo sunt fulget ita erit Filius hominis in die sua
clem: nam, sicut fulgur coruscans de sub clo in ea qu sub clo sunt, fulget: ita erit Filius hominis in die sua.
tr: ωσπερ γαρ η αστραπη η αστραπτουσα εκ της υπ ουρανον εις την υπ ουρανον λαμπει ουτως εσται και ο υιος του ανθρωπου εν τη ημερα αυτου
kjv: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

vulg: primum autem oportet illum multa pati et reprobari a generatione hac
clem: Primum autem oportet illum multa pati, et reprobari a generatione hac.
tr: πρωτον δε δει αυτον πολλα παθειν και αποδοκιμασθηναι απο της γενεας ταυτης
kjv: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.

vulg: et sicut factum est in diebus Noe ita erit et in diebus Filii hominis
clem: Et sicut factum est in diebus No, ita erit et in diebus Filii hominis:
tr: και καθως εγενετο εν ταις ημεραις του νωε ουτως εσται και εν ταις ημεραις του υιου του ανθρωπου
kjv: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

vulg: edebant et bibebant uxores ducebant et dabantur ad nuptias usque in diem qua intravit Noe in arcam et venit diluvium et perdidit omnes
clem: edebant et bibebant: uxores ducebant et dabantur ad nuptias, usque in diem, qua intravit No in arcam: et venit diluvium, et perdidit omnes.
tr: ησθιον επινον εγαμουν εξεγαμιζοντο αχρι ης ημερας εισηλθεν νωε εις την κιβωτον και ηλθεν ο κατακλυσμος και απωλεσεν απαντας
kjv: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

vulg: similiter sicut factum est in diebus Loth edebant et bibebant emebant et vendebant plantabant aedificabant
clem: Similiter sicut factum est in diebus Lot: edebant et bibebant, emebant et vendebant, plantabant et dificabant:
tr: ομοιως και ως εγενετο εν ταις ημεραις λωτ ησθιον επινον ηγοραζον επωλουν εφυτευον ωκοδομουν
kjv: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

vulg: qua die autem exiit Loth a Sodomis pluit ignem et sulphur de caelo et omnes perdidit
clem: qua die autem exiit Lot a Sodomis, pluit ignem et sulphur de clo, et omnes perdidit:
tr: η δε ημερα εξηλθεν λωτ απο σοδομων εβρεξεν πυρ και θειον απ ουρανου και απωλεσεν απαντας
kjv: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.

vulg: secundum haec erit qua die Filius hominis revelabitur
clem: secundum hc erit qua die Filius hominis revelabitur.
tr: κατα ταυτα εσται η ημερα ο υιος του ανθρωπου αποκαλυπτεται
kjv: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

vulg: in illa hora qui fuerit in tecto et vasa eius in domo ne descendat tollere illa et qui in agro similiter non redeat retro
clem: In illa hora, qui fuerit in tecto, et vasa ejus in domo, ne descendat tollere illa: et qui in agro, similiter non redeat retro.
tr: εν εκεινη τη ημερα ος εσται επι του δωματος και τα σκευη αυτου εν τη οικια μη καταβατω αραι αυτα και ο εν τω αγρω ομοιως μη επιστρεψατω εις τα οπισω
kjv: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.

vulg: memores estote uxoris Loth
clem: Memores estote uxoris Lot.
tr: μνημονευετε της γυναικος λωτ
kjv: Remember Lot's wife.

vulg: quicumque quaesierit animam suam salvare perdet illam et qui perdiderit illam vivificabit eam
clem: Quicumque qusierit animam suam salvam facere, perdet illam: et quicumque perdiderit illam, vivificabit eam.
tr: ος εαν ζητηση την ψυχην αυτου σωσαι απολεσει αυτην και ος εαν απολεση αυτην ζωογονησει αυτην
kjv: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.

vulg: dico vobis illa nocte erunt duo in lecto uno unus adsumetur et alter relinquetur
clem: Dico vobis: In illa nocte erunt duo in lecto uno: unus assumetur, et alter relinquetur:
tr: λεγω υμιν ταυτη τη νυκτι εσονται δυο επι κλινης μιας ο εις παραληφθησεται και ο ετερος αφεθησεται
kjv: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

vulg: duae erunt molentes in unum una adsumetur et altera relinquetur duo in agro unus adsumetur et alter relinquetur
clem: du erunt molentes in unum: una assumetur, et altera relinquetur: duo in agro: unus assumetur, et alter relinquetur.
tr: δυο εσονται αληθουσαι επι το αυτο  η  μια παραληφθησεται και η ετερα αφεθησεται
kjv: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

vulg: respondentes dicunt illi ubi Domine
clem: Respondentes dicunt illi: Ubi Domine?
tr: δυο εσονται εν τω αγρω ο εις παραληφθησεται και ο ετερος αφεθησεται
kjv: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

vulg: qui dixit eis ubicumque fuerit corpus illuc congregabuntur aquilae
clem: Qui dixit illis: Ubicumque fuerit corpus, illuc congregabuntur et aquil.
tr: και αποκριθεντες λεγουσιν αυτω που κυριε ο δε ειπεν αυτοις οπου το σωμα εκει συναχθησονται οι αετοι
kjv: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.

vulg: dicebat autem et parabolam ad illos quoniam oportet semper orare et non deficere
clem: Dicebat autem et parabolam ad illos, quoniam oportet semper orare et non deficere,
tr: ελεγεν δε και παραβολην αυτοις προς το δειν παντοτε προσευχεσθαι και μη εκκακειν
kjv: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

vulg: dicens iudex quidam erat in quadam civitate qui Deum non timebat et hominem non verebatur
clem: dicens: Judex quidam erat in quadam civitate, qui Deum non timebat, et hominem non reverebatur.
tr: λεγων κριτης τις ην εν τινι πολει τον θεον μη φοβουμενος και ανθρωπον μη εντρεπομενος
kjv: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

vulg: vidua autem quaedam erat in civitate illa et veniebat ad eum dicens vindica me de adversario meo
clem: Vidua autem qudam erat in civitate illa, et veniebat ad eum, dicens: Vindica me de adversario meo.
tr: χηρα δε ην εν τη πολει εκεινη και ηρχετο προς αυτον λεγουσα εκδικησον με απο του αντιδικου μου
kjv: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

vulg: et nolebat per multum tempus post haec autem dixit intra se et si Deum non timeo nec hominem revereor
clem: Et nolebat per multum tempus. Post hc autem dixit intra se: Etsi Deum non timeo, nec hominem revereor:
tr: και ουκ ηθελησεν επι χρονον μετα δε ταυτα ειπεν εν εαυτω ει και τον θεον ου φοβουμαι και ανθρωπον ουκ εντρεπομαι
kjv: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

vulg: tamen quia molesta est mihi haec vidua vindicabo illam ne in novissimo veniens suggillet me
clem: tamen quia molesta est mihi hc vidua, vindicabo illam, ne in novissimo veniens sugillet me.
tr: δια γε το παρεχειν μοι κοπον την χηραν ταυτην εκδικησω αυτην ινα μη εις τελος ερχομενη υπωπιαζη με
kjv: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.

vulg: ait autem Dominus audite quid iudex iniquitatis dicit
clem: Ait autem Dominus: Audite quid judex iniquitatis dicit:
tr: ειπεν δε ο κυριος ακουσατε τι ο κριτης της αδικιας λεγει
kjv: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

vulg: Deus autem non faciet vindictam electorum suorum clamantium ad se die ac nocte et patientiam habebit in illis
clem: Deus autem non faciet vindictam electorum suorum clamantium ad se die ac nocte, et patientiam habebit in illis?
tr: ο δε θεος ου μη ποιησει την εκδικησιν των εκλεκτων αυτου των βοωντων προς αυτον ημερας και νυκτος και μακροθυμων επ αυτοις
kjv: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

vulg: dico vobis quia cito faciet vindictam illorum verumtamen Filius hominis veniens putas inveniet fidem in terra
clem: Dico vobis quia cito faciet vindictam illorum. Verumtamen Filius hominis veniens, putas, inveniet fidem in terra?
tr: λεγω υμιν οτι ποιησει την εκδικησιν αυτων εν ταχει πλην ο υιος του ανθρωπου ελθων αρα ευρησει την πιστιν επι της γης
kjv: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

vulg: dixit autem et ad quosdam qui in se confidebant tamquam iusti et aspernabantur ceteros parabolam istam
clem: Dixit autem et ad quosdam qui in se confidebant tamquam justi, et aspernabantur ceteros, parabolam istam:
tr: ειπεν δε και προς τινας τους πεποιθοτας εφ εαυτοις οτι εισιν δικαιοι και εξουθενουντας τους λοιπους την παραβολην ταυτην
kjv: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

vulg: duo homines ascenderunt in templum ut orarent unus Pharisaeus et alter publicanus
clem: Duo homines ascenderunt in templum ut orarent: unus pharisus et alter publicanus.
tr: ανθρωποι δυο ανεβησαν εις το ιερον προσευξασθαι ο εις φαρισαιος και ο ετερος τελωνης
kjv: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

vulg: Pharisaeus stans haec apud se orabat Deus gratias ago tibi quia non sum sicut ceteri hominum raptores iniusti adulteri vel ut etiam hic publicanus
clem: Pharisus stans, hc apud se orabat: Deus, gratias ago tibi, quia non sum sicut ceteri hominum: raptores, injusti, adulteri, velut etiam hic publicanus:
tr: ο φαρισαιος σταθεις προς εαυτον ταυτα προσηυχετο ο θεος ευχαριστω σοι οτι ουκ ειμι ωσπερ οι λοιποι των ανθρωπων αρπαγες αδικοι μοιχοι η και ως ουτος ο τελωνης
kjv: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

vulg: ieiuno bis in sabbato decimas do omnium quae possideo
clem: jejuno bis in sabbato, decimas do omnium qu possideo.
tr: νηστευω δις του σαββατου αποδεκατω παντα οσα κτωμαι
kjv: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

vulg: et publicanus a longe stans nolebat nec oculos ad caelum levare sed percutiebat pectus suum dicens Deus propitius esto mihi peccatori
clem: Et publicanus a longe stans, nolebat nec oculos ad clum levare: sed percutiebat pectus suum, dicens: Deus propitius esto mihi peccatori.
tr: και ο τελωνης μακροθεν εστως ουκ ηθελεν ουδε τους οφθαλμους εις τον ουρανον επαραι αλλ ετυπτεν εις το στηθος αυτου λεγων ο θεος ιλασθητι μοι τω αμαρτωλω
kjv: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

vulg: dico vobis descendit hic iustificatus in domum suam ab illo quia omnis qui se exaltat humiliabitur et qui se humiliat exaltabitur
clem: Dico vobis, descendit hic justificatus in domum suam ab illo: quia omnis qui se exaltat, humiliabitur, et qui se humiliat, exaltabitur.
tr: λεγω υμιν κατεβη ουτος δεδικαιωμενος εις τον οικον αυτου η εκεινος οτι πας ο υψων εαυτον ταπεινωθησεται ο δε ταπεινων εαυτον υψωθησεται
kjv: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

vulg: adferebant autem ad illum et infantes ut eos tangeret quod cum viderent discipuli increpabant illos
clem: Afferebant autem ad illum et infantes, ut eos tangeret. Quod cum viderent discipuli, increpabant illos.
tr: προσεφερον δε αυτω και τα βρεφη ινα αυτων απτηται ιδοντες δε οι μαθηται επετιμησαν αυτοις
kjv: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

vulg: Iesus autem convocans illos dixit sinite pueros venire ad me et nolite eos vetare talium est enim regnum Dei
clem: Jesus autem convocans illos, dixit: Sinite pueros venire ad me, et nolite vetare eos: talium est enim regnum Dei.
tr: ο δε ιησους προσκαλεσαμενος αυτα ειπεν αφετε τα παιδια ερχεσθαι προς με και μη κωλυετε αυτα των γαρ τοιουτων εστιν η βασιλεια του θεου
kjv: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

vulg: amen dico vobis quicumque non acceperit regnum Dei sicut puer non intrabit in illud
clem: Amen dico vobis, quicumque non acceperit regnum Dei sicut puer, non intrabit in illud.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν ος εαν μη δεξηται την βασιλειαν του θεου ως παιδιον ου μη εισελθη εις αυτην
kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

vulg: et interrogavit eum quidam princeps dicens magister bone quid faciens vitam aeternam possidebo
clem: Et interrogavit eum quidam princeps, dicens: Magister bone, quid faciens vitam ternam possidebo?
tr: και επηρωτησεν τις αυτον αρχων λεγων διδασκαλε αγαθε τι ποιησας ζωην αιωνιον κληρονομησω
kjv: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

vulg: dixit autem ei Iesus quid me dicis bonum nemo bonus nisi solus Deus
clem: Dixit autem ei Jesus: Quid me dicis bonum? nemo bonus nisi solus Deus.
tr: ειπεν δε αυτω ο ιησους τι με λεγεις αγαθον ουδεις αγαθος ει μη εις ο θεος
kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.

vulg: mandata nosti non occides non moechaberis non furtum facies non falsum testimonium dices honora patrem tuum et matrem
clem: Mandata nosti: non occides; non mchaberis; non furtum facies; non falsum testimonium dices; honora patrem tuum et matrem.
tr: τας εντολας οιδας μη μοιχευσης μη φονευσης μη κλεψης μη ψευδομαρτυρησης τιμα τον πατερα σου και την μητερα σου
kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

vulg: qui ait haec omnia custodivi a iuventute mea
clem: Qui ait: Hc omnia custodivi a juventute mea.
tr: ο δε ειπεν ταυτα παντα εφυλαξαμην εκ νεοτητος μου
kjv: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.

vulg: quo audito Iesus ait ei adhuc unum tibi deest omnia quaecumque habes vende et da pauperibus et habebis thesaurum in caelo et veni sequere me
clem: Quo audito, Jesus ait ei: Adhuc unum tibi deest: omnia qucumque habes vende, et da pauperibus, et habebis thesaurum in clo: et veni, sequere me.
tr: ακουσας δε ταυτα ο ιησους ειπεν αυτω ετι εν σοι λειπει παντα οσα εχεις πωλησον και διαδος πτωχοις και εξεις θησαυρον εν ουρανω και δευρο ακολουθει μοι
kjv: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

vulg: his ille auditis contristatus est quia dives erat valde
clem: His ille auditis, contristatus est: quia dives erat valde.
tr: ο δε ακουσας ταυτα περιλυπος εγενετο ην γαρ πλουσιος σφοδρα
kjv: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

vulg: videns autem illum Iesus tristem factum dixit quam difficile qui pecunias habent in regnum Dei intrabunt
clem: Videns autem Jesus illum tristem factum, dixit: Quam difficile, qui pecunias habent, in regnum Dei intrabunt!
tr: ιδων δε αυτον ο ιησους περιλυπον γενομενον ειπεν πως δυσκολως οι τα χρηματα εχοντες εισελευσονται εις την βασιλειαν του θεου
kjv: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

vulg: facilius est enim camelum per foramen acus transire quam divitem intrare in regnum Dei
clem: facilius est enim camelum per foramen acus transire quam divitem intrare in regnum Dei.
tr: ευκοπωτερον γαρ εστιν καμηλον δια τρυμαλιας ραφιδος εισελθειν η πλουσιον εις την βασιλειαν του θεου εισελθειν
kjv: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

vulg: et dixerunt qui audiebant et quis potest salvus fieri
clem: Et dixerunt qui audiebant: Et quis potest salvus fieri?
tr: ειπον δε οι ακουσαντες και τις δυναται σωθηναι
kjv: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?

vulg: ait illis quae inpossibilia sunt apud homines possibilia sunt apud Deum
clem: Ait illis: Qu impossibilia sunt apud homines, possibilia sunt apud Deum.
tr: ο δε ειπεν τα αδυνατα παρα ανθρωποις δυνατα εστιν παρα τω θεω
kjv: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

vulg: ait autem Petrus ecce nos dimisimus omnia et secuti sumus te
clem: Ait autem Petrus: Ecce nos dimisimus omnia et secuti sumus te.
tr: ειπεν δε ο πετρος ιδου ημεις αφηκαμεν παντα και ηκολουθησαμεν σοι
kjv: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.

vulg: qui dixit eis amen dico vobis nemo est qui reliquit domum aut parentes aut fratres aut uxorem aut filios propter regnum Dei
clem: Qui dixit eis: Amen dico vobis, nemo est qui reliquit domum, aut parentes, aut fratres, aut uxorem, aut filios propter regnum Dei,
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτοις αμην λεγω υμιν οτι ουδεις εστιν ος αφηκεν οικιαν η γονεις η αδελφους η γυναικα η τεκνα ενεκεν της βασιλειας του θεου
kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,

vulg: et non recipiat multo plura in hoc tempore et in saeculo venturo vitam aeternam
clem: et non recipiat multo plura in hoc tempore, et in sculo venturo vitam ternam.
tr: ος ου μη απολαβη πολλαπλασιονα εν τω καιρω τουτω και εν τω αιωνι τω ερχομενω ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.

vulg: adsumpsit autem Iesus duodecim et ait illis ecce ascendimus Hierosolyma et consummabuntur omnia quae scripta sunt per prophetas de Filio hominis
clem: Assumpsit autem Jesus duodecim, et ait illis: Ecce ascendimus Jerosolymam, et consummabuntur omnia qu scripta sunt per prophetas de Filio hominis:
tr: παραλαβων δε τους δωδεκα ειπεν προς αυτους ιδου αναβαινομεν εις ιεροσολυμα και τελεσθησεται παντα τα γεγραμμενα δια των προφητων τω υιω του ανθρωπου
kjv: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

vulg: tradetur enim gentibus et inludetur et flagellabitur et conspuetur
clem: tradetur enim gentibus, et illudetur, et flagellabitur, et conspuetur:
tr: παραδοθησεται γαρ τοις εθνεσιν και εμπαιχθησεται και υβρισθησεται και εμπτυσθησεται
kjv: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:

vulg: et postquam flagellaverint occident eum et die tertia resurget
clem: et postquam flagellaverint, occident eum, et tertia die resurget.
tr: και μαστιγωσαντες αποκτενουσιν αυτον και τη ημερα τη τριτη αναστησεται
kjv: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.

vulg: et ipsi nihil horum intellexerunt et erat verbum istud absconditum ab eis et non intellegebant quae dicebantur
clem: Et ipsi nihil horum intellexerunt, et erat verbum istud absconditum ab eis, et non intelligebant qu dicebantur.
tr: και αυτοι ουδεν τουτων συνηκαν και ην το ρημα τουτο κεκρυμμενον απ αυτων και ουκ εγινωσκον τα λεγομενα
kjv: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.

vulg: factum est autem cum adpropinquaret Hiericho caecus quidam sedebat secus viam mendicans
clem: Factum est autem, cum appropinquaret Jericho, ccus quidam sedebat secus viam, mendicans.
tr: εγενετο δε εν τω εγγιζειν αυτον εις ιεριχω τυφλος τις εκαθητο παρα την οδον προσαιτων
kjv: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

vulg: et cum audiret turbam praetereuntem interrogabat quid hoc esset
clem: Et cum audiret turbam prtereuntem, interrogabat quid hoc esset.
tr: ακουσας δε οχλου διαπορευομενου επυνθανετο τι ειη τουτο
kjv: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.

vulg: dixerunt autem ei quod Iesus Nazarenus transiret
clem: Dixerunt autem ei quod Jesus Nazarenus transiret.
tr: απηγγειλαν δε αυτω οτι ιησους ο ναζωραιος παρερχεται
kjv: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.

vulg: et clamavit dicens Iesu Fili David miserere mei
clem: Et clamavit, dicens: Jesu, fili David, miserere mei.
tr: και εβοησεν λεγων ιησου υιε δαβιδ ελεησον με
kjv: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.

vulg: et qui praeibant increpabant eum ut taceret ipse vero multo magis clamabat Fili David miserere mei
clem: Et qui pribant, increpabant eum ut taceret. Ipse vero multo magis clamabat: Fili David, miserere mei.
tr: και οι προαγοντες επετιμων αυτω ινα σιωπηση αυτος δε πολλω μαλλον εκραζεν υιε δαβιδ ελεησον με
kjv: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.

vulg: stans autem Iesus iussit illum adduci ad se et cum adpropinquasset interrogavit illum
clem: Stans autem Jesus jussit illum adduci ad se. Et cum appropinquasset, interrogavit illum,
tr: σταθεις δε ο ιησους εκελευσεν αυτον αχθηναι προς αυτον εγγισαντος δε αυτου επηρωτησεν αυτον
kjv: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,

vulg: dicens quid tibi vis faciam at ille dixit Domine ut videam
clem: dicens: Quid tibi vis faciam? At ille dixit: Domine, ut videam.
tr: λεγων τι σοι θελεις ποιησω ο δε ειπεν κυριε ινα αναβλεψω
kjv: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

vulg: et Iesus dixit illi respice fides tua te salvum fecit
clem: Et Jesus dixit illi: Respice, fides tua te salvum fecit.
tr: και ο ιησους ειπεν αυτω αναβλεψον η πιστις σου σεσωκεν σε
kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.

vulg: et confestim vidit et sequebatur illum magnificans Deum et omnis plebs ut vidit dedit laudem Deo
clem: Et confestim vidit, et sequebatur illum magnificans Deum. Et omnis plebs ut vidit, dedit laudem Deo.
tr: και παραχρημα ανεβλεψεν και ηκολουθει αυτω δοξαζων τον θεον και πας ο λαος ιδων εδωκεν αινον τω θεω
kjv: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.

vulg: et ingressus perambulabat Hiericho
clem: Et ingressus perambulabat Jericho.
tr: και εισελθων διηρχετο την ιεριχω
kjv: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.

vulg: et ecce vir nomine Zaccheus et hic erat princeps publicanorum et ipse dives
clem: Et ecce vir nomine Zachus: et hic princeps erat publicanorum, et ipse dives:
tr: και ιδου ανηρ ονοματι καλουμενος ζακχαιος και αυτος ην αρχιτελωνης και ουτος ην πλουσιος
kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

vulg: et quaerebat videre Iesum quis esset et non poterat prae turba quia statura pusillus erat
clem: et qurebat videre Jesum, quis esset: et non poterat pr turba, quia statura pusillus erat.
tr: και εζητει ιδειν τον ιησουν τις εστιν και ουκ ηδυνατο απο του οχλου οτι τη ηλικια μικρος ην
kjv: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.

vulg: et praecurrens ascendit in arborem sycomorum ut videret illum quia inde erat transiturus
clem: Et prcurrens ascendit in arborem sycomorum ut videret eum: quia inde erat transiturus.
tr: και προδραμων εμπροσθεν ανεβη επι συκομωραιαν ινα ιδη αυτον οτι δι εκεινης ημελλεν διερχεσθαι
kjv: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.

vulg: et cum venisset ad locum suspiciens Iesus vidit illum et dixit ad eum Zacchee festinans descende quia hodie in domo tua oportet me manere
clem: Et cum venisset ad locum, suspiciens Jesus vidit illum, et dixit ad eum: Zache, festinans descende: quia hodie in domo tua oportet me manere.
tr: και ως ηλθεν επι τον τοπον αναβλεψας ο ιησους ειδεν αυτον και ειπεν προς αυτον ζακχαιε σπευσας καταβηθι σημερον γαρ εν τω οικω σου δει με μειναι
kjv: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

vulg: et festinans descendit et excepit illum gaudens
clem: Et festinans descendit, et excepit illum gaudens.
tr: και σπευσας κατεβη και υπεδεξατο αυτον χαιρων
kjv: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.

vulg: et cum viderent omnes murmurabant dicentes quod ad hominem peccatorem devertisset
clem: Et cum viderent omnes, murmurabant, dicentes quod ad hominem peccatorem divertisset.
tr: και ιδοντες απαντες διεγογγυζον λεγοντες οτι παρα αμαρτωλω ανδρι εισηλθεν καταλυσαι
kjv: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

vulg: stans autem Zaccheus dixit ad Dominum ecce dimidium bonorum meorum Domine do pauperibus et si quid aliquem defraudavi reddo quadruplum
clem: Stans autem Zachus, dixit ad Dominum: Ecce dimidium bonorum meorum, Domine, do pauperibus: et si quid aliquem defraudavi, reddo quadruplum.
tr: σταθεις δε ζακχαιος ειπεν προς τον κυριον ιδου τα ημιση των υπαρχοντων μου κυριε διδωμι τοις πτωχοις και ει τινος τι εσυκοφαντησα αποδιδωμι τετραπλουν
kjv: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord: Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

vulg: ait Iesus ad eum quia hodie salus domui huic facta est eo quod et ipse filius sit Abrahae
clem: Ait Jesus ad eum: Quia hodie salus domui huic facta est: eo quod et ipse filius sit Abrah.
tr: ειπεν δε προς αυτον ο ιησους οτι σημερον σωτηρια τω οικω τουτω εγενετο καθοτι και αυτος υιος αβρααμ εστιν
kjv: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.

vulg: venit enim Filius hominis quaerere et salvum facere quod perierat
clem: Venit enim Filius hominis qurere, et salvum facere quod perierat.
tr: ηλθεν γαρ ο υιος του ανθρωπου ζητησαι και σωσαι το απολωλος
kjv: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

vulg: haec illis audientibus adiciens dixit parabolam eo quod esset prope Hierusalem et quia existimarent quod confestim regnum Dei manifestaretur
clem: Hc illis audientibus adjiciens, dixit parabolam, eo quod esset prope Jerusalem: et quia existimarent quod confestim regnum Dei manifestaretur.
tr: ακουοντων δε αυτων ταυτα προσθεις ειπεν παραβολην δια το εγγυς αυτον ειναι ιερουσαλημ και δοκειν αυτους οτι παραχρημα μελλει η βασιλεια του θεου αναφαινεσθαι
kjv: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.

vulg: dixit ergo homo quidam nobilis abiit in regionem longinquam accipere sibi regnum et reverti
clem: Dixit ergo: Homo quidam nobilis abiit in regionem longinquam accipere sibi regnum, et reverti.
tr: ειπεν ουν ανθρωπος τις ευγενης επορευθη εις χωραν μακραν λαβειν εαυτω βασιλειαν και υποστρεψαι
kjv: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

vulg: vocatis autem decem servis suis dedit illis decem mnas et ait ad illos negotiamini dum venio
clem: Vocatis autem decem servis suis, dedit eis decem mnas, et ait ad illos: Negotiamini dum venio.
tr: καλεσας δε δεκα δουλους εαυτου εδωκεν αυτοις δεκα μνας και ειπεν προς αυτους πραγματευσασθε εως ερχομαι
kjv: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.

vulg: cives autem eius oderant illum et miserunt legationem post illum dicentes nolumus hunc regnare super nos
clem: Cives autem ejus oderant eum: et miserunt legationem post illum, dicentes: Nolumus hunc regnare super nos.
tr: οι δε πολιται αυτου εμισουν αυτον και απεστειλαν πρεσβειαν οπισω αυτου λεγοντες ου θελομεν τουτον βασιλευσαι εφ ημας
kjv: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.

vulg: et factum est ut rediret accepto regno et iussit vocari servos quibus dedit pecuniam ut sciret quantum quisque negotiatus esset
clem: Et factum est ut rediret accepto regno: et jussit vocari servos, quibus dedit pecuniam, ut sciret quantum quisque negotiatus esset.
tr: και εγενετο εν τω επανελθειν αυτον λαβοντα την βασιλειαν και ειπεν φωνηθηναι αυτω τους δουλους τουτους οις εδωκεν το αργυριον ινα γνω τις τι διεπραγματευσατο
kjv: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.

vulg: venit autem primus dicens domine mna tua decem mnas adquisivit
clem: Venit autem primus dicens: Domine, mna tua decem mnas acquisivit.
tr: παρεγενετο δε ο πρωτος λεγων κυριε η μνα σου προσειργασατο δεκα μνας
kjv: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.

vulg: et ait illi euge bone serve quia in modico fidelis fuisti eris potestatem habens supra decem civitates
clem: Et ait illi: Euge bone serve, quia in modico fuisti fidelis, eris potestatem habens super decem civitates.
tr: και ειπεν αυτω ευ αγαθε δουλε οτι εν ελαχιστω πιστος εγενου ισθι εξουσιαν εχων επανω δεκα πολεων
kjv: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

vulg: et alter venit dicens domine mna tua fecit quinque mnas
clem: Et alter venit, dicens: Domine, mna tua fecit quinque mnas.
tr: και ηλθεν ο δευτερος λεγων κυριε η μνα σου εποιησεν πεντε μνας
kjv: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.

vulg: et huic ait et tu esto supra quinque civitates
clem: Et huic ait: Et tu esto super quinque civitates.
tr: ειπεν δε και τουτω και συ γινου επανω πεντε πολεων
kjv: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.

vulg: et alter venit dicens domine ecce mna tua quam habui repositam in sudario
clem: Et alter venit, dicens: Domine, ecce mna tua, quam habui repositam in sudario:
tr: και ετερος ηλθεν λεγων κυριε ιδου η μνα σου ην ειχον αποκειμενην εν σουδαριω
kjv: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

vulg: timui enim te quia homo austeris es tollis quod non posuisti et metis quod non seminasti
clem: timui enim te, quia homo austerus es: tollis quod non posuisti, et metis quod non seminasti.
tr: εφοβουμην γαρ σε οτι ανθρωπος αυστηρος ει αιρεις ο ουκ εθηκας και θεριζεις ο ουκ εσπειρας
kjv: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.

vulg: dicit ei de ore tuo te iudico serve nequam sciebas quod ego austeris homo sum tollens quod non posui et metens quod non seminavi
clem: Dicit ei: De ore tuo te judico, serve nequam. Sciebas quod ego homo austerus sum, tollens quod non posui, et metens quod non seminavi:
tr: λεγει δε αυτω εκ του στοματος σου κρινω σε πονηρε δουλε ηδεις οτι εγω ανθρωπος αυστηρος ειμι αιρων ο ουκ εθηκα και θεριζων ο ουκ εσπειρα
kjv: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:

vulg: et quare non dedisti pecuniam meam ad mensam et ego veniens cum usuris utique exegissem illud
clem: et quare non dedisti pecuniam meam ad mensam, ut ego veniens cum usuris utique exegissem illam?
tr: και δια τι ουκ εδωκας το αργυριον μου επι την τραπεζαν και εγω ελθων συν τοκω αν επραξα αυτο
kjv: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?

vulg: et adstantibus dixit auferte ab illo mnam et date illi qui decem mnas habet
clem: Et astantibus dixit: Auferte ab illo mnam, et date illi qui decem mnas habet.
tr: και τοις παρεστωσιν ειπεν αρατε απ αυτου την μναν και δοτε τω τας δεκα μνας εχοντι
kjv: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.

vulg: et dixerunt ei domine habet decem mnas
clem: Et dixerunt ei: Domine, habet decem mnas.
tr: και ειπον αυτω κυριε εχει δεκα μνας
kjv: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)

vulg: dico autem vobis quia omni habenti dabitur ab eo autem qui non habet et quod habet auferetur ab eo
clem: Dico autem vobis, quia omni habenti dabitur, et abundabit: ab eo autem qui non habet, et quod habet auferetur ab eo.
tr: λεγω γαρ υμιν οτι παντι τω εχοντι δοθησεται απο δε του μη εχοντος και ο εχει αρθησεται απ αυτου
kjv: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.

vulg: verumtamen inimicos meos illos qui noluerunt me regnare super se adducite huc et interficite ante me
clem: Verumtamen inimicos meos illos, qui noluerunt me regnare super se, adducite huc: et interficite ante me.
tr: πλην τους εχθρους μου εκεινους τους μη θελησαντας με βασιλευσαι επ αυτους αγαγετε ωδε και κατασφαξατε εμπροσθεν μου
kjv: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.

vulg: et his dictis praecedebat ascendens in Hierosolyma
clem: Et his dictis, prcedebat ascendens Jerosolymam.
tr: και ειπων ταυτα επορευετο εμπροσθεν αναβαινων εις ιεροσολυμα
kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.

vulg: et factum est cum adpropinquasset ad Bethfage et Bethania ad montem qui vocatur Oliveti misit duos discipulos suos
clem: Et factum est, cum appropinquasset ad Bethphage et Bethaniam, ad montem qui vocatur Oliveti, misit duos discipulos suos,
tr: και εγενετο ως ηγγισεν εις βηθφαγη και βηθανιαν προς το ορος το καλουμενον ελαιων απεστειλεν δυο των μαθητων αυτου
kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

vulg: dicens ite in castellum quod contra est in quod introeuntes invenietis pullum asinae alligatum cui nemo umquam hominum sedit solvite illum et adducite
clem: dicens: Ite in castellum quod contra est: in quod intrountes, invenietis pullum asin alligatum, cui nemo umquam hominum sedit: solvite illum, et adducite.
tr: ειπων υπαγετε εις την κατεναντι κωμην εν η εισπορευομενοι ευρησετε πωλον δεδεμενον εφ ον ουδεις πωποτε ανθρωπων εκαθισεν λυσαντες αυτον αγαγετε
kjv: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.

vulg: et si quis vos interrogaverit quare solvitis sic dicetis ei quia Dominus operam eius desiderat
clem: Et si quis vos interrogaverit: Quare solvitis? sic dicetis ei: Quia Dominus operam ejus desiderat.
tr: και εαν τις υμας ερωτα δια τι λυετε ουτως ερειτε αυτω οτι ο κυριος αυτου χρειαν εχει
kjv: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

vulg: abierunt autem qui missi erant et invenerunt sicut dixit illis stantem pullum
clem: Abierunt autem qui missi erant: et invenerunt, sicut dixit illis, stantem pullum.
tr: απελθοντες δε οι απεσταλμενοι ευρον καθως ειπεν αυτοις
kjv: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.

vulg: solventibus autem illis pullum dixerunt domini eius ad illos quid solvitis pullum
clem: Solventibus autem illis pullum, dixerunt domini ejus ad illos: Quid solvitis pullum?
tr: λυοντων δε αυτων τον πωλον ειπον οι κυριοι αυτου προς αυτους τι λυετε τον πωλον
kjv: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?

vulg: at illi dixerunt quia Dominus eum necessarium habet
clem: At illi dixerunt: Quia Dominus eum necessarium habet.
tr: οι δε ειπον ο κυριος αυτου χρειαν εχει
kjv: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

vulg: et duxerunt illum ad Iesum et iactantes vestimenta sua supra pullum inposuerunt Iesum
clem: Et duxerunt illum ad Jesum. Et jacentes vestimenta sua supra pullum, imposuerunt Jesum.
tr: και ηγαγον αυτον προς τον ιησουν και επιρριψαντες εαυτων τα ιματια επι τον πωλον επεβιβασαν τον ιησουν
kjv: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.

vulg: eunte autem illo substernebant vestimenta sua in via
clem: Eunte autem illo, substernebant vestimenta sua in via:
tr: πορευομενου δε αυτου υπεστρωννυον τα ιματια αυτων εν τη οδω
kjv: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.

vulg: et cum adpropinquaret iam ad descensum montis Oliveti coeperunt omnes turbae discentium gaudentes laudare Deum voce magna super omnibus quas viderant virtutibus
clem: et cum appropinquaret jam ad descensum montis Oliveti, cperunt omnes turb discipulorum gaudentes laudare Deum voce magna super omnibus, quas viderant, virtutibus,
tr: εγγιζοντος δε αυτου ηδη προς τη καταβασει του ορους των ελαιων ηρξαντο απαν το πληθος των μαθητων χαιροντες αινειν τον θεον φωνη μεγαλη περι πασων ων ειδον δυναμεων
kjv: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;

vulg: dicentes benedictus qui venit rex in nomine Domini pax in caelo et gloria in excelsis
clem: dicentes: Benedictus, qui venit rex in nomine Domini: pax in clo, et gloria in excelsis.
tr: λεγοντες ευλογημενος ο ερχομενος βασιλευς εν ονοματι κυριου ειρηνη εν ουρανω και δοξα εν υψιστοις
kjv: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

vulg: et quidam Pharisaeorum de turbis dixerunt ad illum magister increpa discipulos tuos
clem: Et quidam pharisorum de turbis dixerunt ad illum: Magister, increpa discipulos tuos.
tr: και τινες των φαρισαιων απο του οχλου ειπον προς αυτον διδασκαλε επιτιμησον τοις μαθηταις σου
kjv: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.

vulg: quibus ipse ait dico vobis quia si hii tacuerint lapides clamabunt
clem: Quibus ipse ait: Dico vobis, quia si hi tacuerint, lapides clamabunt.
tr: και αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις λεγω υμιν οτι εαν ουτοι σιωπησωσιν οι λιθοι κεκραξονται
kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.

vulg: et ut adpropinquavit videns civitatem flevit super illam dicens
clem: Et ut appropinquavit, videns civitatem flevit super illam, dicens:
tr: και ως ηγγισεν ιδων την πολιν εκλαυσεν επ αυτη
kjv: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,

vulg: quia si cognovisses et tu et quidem in hac die tua quae ad pacem tibi nunc autem abscondita sunt ab oculis tuis
clem: Quia si cognovisses et tu, et quidem in hac die tua, qu ad pacem tibi: nunc autem abscondita sunt ab oculis tuis.
tr: λεγων οτι ει εγνως και συ και γε εν τη ημερα σου ταυτη τα προς ειρηνην σου νυν δε εκρυβη απο οφθαλμων σου
kjv: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

vulg: quia venient dies in te et circumdabunt te inimici tui vallo et circumdabunt te et coangustabunt te undique
clem: Quia venient dies in te: et circumdabunt te inimici tui vallo, et circumdabunt te: et coangustabunt te undique:
tr: οτι ηξουσιν ημεραι επι σε και περιβαλουσιν οι εχθροι σου χαρακα σοι και περικυκλωσουσιν σε και συνεξουσιν σε παντοθεν
kjv: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,

vulg: ad terram prosternent te et filios qui in te sunt et non relinquent in te lapidem super lapidem eo quod non cognoveris tempus visitationis tuae
clem: et ad terram prosternent te, et filios tuos, qui in te sunt, et non relinquent in te lapidem super lapidem: eo quod non cognoveris tempus visitationis tu.
tr: και εδαφιουσιν σε και τα τεκνα σου εν σοι και ουκ αφησουσιν εν σοι λιθον επι λιθω ανθ ων ουκ εγνως τον καιρον της επισκοπης σου
kjv: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.

vulg: et ingressus in templum coepit eicere vendentes in illo et ementes
clem: Et ingressus in templum, cpit ejicere vendentes in illo, et ementes,
tr: και εισελθων εις το ιερον ηρξατο εκβαλλειν τους πωλουντας εν αυτω και αγοραζοντας
kjv: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;

vulg: dicens illis scriptum est quia domus mea domus orationis est vos autem fecistis illam speluncam latronum
clem: dicens illis: Scriptum est: Quia domus mea domus orationis est: vos autem fecistis illam speluncam latronum.
tr: λεγων αυτοις γεγραπται ο οικος μου οικος προσευχης εστιν υμεις δε αυτον εποιησατε σπηλαιον ληστων
kjv: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.

vulg: et erat docens cotidie in templo principes autem sacerdotum et scribae et principes plebis quaerebant illum perdere
clem: Et erat docens quotidie in templo. Principes autem sacerdotum, et scrib, et princeps plebis qurebant illum perdere:
tr: και ην διδασκων το καθ ημεραν εν τω ιερω οι δε αρχιερεις και οι γραμματεις εζητουν αυτον απολεσαι και οι πρωτοι του λαου
kjv: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,

vulg: et non inveniebant quid facerent illi omnis enim populus suspensus erat audiens illum
clem: et non inveniebant quid facerent illi. Omnis enim populus suspensus erat, audiens illum.
tr: και ουχ ευρισκον το τι ποιησωσιν ο λαος γαρ απας εξεκρεματο αυτου ακουων
kjv: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.

vulg: et factum est in una dierum docente illo populum in templo et evangelizante convenerunt principes sacerdotum et scribae cum senioribus
clem: Et factum est in una dierum, docente illo populum in templo, et evangelizante, convenerunt principes sacerdotum, et scrib cum senioribus,
tr: και εγενετο εν μια των ημερων εκεινων διδασκοντος αυτου τον λαον εν τω ιερω και ευαγγελιζομενου επεστησαν οι αρχιερεις και οι γραμματεις συν τοις πρεσβυτεροις
kjv: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,

vulg: et aiunt dicentes ad illum dic nobis in qua potestate haec facis aut quis est qui dedit tibi hanc potestatem
clem: et aiunt dicentes ad illum: Dic nobis in qua potestate hc facis? aut quis est qui dedit tibi hanc potestatem?
tr: και ειπον προς αυτον λεγοντες ειπε ημιν εν ποια εξουσια ταυτα ποιεις η τις εστιν ο δους σοι την εξουσιαν ταυτην
kjv: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

vulg: respondens autem dixit ad illos interrogabo vos et ego verbum respondete mihi
