clem: Respondens autem Jesus, dixit ad illos: Interrogabo vos et ego unum verbum. Respondete mihi:
tr: αποκριθεις δε ειπεν προς αυτους ερωτησω υμας καγω ενα λογον και ειπατε μοι
kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:

vulg: baptismum Iohannis de caelo erat an ex hominibus
clem: baptismus Joannis de clo erat, an ex hominibus?
tr: το βαπτισμα ιωαννου εξ ουρανου ην η εξ ανθρωπων
kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?

vulg: at illi cogitabant inter se dicentes quia si dixerimus de caelo dicet quare ergo non credidistis illi
clem: At illi cogitabant intra se, dicentes: Quia si dixerimus: De clo, dicet: Quare ergo non credidistis illi?
tr: οι δε συνελογισαντο προς εαυτους λεγοντες οτι εαν ειπωμεν εξ ουρανου ερει δια τι ουν ουκ επιστευσατε αυτω
kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?

vulg: si autem dixerimus ex hominibus plebs universa lapidabit nos certi sunt enim Iohannem prophetam esse
clem: Si autem dixerimus: Ex hominibus, plebs universa lapidabit nos: certi sunt enim Joannem prophetam esse.
tr: εαν δε ειπωμεν εξ ανθρωπων πας ο λαος καταλιθασει ημας πεπεισμενος γαρ εστιν ιωαννην προφητην ειναι
kjv: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.

vulg: et responderunt se nescire unde esset
clem: Et responderunt se nescire unde esset.
tr: και απεκριθησαν μη ειδεναι ποθεν
kjv: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.

vulg: et Iesus ait illis neque ego dico vobis in qua potestate haec facio
clem: Et Jesus ait illis: Neque ego dico vobis in qua potestate hc facio.
tr: και ο ιησους ειπεν αυτοις ουδε εγω λεγω υμιν εν ποια εξουσια ταυτα ποιω
kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

vulg: coepit autem dicere ad plebem parabolam hanc homo plantavit vineam et locavit eam colonis et ipse peregre fuit multis temporibus
clem: Cpit autem dicere ad plebem parabolam hanc: Homo plantavit vineam, et locavit eam colonis: et ipse peregre fuit multis temporibus.
tr: ηρξατο δε προς τον λαον λεγειν την παραβολην ταυτην ανθρωπος τις εφυτευσεν αμπελωνα και εξεδοτο αυτον γεωργοις και απεδημησεν χρονους ικανους
kjv: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.

vulg: et in tempore misit ad cultores servum ut de fructu vineae darent illi qui caesum dimiserunt eum inanem
clem: Et in tempore misit ad cultores servum, ut de fructu vine darent illi. Qui csum dimiserunt eum inanem.
tr: και εν καιρω απεστειλεν προς τους γεωργους δουλον ινα απο του καρπου του αμπελωνος δωσιν αυτω οι δε γεωργοι δειραντες αυτον εξαπεστειλαν κενον
kjv: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.

vulg: et addidit alterum servum mittere illi autem hunc quoque caedentes et adficientes contumelia dimiserunt inanem
clem: Et addidit alterum servum mittere. Illi autem hunc quoque cdentes, et afficientes contumelia, dimiserunt inanem.
tr: και προσεθετο πεμψαι ετερον δουλον οι δε κακεινον δειραντες και ατιμασαντες εξαπεστειλαν κενον
kjv: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

vulg: et addidit tertium mittere qui et illum vulnerantes eiecerunt
clem: Et addidit tertium mittere: qui et illum vulnerantes ejecerunt.
tr: και προσεθετο πεμψαι τριτον οι δε και τουτον τραυματισαντες εξεβαλον
kjv: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.

vulg: dixit autem dominus vineae quid faciam mittam filium meum dilectum forsitan cum hunc viderint verebuntur
clem: Dixit autem dominus vine: Quid faciam? Mittam filium meum dilectum: forsitan, cum hunc viderint, verebuntur.
tr: ειπεν δε ο κυριος του αμπελωνος τι ποιησω πεμψω τον υιον μου τον αγαπητον ισως τουτον ιδοντες εντραπησονται
kjv: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.

vulg: quem cum vidissent coloni cogitaverunt inter se dicentes hic est heres occidamus illum ut nostra fiat hereditas
clem: Quem cum vidissent coloni, cogitaverunt intra se, dicentes: Hic est hres, occidamus illum, ut nostra fiat hreditas.
tr: ιδοντες δε αυτον οι γεωργοι διελογιζοντο προς εαυτους λεγοντες ουτος εστιν ο κληρονομος δευτε αποκτεινωμεν αυτον ινα ημων γενηται η κληρονομια
kjv: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.

vulg: et eiectum illum extra vineam occiderunt quid ergo faciet illis dominus vineae
clem: Et ejectum illum extra vineam, occiderunt. Quid ergo faciet illis dominus vine?
tr: και εκβαλοντες αυτον εξω του αμπελωνος απεκτειναν τι ουν ποιησει αυτοις ο κυριος του αμπελωνος
kjv: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

vulg: veniet et perdet colonos istos et dabit vineam aliis quo audito dixerunt illi absit
clem: veniet, et perdet colonos istos, et dabit vineam aliis. Quo audito, dixerunt illi: Absit.
tr: ελευσεται και απολεσει τους γεωργους τουτους και δωσει τον αμπελωνα αλλοις ακουσαντες δε ειπον μη γενοιτο
kjv: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.

vulg: ille autem aspiciens eos ait quid est ergo hoc quod scriptum est lapidem quem reprobaverunt aedificantes hic factus est in caput anguli
clem: Ille autem aspiciens eos, ait: Quid est ergo hoc quod scriptum est: Lapidem quem reprobaverunt dificantes, hic factus est in caput anguli?
tr: ο δε εμβλεψας αυτοις ειπεν τι ουν εστιν το γεγραμμενον τουτο λιθον ον απεδοκιμασαν οι οικοδομουντες ουτος εγενηθη εις κεφαλην γωνιας
kjv: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

vulg: omnis qui ceciderit supra illum lapidem conquassabitur supra quem autem ceciderit comminuet illum
clem: Omnis qui ceciderit super illum lapidem, conquassabitur: super quem autem ceciderit, comminuet illum.
tr: πας ο πεσων επ εκεινον τον λιθον συνθλασθησεται εφ ον δ αν πεση λικμησει αυτον
kjv: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

vulg: et quaerebant principes sacerdotum et scribae mittere in illum manus illa hora et timuerunt populum cognoverunt enim quod ad ipsos dixerit similitudinem istam
clem: Et qurebant principes sacerdotum et scrib mittere in illum manus illa hora, et timuerunt populum: cognoverunt enim quod ad ipsos dixerit similitudinem hanc.
tr: και εζητησαν οι αρχιερεις και οι γραμματεις επιβαλειν επ αυτον τας χειρας εν αυτη τη ωρα και εφοβηθησαν τον λαον εγνωσαν γαρ οτι προς αυτους την παραβολην ταυτην ειπεν
kjv: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.

vulg: et observantes miserunt insidiatores qui se iustos simularent ut caperent eum in sermone et traderent illum principatui et potestati praesidis
clem: Et observantes miserunt insidiatores, qui se justos simularent, ut caparent eum in sermone, ut traderent illum principatui, et potestati prsidis.
tr: και παρατηρησαντες απεστειλαν εγκαθετους υποκρινομενους εαυτους δικαιους ειναι ινα επιλαβωνται αυτου λογου εις το παραδουναι αυτον τη αρχη και τη εξουσια του ηγεμονος
kjv: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.

vulg: et interrogaverunt illum dicentes magister scimus quia recte dicis et doces et non accipis personam sed in veritate viam Dei doces
clem: Et interrogaverunt eum, dicentes: Magister, scimus quia recte dicis et doces: et non accipis personam, sed viam Dei in veritate doces.
tr: και επηρωτησαν αυτον λεγοντες διδασκαλε οιδαμεν οτι ορθως λεγεις και διδασκεις και ου λαμβανεις προσωπον αλλ επ αληθειας την οδον του θεου διδασκεις
kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:

vulg: licet nobis dare tributum Caesari an non
clem: Licet nobis tributum dare Csari, an non?
tr: εξεστιν ημιν καισαρι φορον δουναι η ου
kjv: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?

vulg: considerans autem dolum illorum dixit ad eos quid me temptatis
clem: Considerans autem dolum illorum, dixit ad eos: Quid me tentatis?
tr: κατανοησας δε αυτων την πανουργιαν ειπεν προς αυτους τι με πειραζετε
kjv: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?

vulg: ostendite mihi denarium cuius habet imaginem et inscriptionem respondentes dixerunt Caesaris
clem: ostendite mihi denarium. Cujus habet imaginem et inscriptionem? Respondentes dixerunt ei: Csaris.
tr: επιδειξατε μοι δηναριον τινος εχει εικονα και επιγραφην αποκριθεντες δε ειπον καισαρος
kjv: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.

vulg: et ait illis reddite ergo quae Caesaris sunt Caesari et quae Dei sunt Deo
clem: Et ait illis: Reddite ergo qu sunt Csaris, Csari: et qu sunt Dei, Deo.
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτοις αποδοτε τοινυν τα καισαρος καισαρι και τα του θεου τω θεω
kjv: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.

vulg: et non potuerunt verbum eius reprehendere coram plebe et mirati in responso eius tacuerunt
clem: Et non potuerunt verbum ejus reprehendere coram plebe: et mirati in responso ejus, tacuerunt.
tr: και ουκ ισχυσαν επιλαβεσθαι αυτου ρηματος εναντιον του λαου και θαυμασαντες επι τη αποκρισει αυτου εσιγησαν
kjv: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.

vulg: accesserunt autem quidam Sadducaeorum qui negant esse resurrectionem et interrogaverunt eum
clem: Accesserunt autem quidam sadducorum, qui negant esse resurrectionem, et interrogaverunt eum,
tr: προσελθοντες δε τινες των σαδδουκαιων οι αντιλεγοντες αναστασιν μη ειναι επηρωτησαν αυτον
kjv: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,

vulg: dicentes magister Moses scripsit nobis si frater alicuius mortuus fuerit habens uxorem et hic sine filiis fuerit ut accipiat eam frater eius uxorem et suscitet semen fratri suo
clem: dicentes: Magister, Moyses scripsit nobis: Si frater alicujus mortuus fuerit habens uxorem, et hic sine liberis fuerit, ut accipiat eam frater ejus uxorem, et suscitet semen fratri suo.
tr: λεγοντες διδασκαλε μωσης εγραψεν ημιν εαν τινος αδελφος αποθανη εχων γυναικα και ουτος ατεκνος αποθανη ινα λαβη ο αδελφος αυτου την γυναικα και εξαναστηση σπερμα τω αδελφω αυτου
kjv: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

vulg: septem ergo fratres erant et primus accepit uxorem et mortuus est sine filiis
clem: Septem ergo fratres erant: et primus accepit uxorem, et mortuus est sine filiis.
tr: επτα ουν αδελφοι ησαν και ο πρωτος λαβων γυναικα απεθανεν ατεκνος
kjv: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

vulg: et sequens accepit illam et ipse mortuus est sine filio
clem: Et sequens accepit illam, et ipse mortuus est sine filio.
tr: και ελαβεν ο δευτερος την γυναικα και ουτος απεθανεν ατεκνος
kjv: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.

vulg: et tertius accepit illam similiter et omnes septem et non reliquerunt semen et mortui sunt
clem: Et tertius accepit illam. Similiter et omnes septem, et non reliquerunt semen, et mortui sunt.
tr: και ο τριτος ελαβεν αυτην ωσαυτως δε και οι επτα  και  ου κατελιπον τεκνα και απεθανον
kjv: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.

vulg: novissima omnium mortua est et mulier
clem: Novissime omnium mortua est et mulier.
tr: υστερον δε   παντων απεθανεν και η γυνη
kjv: Last of all the woman died also.

vulg: in resurrectione ergo cuius eorum erit uxor siquidem septem habuerunt eam uxorem
clem: In resurrectione ergo, cujus eorum erit uxor? siquidem septem habuerunt eam uxorem.
tr: εν τη ουν αναστασει τινος αυτων γινεται γυνη οι γαρ επτα εσχον αυτην γυναικα
kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.

vulg: et ait illis Iesus filii saeculi huius nubunt et traduntur ad nuptias
clem: Et ait illis Jesus: Filii hujus sculi nubunt, et traduntur ad nuptias:
tr: και αποκριθεις ειπεν αυτοις ο ιησους οι υιοι του αιωνος τουτου γαμουσιν και εκγαμισκονται
kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

vulg: illi autem qui digni habebuntur saeculo illo et resurrectione ex mortuis neque nubunt neque ducunt uxores
clem: illi vero qui digni habebuntur sculo illo, et resurrectione ex mortuis, neque nubent, neque ducent uxores:
tr: οι δε καταξιωθεντες του αιωνος εκεινου τυχειν και της αναστασεως της εκ νεκρων ουτε γαμουσιν ουτε εκγαμισκονται
kjv: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

vulg: neque enim ultra mori poterunt aequales enim angelis sunt et filii sunt Dei cum sint filii resurrectionis
clem: neque enim ultra mori potuerunt: quales enim angelis sunt, et filii sunt Dei, cum sint filii resurrectionis.
tr: ουτε γαρ αποθανειν ετι δυνανται ισαγγελοι γαρ εισιν και υιοι εισιν του θεου της αναστασεως υιοι οντες
kjv: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.

vulg: quia vero resurgant mortui et Moses ostendit secus rubum sicut dicit Dominum Deum Abraham et Deum Isaac et Deum Iacob
clem: Quia vero resurgant mortui, et Moyses ostendit secus rubum, sicut dicit Dominum, Deum Abraham, et Deum Isaac, et Deum Jacob.
tr: οτι δε εγειρονται οι νεκροι και μωσης εμηνυσεν επι της βατου ως λεγει κυριον τον θεον αβρααμ και τον θεον ισαακ και τον θεον ιακωβ
kjv: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

vulg: Deus autem non est mortuorum sed vivorum omnes enim vivunt ei
clem: Deus autem non est mortuorum, sed vivorum: omnes enim vivunt ei.
tr: θεος δε ουκ εστιν νεκρων αλλα ζωντων παντες γαρ αυτω ζωσιν
kjv: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

vulg: respondentes autem quidam scribarum dixerunt magister bene dixisti
clem: Respondentes autem quidam scribarum, dixerunt ei: Magister, bene dixisti.
tr: αποκριθεντες δε τινες των γραμματεων ειπον διδασκαλε καλως ειπας
kjv: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.

vulg: et amplius non audebant eum quicquam interrogare
clem: Et amplius non audebant eum quidquam interrogare.
tr: ουκετι δε ετολμων επερωταν αυτον ουδεν
kjv: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.

vulg: dixit autem ad illos quomodo dicunt Christum Filium David esse
clem: Dixit autem ad illos: Quomodo dicunt Christum filium esse David?
tr: ειπεν δε προς αυτους πως λεγουσιν τον χριστον υιον δαβιδ ειναι
kjv: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?

vulg: et ipse David dicit in libro Psalmorum dixit Dominus Domino meo sede a dextris meis
clem: et ipse David dicit in libro Psalmorum: Dixit Dominus Domino meo: sede a dextris meis,
tr: και αυτος δαβιδ λεγει εν βιβλω ψαλμων ειπεν ο κυριος τω κυριω μου καθου εκ δεξιων μου
kjv: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

vulg: donec ponam inimicos tuos scabillum pedum tuorum
clem: donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum.
tr: εως αν θω τους εχθρους σου υποποδιον των ποδων σου
kjv: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

vulg: David ergo Dominum illum vocat et quomodo filius eius est
clem: David ergo Dominum illum vocat: et quomodo filius ejus est?
tr: δαβιδ ουν κυριον αυτον καλει και πως υιος αυτου εστιν
kjv: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?

vulg: audiente autem omni populo dixit discipulis suis
clem: Audiente autem omni populo, dixit discipulis suis:
tr: ακουοντος δε παντος του λαου ειπεν τοις μαθηταις αυτου
kjv: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,

vulg: adtendite a scribis qui volunt ambulare in stolis et amant salutationes in foro et primas cathedras in synagogis et primos discubitus in conviviis
clem: Attendite a scribis, qui volunt ambulare in stolis, et amant salutationes in foro, et primas cathedras in synagogis, et primos discubitus in conviviis,
tr: προσεχετε απο των γραμματεων των θελοντων περιπατειν εν στολαις και φιλουντων ασπασμους εν ταις αγοραις και πρωτοκαθεδριας εν ταις συναγωγαις και πρωτοκλισιας εν τοις δειπνοις
kjv: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

vulg: qui devorant domos viduarum simulantes longam orationem hii accipient damnationem maiorem
clem: qui devorant domos viduarum, simulantes longam orationem: hi accipient damnationem majorem.
tr: οι κατεσθιουσιν τας οικιας των χηρων και προφασει μακρα προσευχονται ουτοι ληψονται περισσοτερον κριμα
kjv: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.

vulg: respiciens autem vidit eos qui mittebant munera sua in gazofilacium divites
clem: Respiciens autem, vidit eos qui mittebant munera sua in gazophylacium, divites.
tr: αναβλεψας δε ειδεν τους βαλλοντας τα δωρα αυτων εις το γαζοφυλακιον πλουσιους
kjv: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

vulg: vidit autem et quandam viduam pauperculam mittentem aera minuta duo
clem: Vidit autem et quamdam viduam pauperculam mittentem ra minuta duo.
tr: ειδεν δε και τινα χηραν πενιχραν βαλλουσαν εκει δυο λεπτα
kjv: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.

vulg: et dixit vere dico vobis quia vidua haec pauper plus quam omnes misit
clem: Et dixit: Vere dico vobis, quia vidua hc pauper plus quam omnes misit.
tr: και ειπεν αληθως λεγω υμιν οτι η χηρα η πτωχη αυτη πλειον παντων εβαλεν
kjv: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:

vulg: nam omnes hii ex abundanti sibi miserunt in munera Dei haec autem ex eo quod deest illi omnem victum suum quem habuit misit
clem: Nam omnes hi ex abundanti sibi miserunt in munera Dei: hc autem ex eo quod deest illi, omnem victum suum quem habuit, misit.
tr: απαντες γαρ ουτοι εκ του περισσευοντος αυτοις εβαλον εις τα δωρα του θεου αυτη δε εκ του υστερηματος αυτης απαντα τον βιον ον ειχεν εβαλεν
kjv: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.

vulg: et quibusdam dicentibus de templo quod lapidibus bonis et donis ornatum esset dixit
clem: Et quibusdam dicentibus de templo quod bonis lapidibus et donis ornatum esset, dixit:
tr: και τινων λεγοντων περι του ιερου οτι λιθοις καλοις και αναθημασιν κεκοσμηται ειπεν
kjv: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,

vulg: haec quae videtis venient dies in quibus non relinquetur lapis super lapidem qui non destruatur
clem: Hc qu videtis, venient dies in quibus non relinquetur lapis super lapidem, qui non destruatur.
tr: ταυτα α θεωρειτε ελευσονται ημεραι εν αις ουκ αφεθησεται λιθος επι λιθω ος ου καταλυθησεται
kjv: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

vulg: interrogaverunt autem illum dicentes praeceptor quando haec erunt et quod signum cum fieri incipient
clem: Interrogaverunt autem illum, dicentes: Prceptor, quando hc erunt, et quod signum cum fieri incipient?
tr: επηρωτησαν δε αυτον λεγοντες διδασκαλε ποτε ουν ταυτα εσται και τι το σημειον οταν μελλη ταυτα γινεσθαι
kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?

vulg: qui dixit videte ne seducamini multi enim venient in nomine meo dicentes quia ego sum et tempus adpropinquavit nolite ergo ire post illos
clem: Qui dixit: Videte ne seducamini: multi enim venient in nomine meo, dicentes quia ego sum: et tempus appropinquavit: nolite ergo ire post eos.
tr: ο δε ειπεν βλεπετε μη πλανηθητε πολλοι γαρ ελευσονται επι τω ονοματι μου λεγοντες οτι εγω ειμι και ο καιρος ηγγικεν μη ουν πορευθητε οπισω αυτων
kjv: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.

vulg: cum autem audieritis proelia et seditiones nolite terreri oportet primum haec fieri sed non statim finis
clem: Cum autem audieritis prlia et seditiones, nolite terreri: oportet primum hc fieri, sed nondum statim finis.
tr: οταν δε ακουσητε πολεμους και ακαταστασιας μη πτοηθητε δει γαρ ταυτα γενεσθαι πρωτον αλλ ουκ ευθεως το τελος
kjv: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.

vulg: tunc dicebat illis surget gens contra gentem et regnum adversus regnum
clem: Tunc dicebat illis: Surget gens contra gentem, et regnum adversus regnum.
tr: τοτε ελεγεν αυτοις εγερθησεται εθνος επι εθνος και βασιλεια επι βασιλειαν
kjv: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:

vulg: terraemotus magni erunt per loca et pestilentiae et fames terroresque de caelo et signa magna erunt
clem: Et terrmotus magni erunt per loca, et pestilenti, et fames, terroresque de clo, et signa magna erunt.
tr: σεισμοι τε μεγαλοι κατα τοπους και λιμοι και λοιμοι εσονται φοβητρα τε και σημεια απ ουρανου μεγαλα εσται
kjv: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

vulg: sed ante haec omnia inicient vobis manus suas et persequentur tradentes in synagogas et custodias trahentes ad reges et praesides propter nomen meum
clem: Sed ante hc omnia injicient vobis manus suas, et persequentur tradentes in synagogas et custodias, trahentes ad reges et prsides propter nomen meum:
tr: προ δε τουτων απαντων επιβαλουσιν εφ υμας τας χειρας αυτων και διωξουσιν παραδιδοντες εις συναγωγας και φυλακας αγομενους επι βασιλεις και ηγεμονας ενεκεν του ονοματος μου
kjv: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.

vulg: continget autem vobis in testimonium
clem: continget autem vobis in testimonium.
tr: αποβησεται δε υμιν εις μαρτυριον
kjv: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.

vulg: ponite ergo in cordibus vestris non praemeditari quemadmodum respondeatis
clem: Ponite ergo in cordibus vestris non prmeditari quemadmodum respondeatis:
tr: θεσθε ουν εις τας καρδιας υμων μη προμελεταν απολογηθηναι
kjv: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:

vulg: ego enim dabo vobis os et sapientiam cui non poterunt resistere et contradicere omnes adversarii vestri
clem: ego enim dabo vobis os et sapientiam, cui non poterunt resistere et contradicere omnes adversarii vestri.
tr: εγω γαρ δωσω υμιν στομα και σοφιαν η ου δυνησονται αντειπειν ουδε αντιστηναι παντες οι αντικειμενοι υμιν
kjv: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

vulg: trademini autem a parentibus et fratribus et cognatis et amicis et morte adficient ex vobis
clem: Trademini autem a parentibus, et fratribus, et cognatis, et amicis, et morte afficient ex vobis:
tr: παραδοθησεσθε δε και υπο γονεων και αδελφων και συγγενων και φιλων και θανατωσουσιν εξ υμων
kjv: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.

vulg: et eritis odio omnibus propter nomen meum
clem: et eritis odio omnibus propter nomen meum:
tr: και εσεσθε μισουμενοι υπο παντων δια το ονομα μου
kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.

vulg: et capillus de capite vestro non peribit
clem: et capillus de capite vestro non peribit.
tr: και θριξ εκ της κεφαλης υμων ου μη αποληται
kjv: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.

vulg: in patientia vestra possidebitis animas vestras
clem: In patientia vestra possidebitis animas vestras.
tr: εν τη υπομονη υμων κτησασθε τας ψυχας υμων
kjv: In your patience possess ye your souls.

vulg: cum autem videritis circumdari ab exercitu Hierusalem tunc scitote quia adpropinquavit desolatio eius
clem: Cum autem videritis circumdari ab exercitu Jerusalem, tunc scitote quia appropinquavit desolatio ejus:
tr: οταν δε ιδητε κυκλουμενην υπο στρατοπεδων την ιερουσαλημ τοτε γνωτε οτι ηγγικεν η ερημωσις αυτης
kjv: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.

vulg: tunc qui in Iudaea sunt fugiant in montes et qui in medio eius discedant et qui in regionibus non intrent in eam
clem: tunc qui in Juda sunt, fugiant ad montes, et qui in medio ejus, discedant: et qui in regionibus, non intrent in eam,
tr: τοτε οι εν τη ιουδαια φευγετωσαν εις τα ορη και οι εν μεσω αυτης εκχωρειτωσαν και οι εν ταις χωραις μη εισερχεσθωσαν εις αυτην
kjv: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.

vulg: quia dies ultionis hii sunt ut impleantur omnia quae scripta sunt
clem: quia dies ultionis hi sunt, ut impleantur omnia qu scripta sunt.
tr: οτι ημεραι εκδικησεως αυται εισιν του πληρωθηναι παντα τα γεγραμμενα
kjv: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

vulg: vae autem praegnatibus et nutrientibus in illis diebus erit enim pressura magna supra terram et ira populo huic
clem: V autem prgnantibus et nutrientibus in illis diebus! erit enim pressura magna super terram, et ira populo huic.
tr: ουαι δε ταις εν γαστρι εχουσαις και ταις θηλαζουσαις εν εκειναις ταις ημεραις εσται γαρ αναγκη μεγαλη επι της γης και οργη εν τω λαω τουτω
kjv: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

vulg: et cadent in ore gladii et captivi ducentur in omnes gentes et Hierusalem calcabitur a gentibus donec impleantur tempora nationum
clem: Et cadent in ore gladii, et captivi ducentur in omnes gentes, et Jerusalem calcabitur a gentibus, donec impleantur tempora nationum.
tr: και πεσουνται στοματι μαχαιρας και αιχμαλωτισθησονται εις παντα τα εθνη και ιερουσαλημ εσται πατουμενη υπο εθνων αχρι πληρωθωσιν καιροι εθνων
kjv: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

vulg: et erunt signa in sole et luna et stellis et in terris pressura gentium prae confusione sonitus maris et fluctuum
clem: Et erunt signa in sole, et luna, et stellis, et in terris pressura gentium pr confusione sonitus maris, et fluctuum:
tr: και εσται σημεια εν ηλιω και σεληνη και αστροις και επι της γης συνοχη εθνων εν απορια ηχουσης θαλασσης και σαλου
kjv: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

vulg: arescentibus hominibus prae timore et expectatione quae supervenient universo orbi nam virtutes caelorum movebuntur
clem: arescentibus hominibus pr timore, et exspectatione, qu supervenient universo orbi: nam virtutes clorum movebuntur:
tr: αποψυχοντων ανθρωπων απο φοβου και προσδοκιας των επερχομενων τη οικουμενη αι γαρ δυναμεις των ουρανων σαλευθησονται
kjv: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

vulg: et tunc videbunt Filium hominis venientem in nube cum potestate magna et maiestate
clem: et tunc videbunt Filium hominis venientem in nube cum potestate magna et majestate.
tr: και τοτε οψονται τον υιον του ανθρωπου ερχομενον εν νεφελη μετα δυναμεως και δοξης πολλης
kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

vulg: his autem fieri incipientibus respicite et levate capita vestra quoniam adpropinquat redemptio vestra
clem: His autem fieri incipientibus, respicite, et levate capita vestra: quoniam appropinquat redemptio vestra.
tr: αρχομενων δε τουτων γινεσθαι ανακυψατε και επαρατε τας κεφαλας υμων διοτι εγγιζει η απολυτρωσις υμων
kjv: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

vulg: et dixit illis similitudinem videte ficulneam et omnes arbores
clem: Et dixit illis similitudinem: Videte ficulneam, et omnes arbores:
tr: και ειπεν παραβολην αυτοις ιδετε την συκην και παντα τα δενδρα
kjv: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;

vulg: cum producunt iam ex se fructum scitis quoniam prope est aestas
clem: cum producunt jam ex se fructum, scitis quoniam prope est stas.
tr: οταν προβαλωσιν ηδη βλεποντες αφ εαυτων γινωσκετε οτι ηδη εγγυς το θερος εστιν
kjv: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.

vulg: ita et vos cum videritis haec fieri scitote quoniam prope est regnum Dei
clem: Ita et vos cum videritis hc fieri, scitote quoniam prope est regnum Dei.
tr: ουτως και υμεις οταν ιδητε ταυτα γινομενα γινωσκετε οτι εγγυς εστιν η βασιλεια του θεου
kjv: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.

vulg: amen dico vobis quia non praeteribit generatio haec donec omnia fiant
clem: Amen dico vobis, quia non prteribit generatio hc, donec omnia fiant.
tr: αμην λεγω υμιν οτι ου μη παρελθη η γενεα αυτη εως αν παντα γενηται
kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.

vulg: caelum et terra transibunt verba autem mea non transient
clem: Clum et terra transibunt: verba autem mea non transibunt.
tr: ο ουρανος και η γη παρελευσονται οι δε λογοι μου ου μη παρελθωσιν
kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

vulg: adtendite autem vobis ne forte graventur corda vestra in crapula et ebrietate et curis huius vitae et superveniat in vos repentina dies illa
clem: Attendite autem vobis, ne forte graventur corda vestra in crapula, et ebrietate, et curis hujus vit, et superveniat in vos repentina dies illa:
tr: προσεχετε δε εαυτοις μηποτε βαρυνθωσιν υμων αι καρδιαι εν κραιπαλη και μεθη και μεριμναις βιωτικαις και αιφνιδιος εφ υμας επιστη η ημερα εκεινη
kjv: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.

vulg: tamquam laqueus enim superveniet in omnes qui sedent super faciem omnis terrae
clem: tamquam laqueus enim superveniet in omnes qui sedent super faciem omnis terr.
tr: ως παγις γαρ επελευσεται επι παντας τους καθημενους επι προσωπον πασης της γης
kjv: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.

vulg: vigilate itaque omni tempore orantes ut digni habeamini fugere ista omnia quae futura sunt et stare ante Filium hominis
clem: Vigilate itaque, omni tempore orantes, ut digni habeamini fugere ista omnia qu futura sunt, et stare ante Filium hominis.
tr: αγρυπνειτε ουν εν παντι καιρω δεομενοι ινα καταξιωθητε εκφυγειν ταυτα παντα τα μελλοντα γινεσθαι και σταθηναι εμπροσθεν του υιου του ανθρωπου
kjv: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

vulg: erat autem diebus docens in templo noctibus vero exiens morabatur in monte qui vocatur Oliveti
clem: Erat autem diebus docens in templo: noctibus vero exiens, morabatur in monte qui vocatur Oliveti.
tr: ην δε τας ημερας εν τω ιερω διδασκων τας δε νυκτας εξερχομενος ηυλιζετο εις το ορος το καλουμενον ελαιων
kjv: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

vulg: et omnis populus manicabat ad eum in templo audire eum
clem: Et omnis populus manicabat ad eum in templo audire eum.
tr: και πας ο λαος ωρθριζεν προς αυτον εν τω ιερω ακουειν αυτου
kjv: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.

vulg: adpropinquabat autem dies festus azymorum qui dicitur pascha
clem: Appropinquat autem dies festus azymorum, qui dicitur Pascha:
tr: ηγγιζεν δε η εορτη των αζυμων η λεγομενη πασχα
kjv: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

vulg: et quaerebant principes sacerdotum et scribae quomodo eum interficerent timebant vero plebem
clem: et qurebant principes sacerdotum, et scrib, quomodo Jesum interficerent: timebant vero plebem.
tr: και εζητουν οι αρχιερεις και οι γραμματεις το πως ανελωσιν αυτον εφοβουντο γαρ τον λαον
kjv: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.

vulg: intravit autem Satanas in Iudam qui cognominatur Scarioth unum de duodecim
clem: Intravit autem Satanas in Judam, qui cognominabatur Iscariotes, unum de duodecim:
tr: εισηλθεν δε ο σατανας εις ιουδαν τον επικαλουμενον ισκαριωτην οντα εκ του αριθμου των δωδεκα
kjv: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

vulg: et abiit et locutus est cum principibus sacerdotum et magistratibus quemadmodum illum traderet eis
clem: et abiit, et locutus est cum principibus sacerdotum, et magistratibus, quemadmodum illum traderet eis.
tr: και απελθων συνελαλησεν τοις αρχιερευσιν και τοις στρατηγοις το πως αυτον παραδω αυτοις
kjv: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.

vulg: et gavisi sunt et pacti sunt pecuniam illi dare
clem: Et gavisi sunt, et pacti sunt pecuniam illi dare.
tr: και εχαρησαν και συνεθεντο αυτω αργυριον δουναι
kjv: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

vulg: et spopondit et quaerebat oportunitatem ut traderet illum sine turbis
clem: Et spopondit, et qurebat opportunitatem ut traderet illum sine turbis.
tr: και εξωμολογησεν και εζητει ευκαιριαν του παραδουναι αυτον αυτοις ατερ οχλου
kjv: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

vulg: venit autem dies azymorum in qua necesse erat occidi pascha
clem: Venit autem dies azymorum, in qua necesse erat occidi pascha.
tr: ηλθεν δε η ημερα των αζυμων εν η εδει θυεσθαι το πασχα
kjv: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.

vulg: et misit Petrum et Iohannem dicens euntes parate nobis pascha ut manducemus
clem: Et misit Petrum et Joannem, dicens: Euntes parate nobis pascha, ut manducemus.
tr: και απεστειλεν πετρον και ιωαννην ειπων πορευθεντες ετοιμασατε ημιν το πασχα ινα φαγωμεν
kjv: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.

vulg: at illi dixerunt ubi vis paremus
clem: At illi dixerunt: Ubi vis paremus?
tr: οι δε ειπον αυτω που θελεις ετοιμασωμεν
kjv: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

vulg: et dixit ad eos ecce introeuntibus vobis in civitatem occurret vobis homo amphoram aquae portans sequimini eum in domum in qua intrat
clem: Et dixit ad eos: Ecce intrountibus vobis in civitatem occurret vobis homo quidam amphoram aqu portans: sequimini eum in domum, in quam intrat,
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτοις ιδου εισελθοντων υμων εις την πολιν συναντησει υμιν ανθρωπος κεραμιον υδατος βασταζων ακολουθησατε αυτω εις την οικιαν ου εισπορευεται
kjv: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.

vulg: et dicetis patri familias domus dicit tibi magister ubi est diversorium ubi pascha cum discipulis meis manducem
clem: et dicetis patrifamilias domus: Dicit tibi Magister: Ubi est diversorium, ubi pascha cum discipulis meis manducem?
tr: και ερειτε τω οικοδεσποτη της οικιας λεγει σοι ο διδασκαλος που εστιν το καταλυμα οπου το πασχα μετα των μαθητων μου φαγω
kjv: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

vulg: et ipse vobis ostendet cenaculum magnum stratum et ibi parate
clem: Et ipse ostendet vobis cnaculum magnum stratum, et ibi parate.
tr: κακεινος υμιν δειξει ανωγεον μεγα εστρωμενον εκει ετοιμασατε
kjv: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

vulg: euntes autem invenerunt sicut dixit illis et paraverunt pascha
clem: Euntes autem invenerunt sicut dixit illis, et paraverunt pascha.
tr: απελθοντες δε ευρον καθως ειρηκεν αυτοις και ητοιμασαν το πασχα
kjv: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

vulg: et cum facta esset hora discubuit et duodecim apostoli cum eo
clem: Et cum facta esset hora, discubuit, et duodecim apostoli cum eo.
tr: και οτε εγενετο η ωρα ανεπεσεν και οι δωδεκα αποστολοι συν αυτω
kjv: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.

vulg: et ait illis desiderio desideravi hoc pascha manducare vobiscum antequam patiar
clem: Et ait illis: Desiderio desideravi hoc pascha manducare vobiscum, antequam patiar.
tr: και ειπεν προς αυτους επιθυμια επεθυμησα τουτο το πασχα φαγειν μεθ υμων προ του με παθειν
kjv: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

vulg: dico enim vobis quia ex hoc non manducabo illud donec impleatur in regno Dei
clem: Dico enim vobis, quia ex hoc non manducabo illud, donec impleatur in regno Dei.
tr: λεγω γαρ υμιν οτι ουκετι ου μη φαγω εξ αυτου εως οτου πληρωθη εν τη βασιλεια του θεου
kjv: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

vulg: et accepto calice gratias egit et dixit accipite et dividite inter vos
clem: Et accepto calice gratias egit, et dixit: Accipite, et dividite inter vos.
tr: και δεξαμενος ποτηριον ευχαριστησας ειπεν λαβετε τουτο και διαμερισατε εαυτοις
kjv: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:

vulg: dico enim vobis quod non bibam de generatione vitis donec regnum Dei veniat
clem: Dico enim vobis quod non bibam de generatione vitis donec regnum Dei veniat.
tr: λεγω γαρ υμιν οτι ου μη πιω απο του γεννηματος της αμπελου εως οτου η βασιλεια του θεου ελθη
kjv: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.

vulg: et accepto pane gratias egit et fregit et dedit eis dicens hoc est corpus meum quod pro vobis datur hoc facite in meam commemorationem
clem: Et accepto pane gratias egit, et fregit, et dedit eis, dicens: Hoc est corpus meum, quod pro vobis datur: hoc facite in meam commemorationem.
tr: και λαβων αρτον ευχαριστησας εκλασεν και εδωκεν αυτοις λεγων τουτο εστιν το σωμα μου το υπερ υμων διδομενον τουτο ποιειτε εις την εμην αναμνησιν
kjv: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

vulg: similiter et calicem postquam cenavit dicens hic est calix novum testamentum in sanguine meo quod pro vobis funditur
clem: Similiter et calicem, postquam cnavit, dicens: Hic est calix novum testamentum in sanguine meo, qui pro vobis fundetur.
tr: ωσαυτως και το ποτηριον μετα το δειπνησαι λεγων τουτο το ποτηριον η καινη διαθηκη εν τω αιματι μου το υπερ υμων εκχυνομενον
kjv: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.

vulg: verumtamen ecce manus tradentis me mecum est in mensa
clem: Verumtamen ecce manus tradentis me, mecum est in mensa.
tr: πλην ιδου η χειρ του παραδιδοντος με μετ εμου επι της τραπεζης
kjv: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.

vulg: et quidem Filius hominis secundum quod definitum est vadit verumtamen vae illi homini per quem traditur
clem: Et quidem Filius hominis, secundum quod definitum est, vadit: verumtamen v homini illi per quem tradetur.
tr: και ο μεν υιος του ανθρωπου πορευεται κατα το ωρισμενον πλην ουαι τω ανθρωπω εκεινω δι ου παραδιδοται
kjv: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!

vulg: et ipsi coeperunt quaerere inter se quis esset ex eis qui hoc facturus esset
clem: Et ipsi cperunt qurere inter se quis esset ex eis qui hoc facturus esset.
tr: και αυτοι ηρξαντο συζητειν προς εαυτους το τις αρα ειη εξ αυτων ο τουτο μελλων πρασσειν
kjv: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.

vulg: facta est autem et contentio inter eos quis eorum videretur esse maior
clem: Facta est autem et contentio inter eos, quis eorum videretur esse major.
tr: εγενετο δε και φιλονεικια εν αυτοις το τις αυτων δοκει ειναι μειζων
kjv: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.

vulg: dixit autem eis reges gentium dominantur eorum et qui potestatem habent super eos benefici vocantur
clem: Dixit autem eis: Reges gentium dominantur eorum: et qui potestatem habent super eos, benefici vocantur.
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτοις οι βασιλεις των εθνων κυριευουσιν αυτων και οι εξουσιαζοντες αυτων ευεργεται καλουνται
kjv: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.

vulg: vos autem non sic sed qui maior est in vobis fiat sicut iunior et qui praecessor est sicut ministrator
clem: Vos autem non sic: sed qui major est in vobis, fiat sicut minor: et qui prcessor est, sicut ministrator.
tr: υμεις δε ουχ ουτως αλλ ο μειζων εν υμιν γενεσθω ως ο νεωτερος και ο ηγουμενος ως ο διακονων
kjv: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.

vulg: nam quis maior est qui recumbit an qui ministrat nonne qui recumbit ego autem in medio vestrum sum sicut qui ministrat
clem: Nam quis major est, qui recumbit, an qui ministrat? nonne qui recumbit? Ego autem in medio vestrum sum, sicut qui ministrat:
tr: τις γαρ μειζων ο ανακειμενος η ο διακονων ουχι ο ανακειμενος εγω δε ειμι εν μεσω υμων ως ο διακονων
kjv: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.

vulg: vos autem estis qui permansistis mecum in temptationibus meis
clem: vos autem estis, qui permansistis mecum in tentationibus meis.
tr: υμεις δε εστε οι διαμεμενηκοτες μετ εμου εν τοις πειρασμοις μου
kjv: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.

vulg: et ego dispono vobis sicut disposuit mihi Pater meus regnum
clem: Et ego dispono vobis sicut disposuit mihi Pater meus regnum,
tr: καγω διατιθεμαι υμιν καθως διεθετο μοι ο πατηρ μου βασιλειαν
kjv: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;

vulg: ut edatis et bibatis super mensam meam in regno et sedeatis super thronos iudicantes duodecim tribus Israhel
clem: ut edatis et bibatis super mensam meam in regno meo, et sedeatis super thronos judicantes duodecim tribus Isral.
tr: ινα εσθιητε και πινητε επι της τραπεζης μου εν τη βασιλεια μου και καθισησθε επι θρονων κρινοντες τας δωδεκα φυλας του ισραηλ
kjv: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

vulg: ait autem Dominus Simon Simon ecce Satanas expetivit vos ut cribraret sicut triticum
clem: Ait autem Dominus: Simon, Simon, ecce Satanas expetivit vos ut cribraret sicut triticum:
tr: ειπεν δε ο κυριος σιμων σιμων ιδου ο σατανας εξητησατο υμας του σινιασαι ως τον σιτον
kjv: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:

vulg: ego autem rogavi pro te ut non deficiat fides tua et tu aliquando conversus confirma fratres tuos
clem: ego autem rogavi pro te ut non deficiat fides tua: et tu aliquando conversus, confirma fratres tuos.
tr: εγω δε εδεηθην περι σου ινα μη εκλειπη η πιστις σου και συ ποτε επιστρεψας στηριξον τους αδελφους σου
kjv: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.

vulg: qui dixit ei Domine tecum paratus sum et in carcerem et in mortem ire
clem: Qui dixit ei: Domine, tecum paratus sum et in carcerem et in mortem ire.
tr: ο δε ειπεν αυτω κυριε μετα σου ετοιμος ειμι και εις φυλακην και εις θανατον πορευεσθαι
kjv: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

vulg: et ille dixit dico tibi Petre non cantabit hodie gallus donec ter abneges nosse me
clem: At ille dixit: Dico tibi, Petre, non cantabit hodie gallus, donec ter abneges nosse me. Et dixit eis:
tr: ο δε ειπεν λεγω σοι πετρε ου μη φωνησει σημερον αλεκτωρ πριν η τρις απαρνηση μη ειδεναι με
kjv: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.

vulg: et dixit eis quando misi vos sine sacculo et pera et calciamentis numquid aliquid defuit vobis at illi dixerunt nihil
clem: Quando misi vos sine sacculo, et pera, et calceamentis, numquid aliquid defuit vobis?
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις οτε απεστειλα υμας ατερ βαλαντιου και πηρας και υποδηματων μη τινος υστερησατε οι δε ειπον ουδενος
kjv: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.

vulg: dixit ergo eis sed nunc qui habet sacculum tollat similiter et peram et qui non habet vendat tunicam suam et emat gladium
clem: At illi dixerunt: Nihil. Dixit ergo eis: Sed nunc qui habet sacculum, tollat; similiter et peram: et qui non habet, vendat tunicam suam et emat gladium.
tr: ειπεν ουν αυτοις αλλα νυν ο εχων βαλαντιον αρατω ομοιως και πηραν και ο μη εχων πωλησατω το ιματιον αυτου και αγορασατω μαχαιραν
kjv: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.

vulg: dico enim vobis quoniam adhuc hoc quod scriptum est oportet impleri in me et quod cum iniustis deputatus est etenim ea quae sunt de me finem habent
clem: Dico enim vobis, quoniam adhuc hoc quod scriptum est, oportet impleri in me: Et cum iniquis deputatus est. Etenim ea qu sunt de me finem habent.
tr: λεγω γαρ υμιν οτι ετι τουτο το γεγραμμενον δει τελεσθηναι εν εμοι το και μετα ανομων ελογισθη και γαρ τα περι εμου τελος εχει
kjv: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.

vulg: at illi dixerunt Domine ecce gladii duo hic at ille dixit eis satis est
clem: At illi dixerunt: Domine, ecce duo gladii hic. At ille dixit eis: Satis est.
tr: οι δε ειπον κυριε ιδου μαχαιραι ωδε δυο ο δε ειπεν αυτοις ικανον εστιν
kjv: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

vulg: et egressus ibat secundum consuetudinem in montem Olivarum secuti sunt autem illum et discipuli
clem: Et egressus ibat secundum consuetudinem in monte Olivarum. Secuti sunt autem illum et discipuli.
tr: και εξελθων επορευθη κατα το εθος εις το ορος των ελαιων ηκολουθησαν δε αυτω και οι μαθηται αυτου
kjv: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.

vulg: et cum pervenisset ad locum dixit illis orate ne intretis in temptationem
clem: Et cum pervenisset ad locum, dixit illis: Orate ne intretis in tentationem.
tr: γενομενος δε επι του τοπου ειπεν αυτοις προσευχεσθε μη εισελθειν εις πειρασμον
kjv: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.

vulg: et ipse avulsus est ab eis quantum iactus est lapidis et positis genibus orabat
clem: Et ipse avulsus est ab eis quantum jactus est lapidis: et positis genibus orabat,
tr: και αυτος απεσπασθη απ αυτων ωσει λιθου βολην και θεις τα γονατα προσηυχετο
kjv: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,

vulg: dicens Pater si vis transfer calicem istum a me verumtamen non mea voluntas sed tua fiat
clem: dicens: Pater, si vis, transfer calicem istum a me: verumtamen non mea voluntas, sed tua fiat.
tr: λεγων πατερ ει βουλει παρενεγκειν  παρενεγκε  το ποτηριον τουτο απ εμου πλην μη το θελημα μου αλλα το σον γενεσθω
kjv: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

vulg: apparuit autem illi angelus de caelo confortans eum et factus in agonia prolixius orabat
clem: Apparuit autem illi angelus de clo, confortans eum. Et factus in agonia, prolixius orabat.
tr: ωφθη δε αυτω αγγελος απ ουρανου ενισχυων αυτον
kjv: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.

vulg: et factus est sudor eius sicut guttae sanguinis decurrentis in terram
clem: Et factus est sudor ejus sicut gutt sanguinis decurrentis in terram.
tr: και γενομενος εν αγωνια εκτενεστερον προσηυχετο εγενετο δε ο ιδρως αυτου ωσει θρομβοι αιματος καταβαινοντες επι την γην
kjv: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

vulg: et cum surrexisset ab oratione et venisset ad discipulos suos invenit eos dormientes prae tristitia
clem: Et cum surrexisset ab oratione et venisset ad discipulos suos, invenit eos dormientes pr tristitia.
tr: και αναστας απο της προσευχης ελθων προς τους μαθητας  αυτου  ευρεν αυτους κοιμωμενους απο της λυπης
kjv: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,

vulg: et ait illis quid dormitis surgite orate ne intretis in temptationem
clem: Et ait illis: Quid dormitis? surgite, orate, ne intretis in tentationem.
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις τι καθευδετε ανασταντες προσευχεσθε ινα μη εισελθητε εις πειρασμον
kjv: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.

vulg: adhuc eo loquente ecce turba et qui vocabatur Iudas unus de duodecim antecedebat eos et adpropinquavit Iesu ut oscularetur eum
clem: Adhuc eo loquente, ecce turba: et qui vocabatur Judas, unus de duodecim, antecedebat eos, et appropinquavit Jesu ut oscularetur eum.
tr: ετι δε αυτου λαλουντος ιδου οχλος και ο λεγομενος ιουδας εις των δωδεκα προηρχετο αυτων και ηγγισεν τω ιησου φιλησαι αυτον
kjv: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.

vulg: Iesus autem dixit ei Iuda osculo Filium hominis tradis
clem: Jesus autem dixit illi: Juda, osculo Filium hominis tradis?
tr: ο δε ιησους ειπεν αυτω ιουδα φιληματι τον υιον του ανθρωπου παραδιδως
kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

vulg: videntes autem hii qui circa ipsum erant quod futurum erat dixerunt ei Domine si percutimus in gladio
clem: Videntes autem hi qui circa ipsum erant, quod futurum erat, dixerunt ei: Domine, si percutimus in gladio?
tr: ιδοντες δε οι περι αυτον το εσομενον ειπον αυτω κυριε ει παταξομεν εν μαχαιρα
kjv: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

vulg: et percussit unus ex illis servum principis sacerdotum et amputavit auriculam eius dextram
clem: Et percussit unus ex illis servum principis sacerdotum, et amputavit auriculam ejus dexteram.
tr: και επαταξεν εις τις εξ αυτων τον δουλον του αρχιερεως και αφειλεν αυτου το ους το δεξιον
kjv: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

vulg: respondens autem Iesus ait sinite usque huc et cum tetigisset auriculam eius sanavit eum
clem: Respondens autem Jesus, ait: Sinite usque huc. Et cum tetigisset auriculam ejus, sanavit eum.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ιησους ειπεν εατε εως τουτου και αψαμενος του ωτιου αυτου ιασατο αυτον
kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.

vulg: dixit autem Iesus ad eos qui venerant ad se principes sacerdotum et magistratus templi et seniores quasi ad latronem existis cum gladiis et fustibus
clem: Dixit autem Jesus ad eos qui venerant ad se principes sacerdotum, et magistratus templi, et seniores: Quasi ad latronem existis cum gladiis et fustibus?
tr: ειπεν δε ο ιησους προς τους παραγενομενους επ αυτον αρχιερεις και στρατηγους του ιερου και πρεσβυτερους ως επι ληστην εξεληλυθατε μετα μαχαιρων και ξυλων
kjv: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?

vulg: cum cotidie vobiscum fuerim in templo non extendistis manus in me sed haec est hora vestra et potestas tenebrarum
clem: Cum quotidie vobiscum fuerim in templo, non extendistis manus in me: sed hc est hora vestra, et potestas tenebrarum.
tr: καθ ημεραν οντος μου μεθ υμων εν τω ιερω ουκ εξετεινατε τας χειρας επ εμε αλλ αυτη υμων εστιν η ωρα και η εξουσια του σκοτους
kjv: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

vulg: conprehendentes autem eum duxerunt ad domum principis sacerdotum Petrus vero sequebatur a longe
clem: Comprehendentes autem eum, duxerunt ad domum principis sacerdotum: Petrus vero sequebatur a longe.
tr: συλλαβοντες δε αυτον ηγαγον και εισηγαγον αυτον εις τον οικον του αρχιερεως ο δε πετρος ηκολουθει μακροθεν
kjv: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.

vulg: accenso autem igni in medio atrio et circumsedentibus illis erat Petrus in medio eorum
clem: Accenso autem igne in medio atrii et circumsedentibus illis, erat Petrus in medio eorum.
tr: αψαντων δε πυρ εν μεσω της αυλης και συγκαθισαντων αυτων εκαθητο ο πετρος εν μεσω αυτων
kjv: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.

vulg: quem cum vidisset ancilla quaedam sedentem ad lumen et eum fuisset intuita dixit et hic cum illo erat
clem: Quem cum vidisset ancilla qudam sedentem ad lumen, et eum fuisset intuita, dixit: Et hic cum illo erat.
tr: ιδουσα δε αυτον παιδισκη τις καθημενον προς το φως και ατενισασα αυτω ειπεν και ουτος συν αυτω ην
kjv: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.

vulg: at ille negavit eum dicens mulier non novi illum
clem: At ille negavit eum, dicens: Mulier, non novi illum.
tr: ο δε ηρνησατο αυτον λεγων γυναι ουκ οιδα αυτον
kjv: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.

vulg: et post pusillum alius videns eum dixit et tu de illis es Petrus vero ait o homo non sum
clem: Et post pusillum alius videns eum, dixit: Et tu de illis es. Petrus vero ait: O homo, non sum.
tr: και μετα βραχυ ετερος ιδων αυτον εφη και συ εξ αυτων ει ο δε πετρος ειπεν ανθρωπε ουκ ειμι
kjv: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.

vulg: et intervallo facto quasi horae unius alius quidam adfirmabat dicens vere et hic cum illo erat nam et Galilaeus est
clem: Et intervallo facto quasi hor unius, alius quidam affirmabat, dicens: Vere et hic cum illo erat: nam et Galilus est.
tr: και διαστασης ωσει ωρας μιας αλλος τις διισχυριζετο λεγων επ αληθειας και ουτος μετ αυτου ην και γαρ γαλιλαιος εστιν
kjv: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.

vulg: et ait Petrus homo nescio quod dicis et continuo adhuc illo loquente cantavit gallus
clem: Et ait Petrus: Homo, nescio quid dicis. Et continuo, adhuc illo loquente, cantavit gallus.
tr: ειπεν δε ο πετρος ανθρωπε ουκ οιδα ο λεγεις και παραχρημα ετι λαλουντος αυτου εφωνησεν ο αλεκτωρ
kjv: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.

vulg: et conversus Dominus respexit Petrum et recordatus est Petrus verbi Domini sicut dixit quia priusquam gallus cantet ter me negabis
clem: Et conversus Dominus respexit Petrum, et recordatus est Petrus verbi Domini, sicut dixerat: Quia priusquam gallus cantet, ter me negabis.
tr: και στραφεις ο κυριος ενεβλεψεν τω πετρω και υπεμνησθη ο πετρος του λογου του κυριου ως ειπεν αυτω οτι πριν αλεκτορα φωνησαι απαρνηση με τρις
kjv: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

vulg: et egressus foras Petrus flevit amare
clem: Et egressus foras Petrus flevit amare.
tr: και εξελθων εξω ο πετρος εκλαυσεν πικρως
kjv: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.

vulg: et viri qui tenebant illum inludebant ei caedentes
clem: Et viri qui tenebant illum, illudebant ei, cdentes.
tr: και οι ανδρες οι συνεχοντες τον ιησουν ενεπαιζον αυτω δεροντες
kjv: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.

vulg: et velaverunt eum et percutiebant faciem eius et interrogabant eum dicentes prophetiza quis est qui te percussit
clem: Et velaverunt eum, et percutiebant faciem ejus: et interrogabant eum, dicentes: Prophetiza, quis est, qui te percussit?
tr: και περικαλυψαντες αυτον ετυπτον αυτου το προσωπον και επηρωτων αυτον λεγοντες προφητευσον τις εστιν ο παισας σε
kjv: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?

vulg: et alia multa blasphemantes dicebant in eum
clem: Et alia multa blasphemantes dicebant in eum.
tr: και ετερα πολλα βλασφημουντες ελεγον εις αυτον
kjv: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.

vulg: et ut factus est dies convenerunt seniores plebis et principes sacerdotum et scribae et duxerunt illum in concilium suum dicentes si tu es Christus dic nobis
clem: Et ut factus est dies, convenerunt seniores plebis, et principes sacerdotum, et scrib, et duxerunt illum in concilium suum, dicentes: Si tu es Christus, dic nobis.
tr: και ως εγενετο ημερα συνηχθη το πρεσβυτεριον του λαου αρχιερεις τε και γραμματεις και ανηγαγον αυτον εις το συνεδριον εαυτων λεγοντες
kjv: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,

vulg: et ait illis si vobis dixero non creditis mihi
clem: Et ait illis: Si vobis dixero, non credetis mihi:
tr: ει συ ει ο χριστος ειπε ημιν ειπεν δε αυτοις εαν υμιν ειπω ου μη πιστευσητε
kjv: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

vulg: si autem et interrogavero non respondebitis mihi neque dimittetis
clem: si autem et interrogavero, non respondebitis mihi, neque dimittetis.
tr: εαν δε και ερωτησω ου μη αποκριθητε μοι η απολυσητε
kjv: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.

vulg: ex hoc autem erit Filius hominis sedens a dextris virtutis Dei
clem: Ex hoc autem erit Filius hominis sedens a dextris virtutis Dei.
tr: απο του νυν εσται ο υιος του ανθρωπου καθημενος εκ δεξιων της δυναμεως του θεου
kjv: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.

vulg: dixerunt autem omnes tu ergo es Filius Dei qui ait vos dicitis quia ego sum
clem: Dixerunt autem omnes: Tu ergo es Filius Dei? Qui ait: Vos dicitis, quia ego sum.
tr: ειπον δε παντες συ ουν ει ο υιος του θεου ο δε προς αυτους εφη υμεις λεγετε οτι εγω ειμι
kjv: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.

vulg: at illi dixerunt quid adhuc desideramus testimonium ipsi enim audivimus de ore eius
clem: At illi dixerunt: Quid adhuc desideramus testimonium? ipsi enim audivimus de ore ejus.
tr: οι δε ειπον τι ετι χρειαν εχομεν μαρτυριας αυτοι γαρ ηκουσαμεν απο του στοματος αυτου
kjv: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.

vulg: et surgens omnis multitudo eorum duxerunt illum ad Pilatum
clem: Et surgens omnis multitudo eorum, duxerunt illum ad Pilatum.
tr: και ανασταν απαν το πληθος αυτων ηγαγεν αυτον επι τον πιλατον
kjv: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.

vulg: coeperunt autem accusare illum dicentes hunc invenimus subvertentem gentem nostram et prohibentem tributa dari Caesari et dicentem se Christum regem esse
clem: Cperunt autem illum accusare, dicentes: Hunc invenimus subvertentem gentem nostram, et prohibentem tributa dare Csari, et dicentem se Christum regem esse.
tr: ηρξαντο δε κατηγορειν αυτου λεγοντες τουτον ευρομεν διαστρεφοντα το εθνος και κωλυοντα καισαρι φορους διδοναι λεγοντα εαυτον χριστον βασιλεα ειναι
kjv: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.

vulg: Pilatus autem interrogavit eum dicens tu es rex Iudaeorum at ille respondens ait tu dicis
clem: Pilatus autem interrogavit eum, dicens: Tu es rex Judorum? At ille respondens ait: Tu dicis.
tr: ο δε πιλατος επηρωτησεν αυτον λεγων συ ει ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων ο δε αποκριθεις αυτω εφη συ λεγεις
kjv: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.

vulg: ait autem Pilatus ad principes sacerdotum et turbas nihil invenio causae in hoc homine
clem: Ait autem Pilatus ad principes sacerdotum et turbas: Nihil invenio caus in hoc homine.
tr: ο δε πιλατος ειπεν προς τους αρχιερεις και τους οχλους ουδεν ευρισκω αιτιον εν τω ανθρωπω τουτω
kjv: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.

vulg: at illi invalescebant dicentes commovet populum docens per universam Iudaeam et incipiens a Galilaea usque huc
clem: At illi invalescebant, dicentes: Commovet populum docens per universam Judam, incipiens a Galila usque huc.
tr: οι δε επισχυον λεγοντες οτι ανασειει τον λαον διδασκων καθ ολης της ιουδαιας αρξαμενος απο της γαλιλαιας εως ωδε
kjv: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.

vulg: Pilatus autem audiens Galilaeam interrogavit si homo Galilaeus esset
clem: Pilatus autem audiens Galilam, interrogavit si homo Galilus esset.
tr: πιλατος δε ακουσας γαλιλαιαν επηρωτησεν ει ο ανθρωπος γαλιλαιος εστιν
kjv: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.

vulg: et ut cognovit quod de Herodis potestate esset remisit eum ad Herodem qui et ipse Hierosolymis erat illis diebus
clem: Et ut cognovit quod de Herodis potestate esset, remisit eum ad Herodem, qui et ipse Jerosolymis erat illis diebus.
tr: και επιγνους οτι εκ της εξουσιας ηρωδου εστιν ανεπεμψεν αυτον προς ηρωδην οντα και αυτον εν ιεροσολυμοις εν ταυταις ταις ημεραις
kjv: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

vulg: Herodes autem viso Iesu gavisus est valde erat enim cupiens ex multo tempore videre eum eo quod audiret multa de illo et sperabat signum aliquod videre ab eo fieri
clem: Herodes autem viso Jesu, gavisus est valde. Erat enim cupiens ex multo tempore videre eum, eo quod audierat multa de eo, et sperabat signum aliquod videre ab eo fieri.
tr: ο δε ηρωδης ιδων τον ιησουν εχαρη λιαν ην γαρ θελων εξ ικανου ιδειν αυτον δια το ακουειν πολλα περι αυτου και ηλπιζεν τι σημειον ιδειν υπ αυτου γινομενον
kjv: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.

vulg: interrogabat autem illum multis sermonibus at ipse nihil illi respondebat
clem: Interrogabat autem eum multis sermonibus. At ipse nihil illi respondebat.
tr: επηρωτα δε αυτον εν λογοις ικανοις αυτος δε ουδεν απεκρινατο αυτω
kjv: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.

vulg: stabant etiam principes sacerdotum et scribae constanter accusantes eum
clem: Stabant autem principes sacerdotum et scrib constanter accusantes eum.
tr: ειστηκεισαν δε οι αρχιερεις και οι γραμματεις ευτονως κατηγορουντες αυτου
kjv: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.

vulg: sprevit autem illum Herodes cum exercitu suo et inlusit indutum veste alba et remisit ad Pilatum
clem: Sprevit autem illum Herodes cum exercitu suo: et illusit indutum veste alba, et remisit ad Pilatum.
tr: εξουθενησας δε αυτον ο ηρωδης συν τοις στρατευμασιν αυτου και εμπαιξας περιβαλων αυτον εσθητα λαμπραν ανεπεμψεν αυτον τω πιλατω
kjv: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.

vulg: et facti sunt amici Herodes et Pilatus in ipsa die nam antea inimici erant ad invicem
clem: Et facti sunt amici Herodes et Pilatus in ipsa die: nam antea inimici erant ad invicem.
tr: εγενοντο δε φιλοι ο τε πιλατος και ο ηρωδης εν αυτη τη ημερα μετ αλληλων προυπηρχον γαρ εν εχθρα οντες προς εαυτους
kjv: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.

vulg: Pilatus autem convocatis principibus sacerdotum et magistratibus et plebe
clem: Pilatus autem, convocatis principibus sacerdotum, et magistratibus, et plebe,
tr: πιλατος δε συγκαλεσαμενος τους αρχιερεις και τους αρχοντας και τον λαον
kjv: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

vulg: dixit ad illos obtulistis mihi hunc hominem quasi avertentem populum et ecce ego coram vobis interrogans nullam causam inveni in homine isto ex his in quibus eum accusatis
clem: dixit ad illos: Obtulistis mihi hunc hominem, quasi avertentem populum, et ecce ego coram vobis interrogans, nullam causam inveni in homine isto ex his in quibus eum accusatis.
tr: ειπεν προς αυτους προσηνεγκατε μοι τον ανθρωπον τουτον ως αποστρεφοντα τον λαον και ιδου εγω ενωπιον υμων ανακρινας ουδεν ευρον εν τω ανθρωπω τουτω αιτιον ων κατηγορειτε κατ αυτου
kjv: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:

vulg: sed neque Herodes nam remisi vos ad illum et ecce nihil dignum morte actum est ei
clem: Sed neque Herodes: nam remisi vos ad illum, et ecce nihil dignum morte actum est ei.
tr: αλλ ουδε ηρωδης ανεπεμψα γαρ υμας προς αυτον και ιδου ουδεν αξιον θανατου εστιν πεπραγμενον αυτω
kjv: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.

vulg: emendatum ergo illum dimittam
clem: Emendatum ergo illum dimittam.
tr: παιδευσας ουν αυτον απολυσω
kjv: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.

vulg: necesse autem habebat dimittere eis per diem festum unum
clem: Necesse autem habebat dimittere eis per diem festum unum.
tr: αναγκην δε ειχεν απολυειν αυτοις κατα εορτην ενα
kjv: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)

vulg: exclamavit autem simul universa turba dicens tolle hunc et dimitte nobis Barabban
clem: Exclamavit autem simul universa turba, dicens: Tolle hunc, et dimitte nobis Barabbam:
tr: ανεκραξαν δε παμπληθει λεγοντες αιρε τουτον απολυσον δε ημιν τον βαραββαν
kjv: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:

vulg: qui erat propter seditionem quandam factam in civitate et homicidium missus in carcerem
clem: qui erat propter seditionem quamdam factam in civitate et homicidium missus in carcerem.
tr: οστις ην δια στασιν τινα γενομενην εν τη πολει και φονον βεβλημενος εις φυλακην
kjv: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)

vulg: iterum autem Pilatus locutus est ad illos volens dimittere Iesum
clem: Iterum autem Pilatus locutus est ad eos, volens dimittere Jesum.
tr: παλιν ουν ο πιλατος προσεφωνησεν θελων απολυσαι τον ιησουν
kjv: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.

vulg: at illi succlamabant dicentes crucifige crucifige illum
clem: At illi succlamabant, dicentes: Crucifige, crucifige eum.
tr: οι δε επεφωνουν λεγοντες σταυρωσον σταυρωσον αυτον
kjv: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.

vulg: ille autem tertio dixit ad illos quid enim mali fecit iste nullam causam mortis invenio in eo corripiam ergo illum et dimittam
clem: Ille autem tertio dixit ad illos: Quid enim mali fecit iste? nullam causam mortis invenio in eo: corripiam ergo illum et dimittam.
tr: ο δε τριτον ειπεν προς αυτους τι γαρ κακον εποιησεν ουτος ουδεν αιτιον θανατου ευρον εν αυτω παιδευσας ουν αυτον απολυσω
kjv: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.

vulg: at illi instabant vocibus magnis postulantes ut crucifigeretur et invalescebant voces eorum
clem: At illi instabant vocibus magnis postulantes ut crucifigeretur: et invalescebant voces eorum.
tr: οι δε επεκειντο φωναις μεγαλαις αιτουμενοι αυτον σταυρωθηναι και κατισχυον αι φωναι αυτων και των αρχιερεων
kjv: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.

vulg: et Pilatus adiudicavit fieri petitionem eorum
clem: Et Pilatus adjudicavit fieri petitionem eorum.
tr: ο δε πιλατος επεκρινεν γενεσθαι το αιτημα αυτων
kjv: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.

vulg: dimisit autem illis eum qui propter homicidium et seditionem missus fuerat in carcerem quem petebant Iesum vero tradidit voluntati eorum
clem: Dimisit autem illis eum qui propter homicidium et seditionem missus fuerat in carcerem, quem petebant: Jesum vero tradidit voluntati eorum.
tr: απελυσεν δε αυτοις τον δια στασιν και φονον βεβλημενον εις την φυλακην ον ητουντο τον δε ιησουν παρεδωκεν τω θεληματι αυτων
kjv: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.

vulg: et cum ducerent eum adprehenderunt Simonem quendam Cyrenensem venientem de villa et inposuerunt illi crucem portare post Iesum
clem: Et cum ducerent eum, apprehenderunt Simonem quemdam Cyrenensem venientem de villa: et imposuerunt illi crucem portare post Jesum.
tr: και ως απηγαγον αυτον επιλαβομενοι σιμωνος τινος κυρηναιου του ερχομενου απ αγρου επεθηκαν αυτω τον σταυρον φερειν οπισθεν του ιησου
kjv: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.

vulg: sequebatur autem illum multa turba populi et mulierum quae plangebant et lamentabant eum
clem: Sequebatur autem illum multa turba populi et mulierum, qu plangebant et lamentabantur eum.
tr: ηκολουθει δε αυτω πολυ πληθος του λαου και γυναικων αι και εκοπτοντο και εθρηνουν αυτον
kjv: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.

vulg: conversus autem ad illas Iesus dixit filiae Hierusalem nolite flere super me sed super vos ipsas flete et super filios vestros
clem: Conversus autem ad illas Jesus, dixit: Fili Jerusalem, nolite flere super me, sed super vos ipsas flete et super filios vestros.
tr: στραφεις δε προς αυτας ο ιησους ειπεν θυγατερες ιερουσαλημ μη κλαιετε επ εμε πλην εφ εαυτας κλαιετε και επι τα τεκνα υμων
kjv: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.

vulg: quoniam ecce venient dies in quibus dicent beatae steriles et ventres qui non genuerunt et ubera quae non lactaverunt
clem: Quoniam ecce venient dies in quibus dicent: Beat steriles, et ventres qui non genuerunt, et ubera qu non lactaverunt.
tr: οτι ιδου ερχονται ημεραι εν αις ερουσιν μακαριαι αι στειραι και κοιλιαι αι ουκ εγεννησαν και μαστοι οι ουκ εθηλασαν
kjv: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.

vulg: tunc incipient dicere montibus cadite super nos et collibus operite nos
clem: Tunc incipient dicere montibus: Cadite super nos; et collibus: Operite nos.
tr: τοτε αρξονται λεγειν τοις ορεσιν πεσετε εφ ημας και τοις βουνοις καλυψατε ημας
kjv: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.

vulg: quia si in viridi ligno haec faciunt in arido quid fiet
clem: Quia si in viridi ligno hc faciunt, in arido quid fiet?
tr: οτι ει εν τω υγρω ξυλω ταυτα ποιουσιν εν τω ξηρω τι γενηται
kjv: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?

vulg: ducebantur autem et alii duo nequam cum eo ut interficerentur
clem: Ducebantur autem et alii duo nequam cum eo, ut interficerentur.
tr: ηγοντο δε και ετεροι δυο κακουργοι συν αυτω αναιρεθηναι
kjv: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.

vulg: et postquam venerunt in locum qui vocatur Calvariae ibi crucifixerunt eum et latrones unum a dextris et alterum a sinistris
clem: Et postquam venerunt in locum qui vocatur Calvari, ibi crucifixerunt eum: et latrones, unum a dextris, et alterum a sinistris.
tr: και οτε απηλθον επι τον τοπον τον καλουμενον κρανιον εκει εσταυρωσαν αυτον και τους κακουργους ον μεν εκ δεξιων ον δε εξ αριστερων
kjv: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.

vulg: Iesus autem dicebat Pater dimitte illis non enim sciunt quid faciunt dividentes vero vestimenta eius miserunt sortes
clem: Jesus autem dicebat: Pater, dimitte illis: non enim sciunt quid faciunt. Dividentes vero vestimenta ejus, miserunt sortes.
tr: ο δε ιησους ελεγεν πατερ αφες αυτοις ου γαρ οιδασιν τι ποιουσιν διαμεριζομενοι δε τα ιματια αυτου εβαλον κληρον
kjv: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

vulg: et stabat populus expectans et deridebant illum principes cum eis dicentes alios salvos fecit se salvum faciat si hic est Christus Dei electus
clem: Et stabat populus spectans, et deridebant eum principes cum eis, dicentes: Alios salvos fecit, se salvum faciat, si hic est Christus Dei electus.
tr: και ειστηκει ο λαος θεωρων εξεμυκτηριζον δε και οι αρχοντες συν αυτοις λεγοντες αλλους εσωσεν σωσατω εαυτον ει ουτος εστιν ο χριστος ο του θεου εκλεκτος
kjv: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.

vulg: inludebant autem ei et milites accedentes et acetum offerentes illi
clem: Illudebant autem ei et milites accedentes, et acetum offerentes ei,
tr: ενεπαιζον δε αυτω και οι στρατιωται προσερχομενοι και οξος προσφεροντες αυτω
kjv: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,

vulg: dicentes si tu es rex Iudaeorum salvum te fac
clem: et dicentes: Si tu es rex Judorum, salvum te fac.
tr: και λεγοντες ει συ ει ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων σωσον σεαυτον
kjv: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.

vulg: erat autem et superscriptio inscripta super illum litteris graecis et latinis et hebraicis hic est rex Iudaeorum
clem: Erat autem et superscriptio scripta super eum litteris grcis, et latinis, et hebraicis: Hic est rex Judorum.
tr: ην δε και επιγραφη γεγραμμενη επ αυτω γραμμασιν ελληνικοις και ρωμαικοις και εβραικοις ουτος εστιν ο βασιλευς των ιουδαιων
kjv: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, This Is The King Of The Jews.

vulg: unus autem de his qui pendebant latronibus blasphemabat eum dicens si tu es Christus salvum fac temet ipsum et nos
clem: Unus autem de his, qui pendebant, latronibus, blasphemabat eum, dicens: Si tu es Christus, salvum fac temetipsum et nos.
tr: εις δε των κρεμασθεντων κακουργων εβλασφημει αυτον λεγων ει συ ει ο χριστος σωσον σεαυτον και ημας
kjv: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.

vulg: respondens autem alter increpabat illum dicens neque tu times Deum quod in eadem damnatione es
clem: Respondens autem alter increpabat eum, dicens: Neque tu times Deum, quod in eadem damnatione es.
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο ετερος επετιμα αυτω λεγων ουδε φοβη συ τον θεον οτι εν τω αυτω κριματι ει
kjv: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?

vulg: et nos quidem iuste nam digna factis recipimus hic vero nihil mali gessit
clem: Et nos quidem juste, nam digna factis recipimus: hic vero nihil mali gessit.
tr: και ημεις μεν δικαιως αξια γαρ ων επραξαμεν απολαμβανομεν ουτος δε ουδεν ατοπον επραξεν
kjv: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.

vulg: et dicebat ad Iesum Domine memento mei cum veneris in regnum tuum
clem: Et dicebat ad Jesum: Domine, memento mei cum veneris in regnum tuum.
tr: και ελεγεν τω ιησου μνησθητι μου κυριε οταν ελθης εν τη βασιλεια σου
kjv: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.

vulg: et dixit illi Iesus amen dico tibi hodie mecum eris in paradiso
clem: Et dixit illi Jesus: Amen dico tibi: Hodie mecum eris in paradiso.
tr: και ειπεν αυτω ο ιησους αμην λεγω σοι σημερον μετ εμου εση εν τω παραδεισω
kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, Today shalt thou be with me in paradise.

vulg: erat autem fere hora sexta et tenebrae factae sunt in universa terra usque in nonam horam
clem: Erat autem fere hora sexta, et tenebr fact sunt in universam terram usque ad horam nonam.
tr: ην δε ωσει ωρα εκτη και σκοτος εγενετο εφ ολην την γην εως ωρας εννατης
kjv: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.

vulg: et obscuratus est sol et velum templi scissum est medium
clem: Et obscuratus est sol, et velum templi scissum est medium.
tr: και εσκοτισθη ο ηλιος και εσχισθη το καταπετασμα του ναου μεσον
kjv: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.

vulg: et clamans voce magna Iesus ait Pater in manus tuas commendo spiritum meum et haec dicens exspiravit
clem: Et clamans voce magna Jesus ait: Pater, in manus tuas commendo spiritum meum. Et hc dicens, expiravit.
tr: και φωνησας φωνη μεγαλη ο ιησους ειπεν πατερ εις χειρας σου παραθησομαι το πνευμα μου και ταυτα ειπων εξεπνευσεν
kjv: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.

vulg: videns autem centurio quod factum fuerat glorificavit Deum dicens vere hic homo iustus erat
