clem: Videns autem centurio quod factum fuerat, glorificavit Deum, dicens: Vere hic homo justus erat.
tr: ιδων δε ο εκατονταρχος το γενομενον εδοξασεν τον θεον λεγων οντως ο ανθρωπος ουτος δικαιος ην
kjv: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.

vulg: et omnis turba eorum qui simul aderant ad spectaculum istud et videbant quae fiebant percutientes pectora sua revertebantur
clem: Et omnis turba eorum, qui simul aderant ad spectaculum istud, et videbant qu fiebant, percutientes pectora sua revertebantur.
tr: και παντες οι συμπαραγενομενοι οχλοι επι την θεωριαν ταυτην θεωρουντες τα γενομενα τυπτοντες εαυτων τα στηθη υπεστρεφον
kjv: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.

vulg: stabant autem omnes noti eius a longe et mulieres quae secutae erant eum a Galilaea haec videntes
clem: Stabant autem omnes noti ejus a longe, et mulieres, qu secut eum erant a Galila, hc videntes.
tr: ειστηκεισαν δε παντες οι γνωστοι αυτου μακροθεν και γυναικες αι συνακολουθησασαι αυτω απο της γαλιλαιας ορωσαι ταυτα
kjv: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.

vulg: et ecce vir nomine Ioseph qui erat decurio vir bonus et iustus
clem: Et ecce vir nomine Joseph, qui erat decurio, vir bonus et justus:
tr: και ιδου ανηρ ονοματι ιωσηφ βουλευτης υπαρχων ανηρ αγαθος και δικαιος
kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:

vulg: hic non consenserat consilio et actibus eorum ab Arimathia civitate Iudaeae qui expectabat et ipse regnum Dei
clem: hic non consenserat consilio, et actibus eorum, ab Arimatha civitate Jud, qui exspectabat et ipse regnum Dei:
tr: ουτος ουκ ην συγκατατεθειμενος τη βουλη και τη πραξει αυτων απο αριμαθαιας πολεως των ιουδαιων ος και προσεδεχετο και αυτος την βασιλειαν του θεου
kjv: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.

vulg: hic accessit ad Pilatum et petiit corpus Iesu
clem: hic accessit ad Pilatum et petiit corpus Jesu:
tr: ουτος προσελθων τω πιλατω ητησατο το σωμα του ιησου
kjv: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.

vulg: et depositum involvit sindone et posuit eum in monumento exciso in quo nondum quisquam positus fuerat
clem: et depositum involvit sindone, et posuit eum in monumento exciso, in quo nondum quisquam positus fuerat.
tr: και καθελων αυτο ενετυλιξεν αυτο σινδονι και εθηκεν αυτο εν μνηματι λαξευτω ου ουκ ην ουδεπω ουδεις κειμενος
kjv: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.

vulg: et dies erat parasceves et sabbatum inlucescebat
clem: Et dies erat parasceves, et sabbatum illucescebat.
tr: και ημερα ην παρασκευη και σαββατον επεφωσκεν
kjv: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.

vulg: subsecutae autem mulieres quae cum ipso venerant de Galilaea viderunt monumentum et quemadmodum positum erat corpus eius
clem: Subsecut autem mulieres, qu cum eo venerant de Galila, viderunt monumentum, et quemadmodum positum erat corpus ejus.
tr: κατακολουθησασαι δε και γυναικες αιτινες ησαν συνεληλυθυιαι αυτω εκ της γαλιλαιας εθεασαντο το μνημειον και ως ετεθη το σωμα αυτου
kjv: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.

vulg: et revertentes paraverunt aromata et unguenta et sabbato quidem siluerunt secundum mandatum
clem: Et revertentes paraverunt aromata, et unguenta: et sabbato quidem siluerunt secundum mandatum.
tr: υποστρεψασαι δε ητοιμασαν αρωματα και μυρα και το μεν σαββατον ησυχασαν κατα την εντολην
kjv: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.

vulg: una autem sabbati valde diluculo venerunt ad monumentum portantes quae paraverant aromata
clem: Una autem sabbati valde diluculo venerunt ad monumentum, portantes qu paraverant aromata:
tr: τη δε μια των σαββατων ορθρου βαθεος ηλθον επι το μνημα φερουσαι α ητοιμασαν αρωματα και τινες συν αυταις
kjv: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.

vulg: et invenerunt lapidem revolutum a monumento
clem: et invenerunt lapidem revolutum a monumento.
tr: ευρον δε τον λιθον αποκεκυλισμενον απο του μνημειου
kjv: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.

vulg: et ingressae non invenerunt corpus Domini Iesu
clem: Et ingress non invenerunt corpus Domini Jesu.
tr: και εισελθουσαι ουχ ευρον το σωμα του κυριου ιησου
kjv: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.

vulg: et factum est dum mente consternatae essent de isto ecce duo viri steterunt secus illas in veste fulgenti
clem: Et factum est, dum mente consternat essent de isto, ecce duo viri steterunt secus illas in veste fulgenti.
tr: και εγενετο εν τω διαπορεισθαι αυτας περι τουτου και ιδου δυο ανδρες επεστησαν αυταις εν εσθησεσιν αστραπτουσαις
kjv: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:

vulg: cum timerent autem et declinarent vultum in terram dixerunt ad illas quid quaeritis viventem cum mortuis
clem: Cum timerent autem, et declinarent vultum in terram, dixerunt ad illas: Quid quritis viventem cum mortuis?
tr: εμφοβων δε γενομενων αυτων και κλινουσων το προσωπον εις την γην ειπον προς αυτας τι ζητειτε τον ζωντα μετα των νεκρων
kjv: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?

vulg: non est hic sed surrexit recordamini qualiter locutus est vobis cum adhuc in Galilaea esset
clem: non est hic, sed surrexit: recordamini qualiter locutus est vobis, cum adhuc in Galila esset,
tr: ουκ εστιν ωδε αλλ ηγερθη μνησθητε ως ελαλησεν υμιν ετι ων εν τη γαλιλαια
kjv: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,

vulg: dicens quia oportet Filium hominis tradi in manus hominum peccatorum et crucifigi et die tertia resurgere
clem: dicens: Quia oportet Filium hominis tradi in manus hominum peccatorum, et crucifigi, et die tertia resurgere.
tr: λεγων οτι δει τον υιον του ανθρωπου παραδοθηναι εις χειρας ανθρωπων αμαρτωλων και σταυρωθηναι και τη τριτη ημερα αναστηναι
kjv: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.

vulg: et recordatae sunt verborum eius
clem: Et recordat sunt verborum ejus.
tr: και εμνησθησαν των ρηματων αυτου
kjv: And they remembered his words,

vulg: et regressae a monumento nuntiaverunt haec omnia illis undecim et ceteris omnibus
clem: Et regress a monumento nuntiaverunt hc omnia illis undecim, et ceteris omnibus.
tr: και υποστρεψασαι απο του μνημειου απηγγειλαν ταυτα παντα τοις ενδεκα και πασιν τοις λοιποις
kjv: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.

vulg: erat autem Maria Magdalene et Iohanna et Maria Iacobi et ceterae quae cum eis erant quae dicebant ad apostolos haec
clem: Erat autem Maria Magdalene, et Joanna, et Maria Jacobi, et ceter qu cum eis erant, qu dicebant ad apostolos hc.
tr: ησαν δε η μαγδαληνη μαρια και ιωαννα και μαρια ιακωβου και αι λοιπαι συν αυταις αι ελεγον προς τους αποστολους ταυτα
kjv: It was Mary Magdalene and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.

vulg: et visa sunt ante illos sicut deliramentum verba ista et non credebant illis
clem: Et visa sunt ante illos sicut deliramentum verba ista, et non crediderunt illis.
tr: και εφανησαν ενωπιον αυτων ωσει ληρος τα ρηματα αυτων και ηπιστουν αυταις
kjv: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.

vulg: Petrus autem surgens cucurrit ad monumentum et procumbens videt linteamina sola posita et abiit secum mirans quod factum fuerat
clem: Petrus autem surgens cucurrit ad monumentum: et procumbens vidit linteamina sola posita, et abiit secum mirans quod factum fuerat.
tr: ο δε πετρος αναστας εδραμεν επι το μνημειον και παρακυψας βλεπει τα οθονια κειμενα μονα και απηλθεν προς εαυτον θαυμαζων το γεγονος
kjv: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.

vulg: et ecce duo ex illis ibant ipsa die in castellum quod erat in spatio stadiorum sexaginta ab Hierusalem nomine Emmaus
clem: Et ecce duo ex illis ibant ipsa die in castellum, quod erat in spatio stadiorum sexaginta ab Jerusalem, nomine Emmaus.
tr: και ιδου δυο εξ αυτων ησαν πορευομενοι εν αυτη τη ημερα εις κωμην απεχουσαν σταδιους εξηκοντα απο ιερουσαλημ η ονομα εμμαους
kjv: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.

vulg: et ipsi loquebantur ad invicem de his omnibus quae acciderant
clem: Et ipsi loquebantur ad invicem de his omnibus qu acciderant.
tr: και αυτοι ωμιλουν προς αλληλους περι παντων των συμβεβηκοτων τουτων
kjv: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

vulg: et factum est dum fabularentur et secum quaererent et ipse Iesus adpropinquans ibat cum illis
clem: Et factum est, dum fabularentur, et secum qurerent: et ipse Jesus appropinquans ibat cum illis:
tr: και εγενετο εν τω ομιλειν αυτους και συζητειν και αυτος ο ιησους εγγισας συνεπορευετο αυτοις
kjv: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.

vulg: oculi autem illorum tenebantur ne eum agnoscerent
clem: oculi autem illorum tenebantur ne eum agnoscerent.
tr: οι δε οφθαλμοι αυτων εκρατουντο του μη επιγνωναι αυτον
kjv: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.

vulg: et ait ad illos qui sunt hii sermones quos confertis ad invicem ambulantes et estis tristes
clem: Et ait ad illos: Qui sunt hi sermones, quos confertis ad invicem ambulantes, et estis tristes?
tr: ειπεν δε προς αυτους τινες οι λογοι ουτοι ους αντιβαλλετε προς αλληλους περιπατουντες και εστε σκυθρωποι
kjv: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?

vulg: et respondens unus cui nomen Cleopas dixit ei tu solus peregrinus es in Hierusalem et non cognovisti quae facta sunt in illa his diebus
clem: Et respondens unus, cui nomen Cleophas, dixit ei: Tu solus peregrinus es in Jerusalem, et non cognovisti qu facta sunt in illa his diebus?
tr: αποκριθεις δε ο εις ω ονομα κλεοπας ειπεν προς αυτον συ μονος παροικεις εν ιερουσαλημ και ουκ εγνως τα γενομενα εν αυτη εν ταις ημεραις ταυταις
kjv: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?

vulg: quibus ille dixit quae et dixerunt de Iesu Nazareno qui fuit vir propheta potens in opere et sermone coram Deo et omni populo
clem: Quibus ille dixit: Qu? Et dixerunt: De Jesu Nazareno, qui fuit vir propheta, potens in opere et sermone coram Deo et omni populo:
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις ποια οι δε ειπον αυτω τα περι ιησου του ναζωραιου ος εγενετο ανηρ προφητης δυνατος εν εργω και λογω εναντιον του θεου και παντος του λαου
kjv: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:

vulg: et quomodo eum tradiderunt summi sacerdotum et principes nostri in damnationem mortis et crucifixerunt eum
clem: et quomodo eum tradiderunt summi sacerdotes et principes nostri in damnationem mortis, et crucifixerunt eum:
tr: οπως τε παρεδωκαν αυτον οι αρχιερεις και οι αρχοντες ημων εις κριμα θανατου και εσταυρωσαν αυτον
kjv: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.

vulg: nos autem sperabamus quia ipse esset redempturus Israhel et nunc super haec omnia tertia dies hodie quod haec facta sunt
clem: nos autem sperabamus quia ipse esset redempturus Isral: et nunc super hc omnia, tertia dies est hodie quod hc facta sunt.
tr: ημεις δε ηλπιζομεν οτι αυτος εστιν ο μελλων λυτρουσθαι τον ισραηλ αλλα γε συν πασιν τουτοις τριτην ταυτην ημεραν αγει σημερον αφ ου ταυτα εγενετο
kjv: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.

vulg: sed et mulieres quaedam ex nostris terruerunt nos quae ante lucem fuerunt ad monumentum
clem: Sed et mulieres qudam ex nostris terruerunt nos, qu ante lucem fuerunt ad monumentum,
tr: αλλα και γυναικες τινες εξ ημων εξεστησαν ημας γενομεναι ορθριαι επι το μνημειον
kjv: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;

vulg: et non invento corpore eius venerunt dicentes se etiam visionem angelorum vidisse qui dicunt eum vivere
clem: et non invento corpore ejus, venerunt, dicentes se etiam visionem angelorum vidisse, qui dicunt eum vivere.
tr: και μη ευρουσαι το σωμα αυτου ηλθον λεγουσαι και οπτασιαν αγγελων εωρακεναι οι λεγουσιν αυτον ζην
kjv: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.

vulg: et abierunt quidam ex nostris ad monumentum et ita invenerunt sicut mulieres dixerunt ipsum vero non viderunt
clem: Et abierunt quidam ex nostris ad monumentum: et ita invenerunt sicut mulieres dixerunt, ipsum vero non invenerunt.
tr: και απηλθον τινες των συν ημιν επι το μνημειον και ευρον ουτως καθως και αι γυναικες ειπον αυτον δε ουκ ειδον
kjv: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.

vulg: et ipse dixit ad eos o stulti et tardi corde ad credendum in omnibus quae locuti sunt prophetae
clem: Et ipse dixit ad eos: O stulti, et tardi corde ad credendum in omnibus qu locuti sunt prophet!
tr: και αυτος ειπεν προς αυτους ω ανοητοι και βραδεις τη καρδια του πιστευειν επι πασιν οις ελαλησαν οι προφηται
kjv: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:

vulg: nonne haec oportuit pati Christum et ita intrare in gloriam suam
clem: Nonne hc oportuit pati Christum, et ita intrare in gloriam suam?
tr: ουχι ταυτα εδει παθειν τον χριστον και εισελθειν εις την δοξαν αυτου
kjv: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?

vulg: et incipiens a Mose et omnibus prophetis interpretabatur illis in omnibus scripturis quae de ipso erant
clem: Et incipiens a Moyse, et omnibus prophetis, interpretabatur illis in omnibus scripturis qu de ipso erant.
tr: και αρξαμενος απο μωσεως και απο παντων των προφητων διηρμηνευεν αυτοις εν πασαις ταις γραφαις τα περι εαυτου
kjv: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

vulg: et adpropinquaverunt castello quo ibant et ipse se finxit longius ire
clem: Et appropinquaverunt castello quo ibant: et ipse se finxit longius ire.
tr: και ηγγισαν εις την κωμην ου επορευοντο και αυτος προσεποιειτο πορρωτερω πορευεσθαι
kjv: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.

vulg: et coegerunt illum dicentes mane nobiscum quoniam advesperascit et inclinata est iam dies et intravit cum illis
clem: Et cogerunt illum, dicentes: Mane nobiscum, quoniam advesperascit, et inclinata est jam dies. Et intravit cum illis.
tr: και παρεβιασαντο αυτον λεγοντες μεινον μεθ ημων οτι προς εσπεραν εστιν και κεκλικεν η ημερα και εισηλθεν του μειναι συν αυτοις
kjv: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.

vulg: et factum est dum recumberet cum illis accepit panem et benedixit ac fregit et porrigebat illis
clem: Et factum est, dum recumberet cum eis, accepit panem, et benedixit, ac fregit, et porrigebat illis.
tr: και εγενετο εν τω κατακλιθηναι αυτον μετ αυτων λαβων τον αρτον ευλογησεν και κλασας επεδιδου αυτοις
kjv: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.

vulg: et aperti sunt oculi eorum et cognoverunt eum et ipse evanuit ex oculis eorum
clem: Et aperti sunt oculi eorum, et cognoverunt eum: et ipse evanuit ex oculis eorum.
tr: αυτων δε διηνοιχθησαν οι οφθαλμοι και επεγνωσαν αυτον και αυτος αφαντος εγενετο απ αυτων
kjv: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.

vulg: et dixerunt ad invicem nonne cor nostrum ardens erat in nobis dum loqueretur in via et aperiret nobis scripturas
clem: Et dixerunt ad invicem: Nonne cor nostrum ardens erat in nobis dum loqueretur in via, et aperiret nobis Scripturas?
tr: και ειπον προς αλληλους ουχι η καρδια ημων καιομενη ην εν ημιν ως ελαλει ημιν εν τη οδω και ως διηνοιγεν ημιν τας γραφας
kjv: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

vulg: et surgentes eadem hora regressi sunt in Hierusalem et invenerunt congregatos undecim et eos qui cum ipsis erant
clem: Et surgentes eadem hora regressi sunt in Jerusalem: et invenerunt congregatos undecim, et eos qui cum illis erant,
tr: και ανασταντες αυτη τη ωρα υπεστρεψαν εις ιερουσαλημ και ευρον συνηθροισμενους τους ενδεκα και τους συν αυτοις
kjv: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,

vulg: dicentes quod surrexit Dominus vere et apparuit Simoni
clem: dicentes: Quod surrexit Dominus vere, et apparuit Simoni.
tr: λεγοντας οτι ηγερθη ο κυριος οντως και ωφθη σιμωνι
kjv: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

vulg: et ipsi narrabant quae gesta erant in via et quomodo cognoverunt eum in fractione panis
clem: Et ipsi narrabant qu gesta erant in via, et quomodo cognoverunt eum in fractione panis.
tr: και αυτοι εξηγουντο τα εν τη οδω και ως εγνωσθη αυτοις εν τη κλασει του αρτου
kjv: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.

vulg: dum haec autem loquuntur Iesus stetit in medio eorum et dicit eis pax vobis ego sum nolite timere
clem: Dum autem hc loquuntur, stetit Jesus in medio eorum, et dicit eis: Pax vobis: ego sum, nolite timere.
tr: ταυτα δε αυτων λαλουντων αυτος ο ιησους εστη εν μεσω αυτων και λεγει αυτοις ειρηνη υμιν
kjv: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

vulg: conturbati vero et conterriti existimabant se spiritum videre
clem: Conturbati vero et conterriti, existimabant se spiritum videre.
tr: πτοηθεντες δε και εμφοβοι γενομενοι εδοκουν πνευμα θεωρειν
kjv: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

vulg: et dixit eis quid turbati estis et cogitationes ascendunt in corda vestra
clem: Et dixit eis: Quid turbati estis, et cogitationes ascendunt in corda vestra?
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις τι τεταραγμενοι εστε και δια τι διαλογισμοι αναβαινουσιν εν ταις καρδιαις υμων
kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?

vulg: videte manus meas et pedes quia ipse ego sum palpate et videte quia spiritus carnem et ossa non habet sicut me videtis habere
clem: videte manus meas, et pedes, quia ego ipse sum; palpate et videte, quia spiritus carnem et ossa non habet, sicut me videtis habere.
tr: ιδετε τας χειρας μου και τους ποδας μου οτι αυτος εγω ειμι ψηλαφησατε με και ιδετε οτι πνευμα σαρκα και οστεα ουκ εχει καθως εμε θεωρειτε εχοντα
kjv: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.

vulg: et cum hoc dixisset ostendit eis manus et pedes
clem: Et cum hoc dixisset, ostendit eis manus et pedes.
tr: και τουτο ειπων επεδειξεν αυτοις τας χειρας και τους ποδας
kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.

vulg: adhuc autem illis non credentibus et mirantibus prae gaudio dixit habetis hic aliquid quod manducetur
clem: Adhuc autem illis non credentibus, et mirantibus pr gaudio, dixit: Habetis hic aliquid quod manducetur?
tr: ετι δε απιστουντων αυτων απο της χαρας και θαυμαζοντων ειπεν αυτοις εχετε τι βρωσιμον ενθαδε
kjv: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?

vulg: at illi obtulerunt ei partem piscis assi et favum mellis
clem: At illi obtulerunt ei partem piscis assi et favum mellis.
tr: οι δε επεδωκαν αυτω ιχθυος οπτου μερος και απο μελισσιου κηριου
kjv: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.

vulg: et cum manducasset coram eis sumens reliquias dedit eis
clem: Et cum manducasset coram eis, sumens reliquias dedit eis.
tr: και λαβων ενωπιον αυτων εφαγεν
kjv: And he took it, and did eat before them.

vulg: et dixit ad eos haec sunt verba quae locutus sum ad vos cum adhuc essem vobiscum quoniam necesse est impleri omnia quae scripta sunt in lege Mosi et prophetis et psalmis de me
clem: Et dixit ad eos: Hc sunt verba qu locutus sum ad vos cum adhuc essem vobiscum, quoniam necesse est impleri omnia qu scripta sunt in lege Moysi, et prophetis, et Psalmis de me.
tr: ειπεν δε αυτοις ουτοι οι λογοι ους ελαλησα προς υμας ετι ων συν υμιν οτι δει πληρωθηναι παντα τα γεγραμμενα εν τω νομω μωσεως και προφηταις και ψαλμοις περι εμου
kjv: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.

vulg: tunc aperuit illis sensum ut intellegerent scripturas
clem: Tunc aperuit illis sensum ut intelligerent Scripturas,
tr: τοτε διηνοιξεν αυτων τον νουν του συνιεναι τας γραφας
kjv: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,

vulg: et dixit eis quoniam sic scriptum est et sic oportebat Christum pati et resurgere a mortuis die tertia
clem: et dixit eis: Quoniam sic scriptum est, et sic oportebat Christum pati, et resurgere a mortuis tertia die:
tr: και ειπεν αυτοις οτι ουτως γεγραπται και ουτως εδει παθειν τον χριστον και αναστηναι εκ νεκρων τη τριτη ημερα
kjv: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behooved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:

vulg: et praedicari in nomine eius paenitentiam et remissionem peccatorum in omnes gentes incipientibus ab Hierosolyma
clem: et prdicari in nomine ejus pnitentiam, et remissionem peccatorum in omnes gentes, incipientibus ab Jerosolyma.
tr: και κηρυχθηναι επι τω ονοματι αυτου μετανοιαν και αφεσιν αμαρτιων εις παντα τα εθνη αρξαμενον απο ιερουσαλημ
kjv: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

vulg: vos autem estis testes horum
clem: Vos autem testes estis horum.
tr: υμεις δε εστε μαρτυρες τουτων
kjv: And ye are witnesses of these things.

vulg: et ego mitto promissum Patris mei in vos vos autem sedete in civitate quoadusque induamini virtutem ex alto
clem: Et ego mitto promissum Patris mei in vos; vos autem sedete in civitate, quoadusque induamini virtute ex alto.
tr: και ιδου εγω αποστελλω την επαγγελιαν του πατρος μου εφ υμας υμεις δε καθισατε εν τη πολει ιερουσαλημ εως ου ενδυσησθε δυναμιν εξ υψους
kjv: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.

vulg: eduxit autem eos foras in Bethaniam et elevatis manibus suis benedixit eis
clem: Eduxit autem eos foras in Bethaniam, et elevatis manibus suis benedixit eis.
tr: εξηγαγεν δε αυτους εξω εως εις βηθανιαν και επαρας τας χειρας αυτου ευλογησεν αυτους
kjv: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

vulg: et factum est dum benediceret illis recessit ab eis et ferebatur in caelum
clem: Et factum est, dum benediceret illis, recessit ab eis, et ferebatur in clum.
tr: και εγενετο εν τω ευλογειν αυτον αυτους διεστη απ αυτων και ανεφερετο εις τον ουρανον
kjv: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.

vulg: et ipsi adorantes regressi sunt in Hierusalem cum gaudio magno
clem: Et ipsi adorantes regressi sunt in Jerusalem cum gaudio magno:
tr: και αυτοι προσκυνησαντες αυτον υπεστρεψαν εις ιερουσαλημ μετα χαρας μεγαλης
kjv: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:

vulg: et erant semper in templo laudantes et benedicentes Deum amen
clem: et erant semper in templo, laudantes et benedicentes Deum. Amen.
tr: και ησαν διαπαντος  δια παντος  εν τω ιερω αινουντες και ευλογουντες τον θεον αμην
kjv: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
